title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' not possible due to active search blocks
desc_en: The NCK is currently processing either the action blocks of the search run or the approach motion after the search run. In this situation, the action (2nd parameter of the alarm) must be rejected. Currently, only the integrated search run is rejected with this alarm. The integrated search run is activated, if search run is triggered in the Stop program state. In other words: Parts of a program have already been executed and a following program part is "skipped" with search run in order to continue the program afterwards. Repeat the action after the approach motion of the search run.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' delayed up to the block end
desc_en: The currently executing action (e.g. dry run on/off, change skip levels, etc.) should be active immediately, but it can become active not earlier than at the end of the block, since a thread is currently being machined. The action is activated with a slight delay. Example: Dry run is started in the middle of the thread, then traversing at high speed does not start before the next block. Alarm can be switched off via MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit17==1. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Start via START is not allowed
desc_en: This alarm is active with "Group Serupro" only. "Group Serupro" is activated by means of MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK, Bit 2 and enables the retrace support of entire channel groups during block search. The MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START specifies which channel is generally started from the PLC and which channel is only allowed to be started from another channel via the START part program command. This alarm occurs if the channel was started via the START part programm command and MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START==FALSE was set. Modify MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START of switch off "Group Serupro" (see MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Start via PLC is not allowed
desc_en: This alarm is active with "Group Serupro" only. "Group Serupro" is activated by means of MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK, Bit 2 and enables the retrace support of entire channel groups during block search. The machine data MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START specifies which channel is generally started from the PLC and which channel is only allowed to be started from another channel via the START part program command. This alarm occurs if the channel was started via the PLC and MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START==TRUE was set. Modify MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START of switch off "Group Serupro" (see MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] dependent channel %2 still active
desc_en: This alarm is active with "Group Serupro" only. "Group Serupro" is activated by means of MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MODE, bit 2 and enables the retrace support of entire channel groups during block search. A _dependent channel_ is a channel that had indirectly been started by the currently active channel. The currently active channel was started via PLC. This channel m_u_s_t be terminated (i.e. reached M30) before the current channel is terminated. This alarm occurs if the currently active channel is terminated before the dependent channel. Switch off "Group Serupro" (see MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK) or install WAITE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Correspondence between marker of channel %1 and channel %2 is invalid.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Search run with hold block
desc_en: Informational alarm. The search run was not performed on the interruption block, instead, it touches down shortly before that. This so-called "hold block" is generated by the part program command IPTRLOCK, or implicitly defined by MD22680 $MC_AUTO_IPTR_LOCK. This is to prevent you from performing a search run in critical program areas (e.g. gear hobbing). The alarm also displays that, instead of searching for the block that actually was interrupted before, another block is being searched for. This behavior is desired and the alarm serves only informational purposes. MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK, MD22680 $MC_AUTO_IPTR_LOCK and language command IPTRLOCK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Search run in a protected program section.
desc_en: A part programmer can define protected part program sections with the language commands IPTRLOCK and IPTRUNLOCK. Every search run in these program sections will then be acknowledged with alarm 16951. In other words: When the alarm appears, the user has started a search run (Serupro type) and the search target lies in a protected area. A protected area can also be defined implicitly with the MD22680 $MC_AUTO_IPTR_LOCK. Note: The alarm can only be generated if the simulation has been completed during the search run. The alarm cannot be output immediately at the start of the search run. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

SERUPRO is possible only with an active coupling, if the axis/spindle disable is active for all master axes/spindles of the slave axis/spindle Set axis/spindle disable of the master axis

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 programmed stop prohibited in stop delay area
desc_en: In a program area (stop delay area) that is bracketed with DELAYFSTON and DELAYFSTOF, a program command was used that causes a stop. No commands other than G4 are permissible that might cause a stop even though only shortly. A stop delay area can also be defined by MD11550 $MN_STOP_MODE_MASK. MD11550 $MN_STOP_MODE_MASK and language command DELAYFSTON DELAYFSTOF

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Stop in stop delay area is delayed
desc_en: In a program area (stop delay area) that is bracketed by DELAYFSTON and DELAYFSTOF, an event has been detected that causes a stop. The stop is delayed and executed after DELAYFSTOF. A stop delay area can also be defined by MD11550 $MN_STOP_MODE_MASK. MD11550 $MN_STOP_MODE_MASK and language command DELAYFSTON DELAYFSTOF

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Program %2 cannot be started due to global start disable.
desc_en: The program selected in this channel cannot be started as "Global start disable" had been set. Note: PI "_N_STRTLK" sets the "Global start disable" and PI "_N_STRTUL" deletes the "Global start disable". The alarm is switched on with MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK bit 6. Delete the "Global start disable" and restart.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Stop-Delay area is suppressed
desc_en: The program area (Stop-Delay area), which is bracketed by DELAYFSTON and DELAYFSTOF, could not be activated. Every stop therefore becomes effective immediately and is not delayed! This occurs every time, when braking into a stop Stop-Delay area, i.e. a braking process starts before the Stop-Delay area and ends not earlier than in the Stop-Delay area. If the Stop-Delay area is entered with override 0, the Stop-Delay area can also not be activated Example: a G4 before the Stop-Delay area allows the user to reduce the override to 0. The next block in the Stop-Delay area then starts with override 0 and the alarm situation described occurs. MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK, bit 7 switches on this alarm. MD11550 $MN_STOP_MODE_MASK and language command DELAYFSTON DELAYFSTOF

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Machine data %2[%3] contains invalid syntax, error code: %4
desc_en: A syntax rule was violated when defining an auxiliary function or a subprogram name. The error code helps pinpoint the problem: 1 - An auxiliary function definition must start with M, D, H or T. 2 - An auxiliary function definition needs an extension or a value. 3- If present, an auxiliary function extension must be a a wild card '*' or a natural number enclosed in square brackets '[', ']'. A natural number is only allowed for 'T' auxiliary functions when $MC_T_M_ADDRESS_EXT_IS_SPINO = TRUE or with active magazine management (MD18080 $MN_MM_TOOL_MANAGEMENT_MASK, MD20310 $MC_TOOL_MANAGEMENT_MASK). 4 - If present, the value of an auxiliary function must be a natural number or a wild card '*' after an equals sign '='. 5 - With active tool management (MD18080 $MN_MM_TOOL_MANAGEMENT_MASK, MD20310 $MC_TOOL_MANAGEMENT_MASK), a numerical value must not be given for 'T', only a wild card '*' is allowed. 6 - Other entries as auxiliary functions are interpreted as subprogram names. A subprogram name must be a valid NC subprogram name with the prefix '_N_', without path specification and without '/'. It must not contain special or control characters. It must not be a keyword of the NC language (e.g. POSA). 7 - '_N_ASUP1' and '_N_ASUP2' are not permitted as subprogram definitions because these are the subprogram names from system ASUBs. - Examples of correct auxiliary function definitions are: 'H[3]=7', 'M[22]', 'D[*]=4', 'T[*]=*', 'T=*', . An example of a correct subprogram name is '_N_TOOL_TWIST'. Please notify the authorized personnel/service department. Enter auxiliary function definition or subprogram name with correct syntax in the displayed MD. - CFG_STOP positions: SD42220 $SC_CFG_STOP_ARRAY

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 T no.= %3, D no.= %4 not existing
desc_en: A programmed D number was not recognized by the NC. By default, the D number refers to the specified T number. If the flat D number function is active, T= 1 is output. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: - The program is incorrect: Eliminate the error with a correction block and continue the program. - The data block is missing: Load a data block for the specified T/D values onto the NCK via HMI with overstore, and continue the program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal sum correction number
desc_en: An attempt was made to access a non-defined total offset of the current tool edge.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 H number already available in T no.= %3, D no.= %4
desc_en: Each H number (except for H=0) must be assigned in a TO unit only once. The indicated edge already has the H number. If the H number shall be assigned more than once, MD10890 $MN_EXTERN_TOOLPROG_MODE, bit 3 must be set = 1. - Change program: - Select different H number

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Tool %3, Duplo no. %5, D no.= %6 does not exist
desc_en: A D number has been programmed that does not exist for the selected tool. If the selected tool does not contain the programmed D number, * the data block for the cutting edge can be loaded into the NC (via HMI, with overstore) or * the cutting edge can be created subsequently, or, * if necessary, the D number and/or the tool identifier can be corrected in the displayed block, and the NC program can be continued..

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Impermissible cutting edge number %2 for monitoring on tool holder number %3
desc_en: A cutting edge number is selected for monitoring on the tool holder displayed, which is not present on the tool contained. Check the tool call in the NC part program. Select a different cutting edge for monitoring (by $AC_MONITORED_DNO) or define the missing cutting edge for the tool. For further details and examples, see the function description of tool life monitoring.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] D number %2 defined in tool T no. %3 and %4
desc_en: The specified D number %2 in the TO unit of channel %1 is not unique. The specified T numbers %3 and %4 each have an offset with number %2. If tool management is active: The specified T numbers belong to tool groups with different names. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: 1. Use unique D numbering within the TO unit. 2. Use another command.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] D number %2 of tools defined on magazine/location %3 and %4
desc_en: The specified D number %2 in the TO unit of channel %1 is not unique. The specified T numbers %3 and %4 each have an offset with number %2. If tool management is active: The specified T numbers belong to tool groups with different names. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: 1. Use unique D numbering within the TO unit. Rename the D numbers if necessary. 2. Use another command.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal T number %3
desc_en: In the displayed block, a tool is accessed that is not defined and is therefore not available. The tool has been named by its T number, its name or its name and duplo number. If the function T=magazine location is activated and programmed, the programmed T number indicates the magazine location number. The alarm can then indicate that the programmed magazine location number is illegal. If the function T=magazine location is activated and programmed, and the multitool function is also activated and programmed in the program line MTL, the alarm can also indicate that there is no multitool at the location programmed with T=magazine location or that there is no tool at the multitool location programmed with MTL.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 T= %3 not existing, program %4
desc_en: A tool identifier which the NCK does not recognize was programmed. If the program pointer is at an NC block which contains the specified T identifier: If the program is incorrect, remedy the error with a correction block and continue the program. If the data block is missing, create one. You can do this by downloading a data block with all the defined D numbers onto the NCK (via HMI with overstore) and continue the program. If the program pointer is at an NC block which does not contain the specified T identifier: The error occurred at an earlier point in the program where the T command appeared, but the alarm was not output until the change command was detected. If the program is incorrect - T5 programmed instead of T55 - the current block can be corrected with a correction block; i.e. if only M06 is entered, you can correct the block with T55 M06. The incorrect T5 line remains in the program until it is terminated by a RESET or end of program. In complex program structures with indirect programming, it may not be possible to correct the program. In this case, you can only intervene locally with an overstore block - with T55 in the example. If the data block is missing, create one. You can do this by downloading the data block of the tool with all the defined D numbers onto the NCK (via HMI with overstore), program the T command with overstore, and continue the program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [TO unit %1: ] Invalid tool designation of '%2', duplo no. %3. No more replacement tools possible in '%4'.
desc_en: The tool with the specified tool identifier, duplo number cannot accept the group identifier. Reason: The maximum number of replacement tools allowed has already been defined. The name allocation causes the tool to be reallocated to a tool group which already contains the maximum number of replacement tools allowed on this machine. Use fewer replacement tools or request a different maximum setting from the machine manufacturer.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 the active tool is no longer on toolholder no./spindle no. %3, program %4
desc_en: The tool at the specified toolholder/spindle at which the last tool change was carried out as master toolholder or master spindle, has been replaced. Example: N10 SETHTH(1) N20 T="Wz1" ; Tool change at master toolholder 1 N30 SETMTH(2) N40 T1="Wz2" ; Toolholder 1 is only a secondary toolholder. Changing the tool does not result in compensation deselection. N50 D5; New correction selection. At present, there is no active tool which D can refer to, i.e. D5 refers to T no. = 0, which results in zero correction. - Modify program: - Set desired spindle as master spindle or toolholder as master toolholder. - Then, if required, reset master spindle or master toolholder.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 no suitable tool found
desc_en: - An attempt was made to access a tool which has not been defined. - The specified tool does not permit access. - A tool with the desired properties is not available. - MTL=MT location T=magazine location number was programmed. There is no multitool at the programmed location Check access to tool: - Are the parameters of the command correctly programmed? - Does the status of the tool prevent access?

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] block %2 illegal tool holder number %3
desc_en: In the displayed block, a tool holder that is not defined is accessed. Check the programming of the tool holder in the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool data cannot be deleted. Tool %3 Error ID: %4
desc_en: An attempt has been made to delete the tool data from the part program for a tool currently being processed. Tool data for tools involved in the current machining operation must not be deleted. This applies both for the tool preselected with T or that has been changed in place of another, and also for tools for which the constant grinding wheel peripheral speed or tool monitoring is active. The first part of parameter 4 ("Error reason") shows why the tool cannot be deleted. The possible values: 1 - Tool is active 2 - WZ is at a magazine location 3 - Tool is active and at a magazine location 4 - Tool is being moved 5 - Tool is active and is being moved 6 - Tool is at a magazine location and is being moved 7 - Tool is active, is at a magazine location, and is being moved Check access to tool offset memory by means of $TC_DP1[t,d] = 0 or deselect tool.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 deleting magazine data not possible
desc_en: An attempt was made to delete magazine data which cannot currently be deleted. A magazine with the 'tool in motion' status active cannot be deleted. A tool adapter which is currently allocated to a magazine location cannot be deleted. A tool adapter cannot be deleted if MD18104 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL_ADAPTER has the value -1. If an attempt to delete a magazine fails $TC_MAP1[ m ] = 0 ; Delete magazine with m=magazine no. $TC_MAP1[ 0 ] = 0 ; Delete all magazines $TC_MAP6[ m ] = 0 ; Delete magazines and all their tools you must ensure that the magazine does not have the 'tool in motion' status at the time of the call. If an attempt to delete a tool adapter fails $TC_ADPTT[ a ] = -1 ; Delete adapter with number a $TC_ADPTT[ 0 ] = -1 ; Delete all adapters then the data association with the magazine location or locations must first be canceled with $TC_MPP7[ m,p ] = 0 ; m = magazine no., p = no. of the location to which the adapter is assigned.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 access to variable not possible

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Tool management: Load manual tool %3, duplo no. %2 onto spindle/toolholder %4
desc_en: Indicates that the specified manual tool must be loaded in the specified toolholder or spindle before the program continues. A manual tool is a tool whose data is known to the NCK but has not been assigned to a magazine location and is, therefore, not fully accessible to the NCK for automatic tool change or, in most cases, to the machine either. The specified manual tool can also be a tool in a multitool. In this case the multitool has to be changed. Make sure that the specified tool is loaded in the toolholder. The alarm is cleared automatically after PLC acknowledgment of the tool change on command.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Tool management: remove manual tool %3 from spindle/toolholder %2
desc_en: Indicates that the specified manual tool must be removed from the specified toolholder or spindle before the program continues. A manual tool is a tool whose data is known to the NCK but has not been assigned to a magazine location and is, therefore, not fully accessible to the NCK for automatic tool change or, in most cases, to the machine either. The specified manual tool may be a tool in a multitool. In this case the multitool has to be removed. Make sure that the specified tool is removed from the toolholder. The alarm is cleared automatically after PLC acknowledgment of the tool change on command. Manual tools can only be used efficiently if this is supported by the PLC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Tool management: Remove manual tool %3 from buffer location %2
desc_en: Indicates that the specified manual tool must be removed from the specified buffer location before the program continues. A manual tool is a tool whose data is known to the NCK but has not been assigned to a magazine location and is, therefore, not fully accessible to the NCK for automatic tool change or, in most cases, to the machine either. The specified manual tool may also be included in a multitool. In this case the multitool has to be removed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Remove manual tool from toolholder %4 and load manual tool %3 %2
desc_en: Indicates that the specified manual tool must be loaded in the specified toolholder or spindle before the program is continued and that the manual tool located there must be removed. A manual tool is a tool whose data are known to the NCK but which is not assigned to a magazine location and is thus not fully accessible to the NCK, and usually also to the machine, for an automatic tool change. Make sure that the manual tools are exchanged. The alarm is cleared automatically after PLC acknowledgment of the tool change on command. Manual tools can only be used efficiently if this is supported by the PLC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Tool %3 cannot become a manual tool
desc_en: The specified tool has a dedicated location and/or a location has been reserved for this tool in an actual magazine. Therefore, it cannot become a manual tool. - Correct the NC program - Use the programming of "DELRMRES" to check that there is no reference to an actual magazine location

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 tool not existing
desc_en: This alarm occurs if a T no., the tool name or the tool name and duplo number is used in an attempt to access a tool that has not been defined or is yet to be defined (e.g. if tools are to be positioned in magazine locations by programming $TC_MPP6 = 'toolNo'). This will only be possible if both the magazine location and the tool specified with 'toolNo' have been defined. The tool which does not exist can also be a multitool (the multitool is treated like a tool). Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 tool T/D= %3 - tool type %4 is not permitted
desc_en: On this system, it is not possible to select tool offsets of the indicated tool types. The variety of tool types can both be limited by the machine OEM and be reduced on individual control models. Only use tools of the tool types permitted for this system. Check whether an error has occurred on defining the tool. Correct the NC program or correct the tool data

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Duplo no. already assigned
desc_en: If an attempt is made to write a tool Duplo number to the name of which another tool (another T number) already exists with the same Duplo number. Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal tool definition
desc_en: If an attempt is made to modify a tool data that would subsequently damage the data consistency or lead to a conflicting definition, this alarm will appear. Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal adapter definition
desc_en: Possible causes of the error: - For an old-type tool adapter (type 1), parameters belonging to the new-type adapter (type 2) cannot be written. - For a new-type tool adapter (type 2), parameters belonging to the old-type adapter (type 1) cannot be written. The adapter type can neither be changed nor set to less than 0 or greater than 2. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal magazine definition
desc_en: If an attempt is made to modify a magazine data that would subsequently damage the data consistency or lead to a conflicting definition, this alarm will appear. Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 magazine location hierarchies have been deleted
desc_en: If $TC_MAMP2, bit 15 is changed, existing hierarchies may be deleted because of a change in meaning. Redefine magazine location hierarchies.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal magazine location definition
desc_en: This alarm occurs if an attempt is made to change a magazine location data which would subsequently damage data consistency irreparably or lead to a conflicting definition. Example: If parameter $TC_MPP1 (= type of location) is written with 'spindle/toolholder location', this may conflict with the limiting MD18075 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOLHOLDERS. The remedy is then either - if permitted by the control model - to increase the value of MD18075 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOLHOLDERS or to correct the magazine definition. A tool cannot be simultaneously: - Loaded in two different magazine locations. - A part of a multitool and in a magazine location. Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [TO unit %1: ] Not all the values of %3 from magazine %2 can be displayed.
desc_en: Not all user magazine location data ($TC_MPPCx[magNo, locNo] can be accessed via OPI. - Either reduce the number of OEM magazine location parameters. (MD18092 $MN_MM_NUM_CC_MAGLOC_PARAM) - Or reduce the number of magazine locations in the stated magazine. ($TC_MAP6[magNo], $TC_MAP7[magNo]) The product of the 3 stated parameters must not exceed 32767.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal tool adapter operation (Cause: %3)
desc_en: Meaning of the error causes: 1: There is already another adapter on the intended magazine or multitool location. Note: If MD18104 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL_ADAPTER = -1 is set, each magazine location is assigned a type 1 adapter from the start. 2: There is already a tool on the intended magazine or multitool location. 3: The adapter cannot be removed from the location because there is still a tool on the location. 4: An attempt is being made to place a non-existent adapter at a magazine or multitool location. 5: The adapter cannot be deleted because it is still assigned to a location. 6: If $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL_ADAPTER = -1, all adapters or one adapter of type 1 cannot be deleted. 6: If $TC_ADPTT[n] = -1, a type 2 adapter cannot be deleted. 6: If $TC_ADPTT[0] = -1, no adapter can be deleted, if $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL_ADAPTER_TYPE2 > 0. 21: Grinding tools (type 4xx) and turning tools (type 5xx) are not allowed on a location with a new-type adapter (type 2): 22: An old-type tool adapter (type 1) cannot yet be assigned to a multitool location. 23: A new-type tool adapter (type 2) cannot yet be assigned to a magazine location. 24: If a multitool with an adapter is placed at a magazine location with an adapter, only a type 1 adapter may be on the magazine location with the default setting. (($TC_ADPT1[n]= 0.0, $TC_ADPT2[n]= 0.0, $TC_ADPT3[n]= 0.0, $TC_ADPTT[n]= 1) 25: Initially a type 2 adapter may only be placed on a multitool location with one location - Assign a maximum of one adapter to a magazine location. - If MD18104 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL_ADAPTER = -1, only write adapter data already associated with the magazine locations. - When assigning an adapter to a magazine location, the magazine location must not contain a tool. - When removing an adapter from a magazine location, the magazine location must not contain a tool. - Only place existing adapters at a magazine or multitool location. - Only type 1 adapters can be deleted with $TC_ADPTT[n] = -1. - All adapters with $TC_ADPTT[0] = -1 can only be deleted if $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL_ADAPTER_TYPE2=0. - Set only permitted tool types on a location with new type adapters (type 2). - Assign old-type tool adapters (type 1) only to a magazine location. - Assign new-type tool adapters (type 2) only to a multitool location. - Do not cascade an adapter to a magazine location and a multitool location. - Set up a multitool with only one magazine location for a type 2 adapter.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 call-by-reference: illegal variable
desc_en: Machine data and system variables must not be transferred as call-by-reference parameters. Modify NC program: Assign the value of the machine data or of the system variable to a program-local variable and transfer this as parameter.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 is not an indexing axis
desc_en: An indexing axis position has been programmed for an axis with the keywords CIC, CAC or CDC that has not been defined as indexing axis in the machine data. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Remove programming instruction for indexing axis positions (CIC, CAC, CDC) from the NC part program or declare the relevant axis to be an indexing axis. Indexing axis declaration: Modify MD30500: $MA_INDEX_AX_ASSIGN_POS_TAB (indexing axis assignment) The axis will become an indexing axis when an assignment to an indexing position table was made in the stated MD. 2 tables are possible (input value 1 or 2). Modify MD10900 $MN_INDEX_AX_LENGTH_POS_TAB_1 Modify MD10920 $MN_INDEX_AX_LENGTH_POS_TAB_2 (Number of positions for 1st/2nd indexing axis) Standard value: 0 Maximum value: 60 Modify MD10910 $MN_INDEX_AX_POS_TAB_1 [n] Modify MD10930 $MN_INDEX_AX_POS_TAB_2 [n] (Positions of the 1st indexing axis) The absolute axis positions are entered. (The list length is defined via MD10900 $MN_INDEX_AX_LENGTH_POS_TAB_1).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 indexing axis %3 with Hirth tooth system is active
desc_en: The 'Hirth tooth system' function is activated for the indexing axis. This axis can therefore approach only indexing positions. A different traverse of the axis is not possible. It is not permissible to program PRESETON or PRESETONS.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 indexing axis %3 with Hirth tooth system stop is delayed
desc_en: For the indexing axis, the 'Hirth tooth system' function is activated and the override has been set to 0 or another stop condition (e.g. VDI interface signal) is active. Since it is possible to stop only on indexing axes, the next possible indexing position is approached. The alarm is displayed until this position is reached or the stop condition is deactivated. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: Wait until the next possible indexing position is reached. Set the override > 0. Deactivate another stop condition.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 indexing axis %3 with Hirth tooth system and axis not referenced
desc_en: The "Hirth tooth system" function is activated for the indexing axis and the axis is to be traversed although it is not referenced. Reference the axis.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 indexing axis %4 is active with Hirth tooth system
desc_en: The 'Hirth tooth system' function is activated for the indexing axis. This axis can therefore approach only indexing positions, another travel movement of the axis is not possible. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Correct part program. Correct FC16 or FC18 call. Deselect machine data MD30505 $MA_HIRTH_IS_ACTIVE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 invalid index for indexing axis %3
desc_en: The programmed index for the indexing axis is beyond the position table range. Example: Perform an absolute approach of the 56th position in the list allocated via the axis-specific MD30500 $MA_INDEX_AX_ASSIGN_POS_TAB with the 1st positioning axis, the number of positions is e.g. only 40 (MD10900 $MN_INDEX_AX_LENGTH_POS_TAB_1 = 40). N100 G.. U=CAC (56) Or, with equidistant distances, the programmed index is smaller or equal 0. Or, an attempt is made with a MOV movement to travel to a position outside the permitted area. Program the indexing axis position in the NC part program in accordance with the length of the current position table, or add the required value to the position table and adjust the length of the list.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 preset on transformed axis %3 not possible
desc_en: The programmed preset key axis is involved in the current transformation. This means that setting the actual value memory (PRESET) is not possible for this axis (valid for PRESETON and PRESETONS). Example: Machine axis A should be set to the new actual value A 100 at the absolute position A 300. : N100 G90 G00 A=300 N101 PRESETON A=100 Avoid preset actual value memory for axes which are participating in a transformation or deselect the transformation with the keyword TRAFOOF.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 preset not possible on axis %4
desc_en: Actual value preset not possible for this axis because - the axis is moving - the axis is involved in a transformation - the axis is currently being monitored for collision - the spindle traverse movement has not yet been completed - reference point approach (G74) is active - the geometry axis is not in the 'neutral axis' state NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronized action: %3 preset not possible on axis %4 in JOGREF mode
desc_en: The actual value cannot be preset for this axis if the mode group to which this axis is assigned is in JOG mode and if the machine function reference point approach is also selected. Avoid setting actual value in this configuration or deselect the machine function reference point approach.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronized action: %3 preset is only possible on a stationary axis %4 in JOG mode
desc_en: In JOG mode, an actual value can only be preset on stationary axes. Avoid setting an actual value while the axis is in motion; wait until the axis is stationary.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronized action: %3 preset not possible on active oscillating axis (axis %4)
desc_en: An actual value cannot be preset on an active oscillating axis controlled via synchronized actions. Avoid setting actual value during active oscillating movement. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 involved in the transformation, action cannot be carried out
desc_en: The axis is involved in the active transformation. It can therefore not execute the demanded action, traversing as positioning axis, enable for axis exchange. Deselect the transformation with TRAFOOF ahead of time or remove the action from the part program block

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 approaching fixed point for transformed axis %3 not possible
desc_en: In the displayed block, an axis is programmed for the fixed point approach (G75) that is involved in the active transformation. Fixed point approach is not performed with this axis! Remove G75 instruction from the part program block or previously deselect transformation with TRAFOOF.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 referencing for transformed axis %3 not possible
desc_en: In the displayed block, an axis is programmed for reference point approach (G74) that is involved in the active transformation. Reference point approach is not performed with this axis! Remove G74 instruction, or the machine axes involved in transformation, from the part program block or previously deselect the transformation with TRAFOOF.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 spindle operation for transformed axis %3 not possible
desc_en: The axis programmed for the spindle operation is involved in the current transformation as geometry axis. This is not allowed. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 machine axis %3 not programmable
desc_en: The machine axis cannot be used in an active transformation. You may be able to program the function in a different coordinate system. For example, it may be possible to specify the retraction position in the basic coordinate system or the workpiece coordinate system. The axis identifier is used to select the coordinate system. Deactivate the transformation or use another coordinate system.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegally coded position programmed
desc_en: The position number n specified with the keyword FP=n is not permissible. Two (2) absolute axis positions can be directly defined as fixed points by the axis-specific machine data MD30600 $MA_FIX_POINT_POS[n]. Or, if position numbers 3 and/or 4 are to be used, then machine data MD30610 $MA_NUM_FIX_POINT_POS must be set accordingly. Program keyword FP with machine fixed points 1 or 2. Example: Approach fixed point 2 with machine axes X1 and Z2. N100 G75 FP=2 X1=0 Z2=0 Or modify MD30610 $MA_NUM_FIX_POINT_POS and, if necessary, MD30600 $MA_FIX_POINT_POS[].

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 not referenced
desc_en: A function has been activated for the axis in JOG mode, e.g. fixed-point approach, JOG to position, JOG in circles, but the axis has not been referenced. Reference axis.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Fixed-point approach not possible for axis %2 in JOG, reason %3
desc_en: A 'fixed-point approach in JOG' has been requested for an axis. This is not possible because: Reason 1: The axis is involved in the active transformation. Reason 2: The axis is a following axis in an active coupling. The fixed point approach will therefore not be executed. Deselect fixed-point approach in JOG, or previously deselect the transformation with TRAFOOF or disband the coupling.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 fixed-point approach in JOG: Fixed point %3 changed
desc_en: 'Fixed-point approach in JOG' is active for the axis, but another fixed point has been selected, or the fixed-point approach has been deactivated. The approach motion is canceled. Trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 fixed-point approach in JOG and override motion active
desc_en: 'Fixed-point approach in JOG' is active for the axis, but another offset motion - for example a synchronization offset $AA_OFF - has been interpolated simultaneously. The position of the selected fixed-point is not reached if offset values are changed during the traversing motion. The target point then becomes "fixed-point position + change in offset value". The end point will be reached if the traversing motion is restarted after the offset value has been changed. (For example: incremental traversing in which the traversing motion stops intermittently). Reason: Restarting the motion takes the current offset value into account. Trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 fixed-point position not available
desc_en: No fixed-point position is available for the fixed point selected in JOG mode. See MD30610 $MA_NUM_FIX_POINT_POS.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Indexing axis %1 fixed point %2 unequal indexing position
desc_en: The axis is a referenced indexing axis, and the fixed-point number %2 to be approached in JOG mode (defined in MD30600 $MA_FIX_POINT_POS) does not coincide with an indexing position. In JOG mode, referenced indexing axes approach indexing positions. MD30600 $MA_FIX_POINT_POS[] or adapt the indexing positions.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 JOG to position and override motion active
desc_en: 'JOG to position' is active for the axis, but an offset motion - for example a synchronization offset $AA_OFF - has been interpolated simultaneously. The position of the SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION is not reached if offset values are changed during the traversing motion. The target point then becomes "Jog position + change in offset value". The position SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION will be reached if the traversing motion is restarted after the offset value has been changed. (For example: incremental traversing in which the traversing motion stops intermittently). Reason: Restarting the motion takes the current offset value into account. Trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 JOG to position: Position changed
desc_en: An axis motion is active for the axis with 'JOG to position' but the position, that is the content of SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION, has been changed. The approach motion is canceled. Trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 JOG to position deactivated

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Indexing axis %1 $SA_JOG_POSITION unequal indexing position
desc_en: The axis is a referenced indexing axis and 'JOG to position' is activated in JOG mode, but SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION does not coincide with an indexing position. In JOG mode, referenced indexing axes approach indexing positions. Modify SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION or indexing positions.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] JOG in a circle is activated, but the axis %2 required for this is not a geometry axis.
desc_en: The function JOG in circles has been activated, but the axis required for this has not been defined as a geometry axis. Define axis as geometry axis.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] JOG a circle is not possible, reason %2
desc_en: The JOG in circles function was activated, but this is not possible because: 1. The current positions of the axes involved lie outside the selected pitch circle. 2. The current positions of the axes involved, with pitch circle selected and tool radius offset active, are too near to the center of the circle. 3. The current positions of the axes involved, with tool radius offset active, are too near to the limiting circle during internal machining. 4. The current positions of the axes involved, with tool radius offset active, are too near to the limiting circle during external machining. 5. The current positions of the axes involved in internal machining are outside the defined circle. 6. The current positions of the axes involved in external machining are inside the defined circle. 10. A rotation is acting on the current plane, that is the current plane is inclined in space. This is not currently supported. 20. JOG Retract is active. This mode is not supported. Define axis as geometry axis.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] JOG a circle is active and JOG circles deactivated
desc_en: A circular motion is active but 'JOG in circles' has been deactivated. The circular motion is canceled. Reactivate 'JOG circles' and trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 axis %4 is not a machine axis
desc_en: At this point, the block context calls for a machine axis. This is the case with: - G74 (reference point approach) - G75 (fixed point approach) - PRESETON/PRESETONS on GANTRY synchronous axis If a geometry or special axis identifier is used, then it must also be permitted as machine axis identifier (MD10000 $MN_AXCONF_MACHAX_NAME_TAB Use machine axis identifier when programming.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 NCK-specific protection area %3 wrong. Error code %4
desc_en: There is an error in the definition of the protection area. The error number gives the specific reason for the alarm: No. Meaning 1: Incomplete or conflicting contour definition. 2: Contour encompasses more than one surface area. 3: Tool-related protection area is not convex. 4: If both boundaries are active in the 3rd dimension of the protection area and both limits have the same value. 5: The number of the protection area does not exist (negative number, zero or greater than the maximum number of protection areas). 6: Protection area definition consists of more than 10 contour elements. 7: Tool-related protection area is defined as inside protection area. 8: Incorrect parameter used. 9: Protection area to be activated is not defined. 10: Incorrect modal G code used for protection area definition. 11: Contour definition incorrect or frame activated. 12: Other, not further specified errors. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 channel-specific protection area %3 incorrect. Error code %4
desc_en: There is an error in the definition of the protection area. The error number gives the specific reason for the alarm. No. Meaning 1: Incomplete or conflicting contour definition. 2: Contour encompasses more than one surface area. 3: Tool-related protection area is not convex. 4: If both boundaries are active in the 3rd dimension of the protection area and both limits have the same value. 5: The number of the protection area does not exist (negative number, zero or greater than the maximum number of protection areas). 6: Protection area definition consists of more than 10 contour elements. 7: Tool-related protection area is defined as inside protection area. 8: Incorrect parameter used. 9: Protection area to be activated is not defined. 10: Incorrect modal G code used for protection area definition. 11: Contour definition incorrect or frame activated. 12: Other, not further specified errors. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Modify definition of the protection area and check MD.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 NCK protection area %3 cannot be activated. Error code %4

message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 orientation of workpiece-related protection area %3 does not correspond to the orientation of tool-related protection area %4
desc_en: The orientation of the workpiece-related protection area and the orientation of the tool-related protection area differ. If the protection area number is negative, then this is an NCK protection area. - Modify the protection area definition or do not simultaneously activate protection areas that have different orientations. - Check machine data and modify the protection area definition if necessary. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
