desc_en: The protection area definition must be terminated with EXECUTE before a preprocessing stop is performed. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 serious error in definition of channel-specific protection area %3
desc_en: The protection area definition must be terminated with EXECUTE before a preprocessing stop is performed. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 invalid value assigned to FXS[]
desc_en: The following values are valid at the present time: 0: "Deselect traverse against fixed stop" 1: "Select traverse against fixed stop" valid. Check the use of permissible values of the program command FXS, and correct the assignment.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 invalid value assigned to FXST[]
desc_en: Only the range 0.0 - 100.0 is valid at the present time. Check the use of permissible values of the program command FXST, and correct the assignment. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 invalid value assigned to FXSW[]
desc_en: Only positive values including zero are valid at the present time. Check the use of permissible values of the program command FXSW, and correct the assignment.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 curve table %4 does not exist
desc_en: An attempt was made to use a curve table whose table number is not known in the system \par. Change the table number in the program instruction or define the curve table with the desired table number.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 frame: fine shift not possible
desc_en: Allocation of a fine shift to settable frames or the basic frame is not possible since MD18600 $MN_MM_FRAME_FINE_TRANS is not equal to 1. Inform the authorized personnel/service department. Modify the program or set MD18600 $MN_MM_FRAME_FINE_TRANS to 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 frame: illegal rotation
desc_en: Rotations are not possible with NCU global frames. Modify part program. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 frame: illegal instruction
desc_en: An attempt was made to read or write a frame which does not exist. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 frame: fine shift not configured
desc_en: Fine shift must be configurd with G58 and G59. Modify machine data.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 frame: illegal switchover of geometry axes
desc_en: It is not allowed to change the geometry axis assignment because the current frame contains rotations. Change NC program or set other mode with MD10602 $MN_FRAME_GEOAX_CHANGE_MODE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 frame: type conflict
desc_en: It is not possible to chain global frames and channel-specific frames. The alarm occurs if a global frame is programmed with a channel axis name and no machine axis on this NCU is assigned to the channel axis. Channel-specific frames cannot be programmed with machine axis names if there is no corresponding channel axis on this NCU. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 reference cam not reached
desc_en: After starting the reference point approach, the rising edge of the reduction cam must be reached within the section defined in the MD34030 $MA_REFP_MAX_CAM_DIST (phase 1 of referencing). (This error occurs only with incremental encoders). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. There are 3 possible causes of error: 1. The value entered in MD34030 $MA_REFP_MAX_CAM_DIST is too small. Determine the maximum possible distance from the beginning of reference motion up to the reduction cam and compare with the value in MD34030 $MA_REFP_MAX_CAM_DIST, increase the value in the MD if necessary. 2. The cam signal is not received by the PLC input module. Operate the reference point switch manually and check the input signal on the NC/PLC interface (route: Switch! Connector! Cable! PLC input! User program). 3. The reference point switch is not operated by the cam. Check the vertical distance between reduction cam and activating switch.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 no cam signal present
desc_en: At the beginning of phase 2 of reference point approach, the signal from the reduction cam is no longer available. Phase 2 of reference point approach begins when the axis remains stationary after deceleration to the reduction cam. The axis then starts in the opposite direction in order to select the next zero marker of the measuring system on leaving the reduction cam or approaching it again (negative/positive edge). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check whether the deceleration path after the approach velocity is greater than the distance to the reference point cam - in which case the axis cannot stop until it is beyond the cam. Use a longer cam or reduce the approach velocity in MD34020 $MA_REFP_VELO_SEARCH_CAM. When the axis has stopped at the cam, it must be checked whether the signal DB380x DBX1000.7 (Deceleration reference point approach) is still available at the interface to the NCK. - Hardware: Wire break? Short circuit? - Software: User program?

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 zero marker not found
desc_en: The hardware zero marker of the incremental position encoder or the substitute zero mark of the absolute position encoder is not within a defined section. Phase 2 of the reference point approach ends when the zero marker of the encoder has been detected after the rising/falling edge of the NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX1000.7 (Deceleration reference point approach) has given the trigger start. The maximum distance between the trigger start and the zero marker that follows is defined in the MD34060 $MA_REFP_MAX_MARKER_DIST. The monitor prevents a zero marker signal from being overtraveled and the next being evaluated as reference point signal. (Faulty cam adjustment or excessive delay by the PLC user program). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check the cam adjustment and make sure that the distance is sufficient between the end of the cam and the zero marker signal that follows. The path must be greater than the axis can cover in the PLC cycle time. Increase the MD34060 $MA_REFP_MAX_MARKER_DIST, but do not select a value greater than the distance between the 2 zero markers. This might result in the monitor being switched off.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 measuring system error
desc_en: In a measuring system with distance-coded reference marks, the distance between two adjacent markers has been found to be more than twice the value entered in MD34300 $MA_ENC_REFP_MARKER_DIST. The control does not issue the alarm until it has again detected a distance that is too long after having made a 2nd attempt in reverse direction with half the traversing velocity. Determine the distance between 2 odd reference marks (reference mark interval). This value (which is 20.00 mm on Heidenhain scales) must be entered in MD34060 $MA_REFP_MAX_MARKER_DIST. Check the reference track of the scale including the electronics for the evaluation.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 reference mark missing
desc_en: In the distance-coded length measurement system, 2 reference marks were not found within the defined searching distance (axis-specific MD34060 $MA_REFP_MAX_MARKER_DIST). A reduction cam is not required for distance-coded scales (but an existing cam will be evaluated). The conventional direction key determines the direction of search. The searching distance MD34060 $MA_REFP_MAX_MARKER_DIST, within which the two reference marks are expected is counted commencing at the start point.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 reference point approach canceled
desc_en: Referencing could not be completed for all stated axes (e.g., cancelation caused by missing servo enable, measuring system switchover, release of direction key, etc.). In distance-coded measuring systems, the alarm will also be displayed if the value 1 has been set in MD34000 $MA_REFP_CAM_IS_ACTIV (reference cams) and one of the conditions stated in the remedy has been fulfilled. Please inform the authorized service personnel. Check the possible reasons for termination: - Servo enable missing: NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX2.1 (Servo enable) - Measuring system switchover: NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX1.5 / 1.6 (Position measuring system 1/2) - Traversing key + or - missing: NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX4.7 / 4.6 (Traversing keys plus/minus) - Feed override = 0 - The feed disable is active - Exact stop not reached within MD36020 $MA_POSITIONING_TIME. - Drive-side error messages, e.g. reference mark signal, not received The axis-specific MD34110 $MA_REFP_CYCLE_NR determines which axes are involved in the channel-specific referencing. Value Meaning -1: No channel-specific referencing, NC Start without referencing. 0: No channel-specific referencing, NC Start with referencing. 1-8: Channel-specific referencing. The number entered here corresponds to the referencing sequence. (When all axes with contents 1 have reached the reference point, then the axes with contents 2 start, etc.).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 reference point shutdown velocity not reached
desc_en: In phase 2 of reference point approach (wait for zero mark), the cam end was reached but the reference point approach velocity was not within the tolerance window. (This can occur when the axis is already at the end of the cam at the beginning of reference point approach. Phase 1 is therefore considered as being already concluded and will not be started.) Phase 2 has been interrupted (this time before the cam) and the reference point approach will be started once again automatically with phase 1. If the approach velocity is not reached at the 2nd attempt either, referencing will be stopped and the alarm displayed. Approach velocity: MD34040 $MA_REFP_VELO_SEARCH_MARKER Velocity tolerance: MD35150 $MA_SPIND_DES_VELO_TOL. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Reduce the MD for the approach velocity MD34040 $MA_REFP_VELO_SEARCH_MARKER and/or increase the MD for the velocity tolerance MD35150 $MA_SPIND_DES_VELO_TOL. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 reference point approach requires 2 measuring systems
desc_en: 2 encoders are needed for setting MD34200 $MA_ENC_REFP_MODE = 6! Inform the authorized personnel/service department. Modify the referencing mode for MD34200 $MA_ENC_REFP_MODE or install and configure a second encoder.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 reference point approach requires second referenced measuring system
desc_en: When setting MD34200 $MA_ENC_REFP_MODE = 6 the 2nd encoder must first be referenced. Change the referencing mode in MD34200 $MA_ENC_REFP_MODE or reference the 2nd encoder.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 handwheel mode active
desc_en: The axes cannot be traversed in JOG mode using the traversing keys because traversing is still taking place via the handwheel. Decide whether the axis is to be traversed by means of the direction keys or the handwheel. End handwheel travel and delete the axial distance-to-go if necessary (NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX2.2 (Delete distance-to-go/Spindle reset)).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 handwheel mode not possible
desc_en: The axis is already traveling via the traversing keys, so handwheel mode is no longer possible. Decide whether the axis is to be traversed by means of the jog keys or via the handwheel.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 already active
desc_en: The axis is to traverse as a machine axis in JOG mode using the direction keys on the machine control panel. However, this is not possible because: 1. It is already traversing as a geometry axis (through the channel-specific interface DB3200 DBX1000.7 / 0.6 (Traversing keys -/+) or DB3200 DBX1004.7 / 4.6 (Traversing keys -/+) or DB3200 DBX1008.7 / 8.6 (Traversing keys -/+)) or 2. It is already traversing as a machine axis (through the axis-specific interface DB380x DBX4.7 / 4.6 (Traversing keys plus/ minus)) or 3. A frame is valid for a rotated coordinate system, and another geometry axis involved in this is already traversing in JOG mode by means of the direction keys. 4. As part of a retraction motion (submode JOG-Retract) it cannot be traversed as a machine axis. Stop traversing through the channel or axis interface or stop the other geometry axis.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 DRF, $AA_OFF, FTOCON, external zero point offset not possible
desc_en: The axis is traversed in a mode (e.g. referencing) that allows no additional overlaid interpolation. Wait until the axis has reached its reference position or terminate reference point approach with "Reset" and start DRF once again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 wrong index for indexing axis in JOG mode
desc_en: 1. The displayed indexing axis is to be traversed incrementally in JOG mode (by 1 indexing position). However, no further indexing position is available in the selected direction. 2. The axis is stationary at the last indexing position. In incremental traversing the working area limitation or the software limit switch is reached without an indexing position being located in front of it at which a stop could be made. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Correct (add to) the list of indexing positions by means of the machine data MD10900 $MN_INDEX_AX_LENGTH_POS_TAB_1 MD10910 $MN_INDEX_AX_POS_TAB_1 MD10920 $MN_INDEX_AX_LENGTH_POS_TAB_2 MD10930 $MN_INDEX_AX_POS_TAB_2 or set the working area limits or the software limit switches to other values.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Master spindle not present in JOG mode
desc_en: The displayed axis is to be traversed as machine axis in JOG mode with revolutional feed, but no master spindle has been defined from which the actual speed could have been derived.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 no revolutional feedrate possible. Axis/spindle %3 stationary
desc_en: An axis is to traverse in JOG with revolutional feedrate. However, the feedrate of the spindle/axis from which the feedrate is to be derived is 0. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: - Traverse the spindle/axis from which the feedrate is to be derived. - Deselect revolutional feedrate G95 in JOG via the Settings screenform. - Deselect revolutional feedrate G95 in setting data SD41100 $SN_JOG_REV_IS_ACTIVE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 revolutional feedrate for axis/spindle %3 is <= zero
desc_en: Revolutional feed has been programmed for an axis/spindle, but the velocity was not programmed or the programmed value is smaller than or equal to zero. Inform the authorized personnel/service department. You have the following possibilities of canceling the alarm; - Correct the part program - Specify a correct feedrate for PLC axes at the VDI interface, - Specify a feedrate for oscillating axes in SD43740 $SA_OSCILL_VELO.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 revolutional feedrate: illegal feed source
desc_en: An axis/spindle is to be traversed at revolutional feedrate. The reference axis/spindle defined in SD 43300 $SA_ASSIGN_FEED_PER_REV_SOURCE refers to itself. The coupling caused cannot be executed. The reference axis/spindle must be modified accordingly in SD 43300. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 already active due to %3
desc_en: The axis (machine axis, geometry axis or orientation axis) is to be traversed in operation mode "Automatic&Jog" (see MD10735 $MN_JOG_MODE_MASK) by using the direction keys or a handwheel. This is not possible, as (see parameter 3): 1. the axis is active as a rotating spindle 2. the axis is a PLC axis 3. the axis is active as an asynchronous reciprocating axis 4. the axis is active as a command axis 5. the axis is active as a slave axis 6. a frame applies for a rotated coordinate system and an axis involved in the required JOG movement of the geometry axis is not available for this 7. an axis container rotation is activated via NCU link Note: This alarm identifies an axis not capable of JOG which received a JOG order. In this case, the NCK will not proceed according to "Internal JOG". Wait for the axis to traverse or cancel with distance-to-go delete or RESET.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 cannot be traversed as geometry axis
desc_en: The axis is currently not in "Geometry axis" state. Therefore, it cannot be traversed in JOG mode as geometry axis. If the word Work (WCS = workpiece coordinate system) is displayed in the "Position" screen, only the geometry axes can be traversed by means of the direction keys! (MCS ... Machine coordinate system; all machine axes can now be traversed by using the direction keys on the machine control panel). Check the operating steps to establish whether geometry axes really must be traversed, otherwise switch over to the machine axes by activating the "Work/Machine" key on the machine control panel.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 already active
desc_en: The displayed axis is already traversing as a machine axis. Therefore, it cannot be operated as a geometry axis. Traversing an axis can take place in JOG mode through 2 different interfaces. 1. As a geometry axis: via the channel-specific interface DB3200 DBX1000.7 / 0.6 (Traversing keys -/+) 2. As a machine axis: via the axis-specific interface DB380x DBX4.7 / 4.6 (Traversing keys plus/minus) With the standard machine control panel, it is not possible to operate an axis as a machine axis and as a geometry axis at the same time. Do not start the geometry axis until the traversing motion as machine axis has been concluded.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 selection of several axes with an active taper angle is not permitted.
desc_en: With an active taper angle, only one geometry axis at the time can be traversed in JOG mode by pressing traversing keys. Simultaneous traversing of a geometry axis as a machine axis is not permitted either. Starting the geometry axis only if traversing of the other geometry axis or machine axis completed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Master spindle not defined for geometry axes in JOG mode
desc_en: The displayed axis is to be traversed as geometry axis in JOG mode with rotary feed, but no master spindle has been defined from which the actual speed could be derived. If the revolutional feedrate is to be active in JOG mode too, then a master spindle must be declared in the channel-specific machine data MD20090 $MC_SPIND_DEF_MASTER_SPIND. In this case, you have to open a screen in the PARAMETER operating area with the softkeys "SETTINGDATA" and "JOG DATA", and preselect the G function G95 there. The JOG feedrate can then be entered in [mm/rev]. (If 0 mm/rev is set as JOG feedrate, the control takes the value assigned in the axis-specific machine data MD32050 $MA_JOG_REV_VELO or in the case of rapid traverse override MD32040 $MA_JOG_REV_VELO_RAPID). The revolutional feedrate in JOG mode is deactivated by changing the G function from G95 to G94.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 software limit switch %3 programmed end position %4
desc_en: The axis is to be traversed by the PLC as a concurrent positioning axis to the limit position. This would violate the corresponding software limit switch for the axis. No traversing takes place. With an additional message to alarm 20140, the axis is to be traversed as a command axis. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Specify smaller target position. Modify MD for SW limit switch. Possibly activate another SW limit switch. Retract axis via JOG.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 working area limit %3 end position %4
desc_en: The displayed axis is to be traversed as a "concurrent positioning axis" to the programmed limit position and the corresponding working area limitation active for the axis is violated. No traversing takes place. With an additional message to alarm 20140, the axis is traversed as a command axis. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 is not an indexing axis
desc_en: The displayed axis is operated as a concurrent positioning axis. Its target position is parameterized in the FC INDEX-AXIS as indexing position number, but the axis is not an indexing axis. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. The FC POS-AXIS for linear and rotary axes should be used or the axis should be declared as an indexing axis. Corresponding machine data for indexing axis declaration: Modify MD30500 $MA_INDEX_AX_ASSIGN_POS_TAB Modify MD10900 $MN_INDEX_AX_LENGTH_POS_TAB_1 Modify MD10910 $MN_INDEX_AX_POS_TAB_1 Modify MD10920 $MN_INDEX_AX_LENGTH_POS_TAB_2 Modify MD10930 $MN_INDEX_AX_POS_TAB_2

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 cannot be repositioned
desc_en: The concurrent positioning axis cannot be positioned because it has already been restarted via the VDI interface and is still active. No repositioning motion takes place and the motion initiated by the VDI interface is not affected. None.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 can currently not oscillate
desc_en: The axis cannot perform an oscillating movement now because it is already being traversed, e.g. in JOG mode. End the other traversing motion.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 oscillating - mode change not possible
desc_en: The axis is performing an oscillating movement. Mode change is not possible because oscillation is not allowed in the selected mode. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 programmed position %4 is behind software limit switch %3
desc_en: The axis is traversed as an oscillating axis and the target position (reversal position or end position) is located behind the corresponding software limit switch. The axis is not traversed. Specify smaller target position. Modify MD for SW limit switch. Possibly activate another SW limit switch.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 programmed position %4 is behind working area limit %3
desc_en: The axis is traversed as an oscillating axis and the target position (reversal position or end position) is located behind the corresponding effective working area limitation. The axis is not traversed. Specify smaller target position. Deactivate working area limitation. Set working area limitation differentially.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 oscillation path %3 <= 0
desc_en: The axis is traversed as an oscillating axis and the distance to be traversed is smaller than or equal to zero. For example, both reversal points are situated on an identical position, one reversal point was shifted against the oscillating direction beyond the other reversal point. The axis is not traversed. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 no handwheel assigned for override
desc_en: No handwheel has been assigned for this specified axis after handwheel overlay has been started in automatic mode. If the axis identifier is missing in the alarm with active velocity overlay FD > 0, then the 1st geometry axis has not been defined in the NC channel. In this case the block is executed without handwheel control. If handwheel control is required, a handwheel must be activated.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 coordinate system-specific working area limit %3 end position %4
desc_en: The displayed axis is operated as a "concurrent positioning axis", and the corresponding active coordinate system-specific working area limitation for the axis is violated. No traversing movement. With an additional message to alarm 20140, the axis is traversed as a command axis. - Specify smaller target position. - Deactivate working area limitation. - Set working area limitation differently. - Retract axis with JOG.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 programmed position %4 lies behind the coordinate system-specific working area limit %3
desc_en: The axis is traversed as a reciprocating axis, and the target position (reversal position or end position) is located behind the corresponding, valid, coordinate system-specific working area limitation. The axis is not traversed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Contour handwheel: traverse direction or overtravel of beginning of block not allowed
desc_en: Travel takes place on the path with the contour handwheel in the opposite direction to the programmed travel direction and the starting point of the path has been reached at the start of the block. Turn the contour handwheel in the opposite direction.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 Geometry axis limitation %3 End position %4
desc_en: The displayed axis is to be traversed as a "concurrent positioning axis" to the programmed end position and the corresponding geometry axis limitation active for the axis is violated. No traversing takes place. With an additional message for alarm 20140, the axis is traversed as a command axis. - Specify smaller target position. - Retract axis with JOG.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 Programmed position %4 lies behind geometry axis limitation %3
desc_en: The axis is traversed as an oscillating axis and the target position (reversal position or end position) is located behind the corresponding effective geometry axis limitation. The axis is not traversed. Specify smaller target position.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 travel to fixed stop not possible. Check programming and axis data.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 has not reached fixed stop
desc_en: On attempting to traverse against a fixed stop, the programmed end position has been reached or the traversing movement has been canceled. The alarm can be concealed by means of the MD37050 $MA_FIXED_STOP_ALARM_MASK. The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Correct the part program and the settings: - Has the traversing block been canceled? - If the axis position does not correspond to the programmed end position, then correct the end position. - If the programmed end position is in the part, the triggering criterion must be checked. - Has the contour deviation leading to triggering been dimensioned too large? Has the torque limit been set too high?

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 travel to fixed stop still active
desc_en: An attempt has been made to move an axis while it is in fixed stop or while the deselection function has not yet been completed. The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 standstill monitoring at fixed-stop end point has been triggered
desc_en: The position of the axis has been beyond the zero speed window ever since selection has been completed. The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. - Check the mechanical components, e.g. has the stop broken away? Has the part to be clamped given way? - Position window for zero speed control too small (MD37020 $MA_FIXED_STOP_WINDOW_DEF) (SD43520 $SA_FIXED_STOP_WINDOW). Default is 1 mm in each case.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 function has been canceled
desc_en: The function has been canceled. The possible reasons for this are: - The torque can no longer be provided because a pulse disable has occurred, . - The PLC has removed the acknowledgments. The system variable $VA_FXS_INFO contains additional information regarding why the function was canceled. The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Check whether - there is a pulse disable from the infeed/regenerative-feedback unit or from the PLC? - the acknowledgment bits have been deleted by the PLC even though NCK has not requested deselection? Read out the system variable $VA_FXS_INFO, and then interpret the additional information.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1: too many compensation relations

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1: Configuration error in compensation table %2
desc_en: Interpolatory compensation with tables. The settings for the specified table are not allowed. $AN_CEC_MAX >= $AN_CEC_MIN and $AN_CEC_STEP != 0 apply to system variables. This table is switched off automatically. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check and correct the characteristic data in the compensation table. If the error cannot be found, the alarm can be suppressed by switching off the table ($SN_CEC_TABLE_ENABLE) or switching off compensation in the axis ($MA_CEC_ENABLE).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Compensation table %1: invalid axis assignment
desc_en: Interpolatory compensation with tables. Assignment of the input or output axes in the given table is not allowed. $AN_CEC_INPUT_AXIS and $AN_CEC_OUTPUT_AXIS != 0 apply to system variables, and both must refer to valid axes. This table is automatically switched off. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check and correct the axis assignment in the compensation table. If the error cannot be found, the alarm can be suppressed by switching off the table ($SN_CEC_TABLE_ENABLE) or switching off compensation in the axis ($MA_CEC_ENABLE).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1: different output assignment of multiplied tables
desc_en: Interpolatory compensation with tables. The two tables whose outputs are to be multiplied together have different output axes assigned to them. The compensation in this axis is automatically switched off. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check and correct the characteristic data in the compensation table ($AN_CEC_OUTPUT_AXIS and $AN_CEC_MULT_BY_TABLE). If the error cannot be found, the alarm can be suppressed by switching off the compensation in the axis ($MA_CEC_ENABLE) or the tables, ($SN_CEC_TABLE_ENABLE).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1: sum of compensation values too large
desc_en: The sum of the compensation values from all tables assigned to the axis had exceeded the limit value MD32720 $MA_CEC_MAX_SUM and had to be limited. Contour errors could have occurred as a result. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1: change of compensation value is too rapid
desc_en: The compensation value has changed more rapidly than has been allowed for in MD32730 $MA_CEC_MAX_VELO. It had to be limited temporarily. The missing section is repeated later but contour errors might have occurred. Check characteristic data of the compensation tables assigned to the axis. Check characteristic curves in the tables ($AN_CEC). Possibly one of the input axes has moved more rapidly than provided for.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Contour tunnel monitoring
desc_en: The tool tip has exited the tunnel placed around the desired contour, i.e. the distance between tool tip and desired contour was greater than specified in the MD21050 $MC_CONTOUR_TUNNEL_TOL. The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check the following points in turn: 1. Is the machine in working order? That is, has the alarm been tripped by a sluggish axis, tool breakage or collision? 2. If the machine is in working order, reduce the velocity or improve the controller setting. 3. Possibly increase the size of the tunnel and monitor errors via analog output in order to ascertain the cause.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action %3 command axis %4 cannot be traversed

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 invalid marker
desc_en: Setting or deleting of a marker in the motion-synchronous action is not possible. Possible causes: SETM(): Maximum number of markers exceeded; marker has already been set. CLEARM(): Specified marker is not within permissible value range. SETM(): use marker in valid value range; do not set the marker again. CLEARM(): use marker in valid value range.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Traversing of command axis %2 see NC alarm %3 parameter %4
desc_en: An NC alarm was detected for a command axis, which is to be traversed from a synchronized action. This alarm is output in the 3rd parameter as an HMI alarm number. Parameter 4 may provide additional information. See help information for the additional alarms.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 axis %4 has illegal axis type
desc_en: The requested command is not permissible in the current axis status for the command axis or spindle. This alarm occurs with command axes (POS, MOV), spindle commands from motion synchronous actions (M3/M4/M5, SPOS), coupled motion (TRAILON, TRAILOF) and lead value coupling (LEADON, LEADOF). First stop the axis or deactivate the coupling, then select a new status.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 command axis %4 cannot be started as it is controlled by the PLC
desc_en: An attempt has been made to start a command axis by means of a block-related or modal synchronous action. This start is not possible as the axis is controlled by the PLC. End control of the axis by the PLC and therefore return it to the channel or start the command axis with a static synchronous action.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 system variable cannot be accessed
desc_en: When using system variables, it is assumed that a read/write operation can access the required data successfully. In accesses to encoder actual values or digital I/Os, the result depends on the availability of the corresponding hardware components. If an access within synchronized actions does not return a valid value, alarm 20144 is output. Outside synchronized actions, such a read/write access causes block execution to be interrupted until the result is available. Block execution is subsequently continued. Before reading/writing system variables, ensure that it is possible to access, for example, the required hardware components.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 arithmetic error

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 nesting depth exceeded
desc_en: For calculating arithmetic expressions in motion synchronous blocks, an operand stack with a fixed set size is used. With very complex expressions, this stack can overflow. Correct the incorrect expression.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 command %4 not executable
desc_en: One of the commands in the synchronized action block cannot be executed, e.g. it is not possible to perform a Reset for the specific synchronized action. Measurement level 2 - Embargo version does not allow measurement from a synchronized action - The MEASA command was programmed in a synchronized action - Measurement is already active - Programming error (see alarm 21701) Change the synchronized action. Measurement level 2 Execute the measurement task from a part program first, in order to improve the error diagnostics. Do not include the measurement in the synchronized action until the first error-free run has been performed .

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 internal error %4

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion-synchronous action: %3 Index %4 is illegal
desc_en: 1.: Slot / I/O area index >= max. number of available slots / I/O areas. 2.: Slot / I/O area index references a slot / I/O area that has not been configured. 3.: Slot / I/O area index references a slot / I/O area that has not been released for system variables. Reaction: NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. NC Stop on alarm. Use a valid index.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Tool management: PLC terminates interrupted command
desc_en: Indication that the PLC has terminated an interrupted command (with alarm output) from the tool management - tool change. This alarm is for information only.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Tool management: PLC can terminate only incorrectly canceled commands
desc_en: Note that the PLC wanted to interrupt an active command from the tool management (tool change), or that there is no active command to cancel. The NCK rejects for the following reasons: - Channel status is "active". Cancel is not allowed, - Channel status is "reset". Nothing can be canceled.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Machine data $AC_FIFO invalid
desc_en: The structure of the FIFO variable $AC_FIFO1 - $AC_FIFO10 specified by the machine data MD28260 $MC_NUM_AC_FIFO, MD28262 $MC_START_AC_FIFO, MD28264 $MC_LEN_AC_FIFO and MD28266 $MC_MODE_AC_FIFO cannot be stored in the R parameter field defined in MD28050 $MC_MM_NUM_R_PARAM. Inform the authorized personnel/service department. Increase the number of R-parameters or reduce the number of FIFO elements. Set the MD as follows: MD28050 $MC_MM_NUM_R_PARAM = MD28262 $MC_START_AC_FIFO + MD28260 $MC_NUM_AC_FIFO * (MD28264 $MC_LEN_AC_FIFO + 6)

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1: Too many MEC compensation relations
desc_en: Multi Error Compensation: The maximum number of possible compensation relations of the axis has been exceeded. With this alarm, the interpolatory compensation in the axis is automatically switched off. Check table parameters $AN_MEC_OUTPUT_AXIS and correct and/or switch off one or more tables (SD41360 $SN_MEC_TABLE_ENABLE).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1: Configuration error in MEC compensation table %2
desc_en: Multi Error Compensation: The settings of the specified table are not permissible. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check and correct the characteristic data in the compensation table. If the error cannot be found, the alarm can be suppressed by switching off the table (SD41360 $SN_MEC_TABLE_ENABLE) or switching off compensation in the axis (MD32770 $MA_MEC_ENABLE).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: MEC compensation table %1: Invalid axis assignment
desc_en: Multi Error Compensation: The assignment of the input or output axes of the specified table is impermissible. For system variables, $AN_MEC_INPUT_AXIS and $AN_MEC_OUTPUT_AXIS != 0 apply, and both must refer to valid axes. This table is automatically switched off. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check and correct the axis assignment of the compensation table. If the error cannot be found, the alarm can be suppressed; to do this, switch off the table (SD41360 $SN_MEC_TABLE_ENABLE) or switch off compensation in the axis (MD32770 $MA_MEC_ENABLE). NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1: Sum of MEC compensation values too large
desc_en: Multi Error Compensation: The sum of the compensation values from all tables assigned to the axis has exceeded the limit value MD32720 $MA_MEC_MAX_SUM and had to be limited. This may have caused contour errors. Check characteristic data of the compensation tables assigned to the axis. Check characteristic curves in the tables ($AN_MEC_VALUE).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1: Change of MEC compensation is too rapid
desc_en: Multi Error Compensation: The compensation value changed faster than permitted in MD32730 $MA_MEC_MAX_VELO. It had to be limited temporarily. The missing distance is made up, but contour errors may have occurred. Check characteristic data of the compensation tables assigned to the axis. Check characteristic curves in the tables ($AN_MEC_VALUE). Possibly one of the input axes has moved more rapidly than provided for.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Input variable %1: Invalid variable name in MEC compensation table %2
desc_en: Multi Error Compensation: The variable name of the input variable is incorrect or not permissible. The permissible variables can be found in the documentation. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check and correct the characteristic data in the compensation table. If the error cannot be found, the alarm can be suppressed by switching off the table (SD41360 $SN_MEC_TABLE_ENABLE) or switching off compensation in the axis (MD32770 $MA_MEC_ENABLE).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Input index %1 assigned multiple times in MEC compensation table %2.
desc_en: Multi Error Compensation: $AN_MEC_INPUT_AXIS and $AN_MEC_INPUT_VAR both define an input variable for the same input index. This double assignment is not permitted. Either reset the corresponding axis assignment in $AN_MEC_INPUT_AXIS or the variable assignment in $AN_MEC_INPUT_VAR by setting the corresponding default value.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Invalid spindle number %2 with tool fine compensation
desc_en: There is no spindle/axis assignment in the target channel for the spindle specified in the PUTFTOC command. Modify program in channel that writes the tool fine compensation.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Spindle %2 no tool assigned
desc_en: In order to make allowance for the fine tool compensation for the tool currently in the spindle, a spindle/tool assignment must be active. This is not presently the case for the programmed spindle in the target channel of fine tool compensation. 1. Modify the part program (write the tool fine compensation). 2. Establish spindle/tool assignment by programming: - TMON (tool monitoring) - GWPSON (tool selection)

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] No active tool
desc_en: A tool fine compensation has been written for the active tool of channel %1 with PUTFTOC. No tool is active in this channel. Therefore, the compensation cannot be assigned. Correct the program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] PUTFTOC command not allowed with FTOCOF
desc_en: A tool fine compensation has been written for channel %1 with PUTFTOC. The tool fine compensation is not active in this channel. FTOCON must be active in the target channel of the PUTFTOC command. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 invalid spindle number %4
desc_en: There is no spindle/axis assignment in the target channel for the specified spindle. Modify program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 cannot be traversed
desc_en: The displayed axis cannot be traversed as a machine axis because JOG Retract mode has been selected in JOG mode. Deselect JOG Retract with RESET

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 cannot be traversed as a geometry axis
desc_en: The displayed axis cannot be traversed as a geometry axis. The geometry axis is part of a retraction motion in JOG Retract mode. The requested motion of the geometry axis would lead to a violation of the permitted retraction direction. Deselect JOG Retract with RESET

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Cartesian manual traverse not possible
desc_en: Cartesian manual traverse is not possible in JOG Retract mode. Deselect JOG Retract with RESET

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Manual traverse in the SZS coodinate system is not possible
desc_en: Manual traverse in the SZS coodinate system is not possible in JOG Retract mode. Deselect JOG Retract with RESET

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 traverse to the specified position is not possible
desc_en: The displayed axis cannot be traversed to the entered position in JOG Retract mode. It is limited to the interrupt position when JOG Retract was selected. Traverse within the permitted positions

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 Travel from hardware limit switch not possible. Reason: %3
desc_en: It has been tried to retract a following axis of an axis coupling or an output axis of a transformation through the master axis or input axis of a transformation. This is not permitted in the current situation. Possible reasons: 1 No permissible direction of retraction 2 Coupling not synchronous 3 Retraction not permitted for the active coupling 4 Reserved 5 Retraction not permitted for the active transformation Remedy for error cause: 1 Define another travel direction 2 Deactivate the coupling and travel the axis/axes separately 3 Deactivate the coupling and travel the axis/axes separately 4 Reserved 5 Deactivate the transformation and travel the axis/axes separately

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Monitoring for ESR active
desc_en: - The display can be suppressed with MD 11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK Bit 16 = 1

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 encoder %3 frequency exceeded
desc_en: The maximum permissible frequency of the currently active encoder (axis-specific interface signal DB380x DBX1.5 / 1.6 (position measuring system 1/2)) in the axis-specific MD36300 $MA_ENC_FREQ_LIMIT [n] (n ... encoder number, 1 or 2) has been exceeded. The reference of the actual value to the mechanical slide position may have been lost. The alarm can be reprogrammed in MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Check MD36300 $MA_ENC_FREQ_LIMIT [n] and NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX1.5 / 1.6 (position measuring system 1/2).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] NC-controlled Extended Stop/Retract triggered
desc_en: "NC-controlled Extended Stop/Retract" triggered. Reset

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2: enable reset, cause %3

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 hardware limit switch %3
desc_en: The signal DB380x DBX1000.1 und .0 (Hardware limit switch plus/minus) has been set at the NC/PLC interface. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. 1. With axes that have already been referenced, the software limit switch 1 or 2 should respond before the hardware limit switch is reached. Check MD36110 $MA_POS_LIMIT_PLUS, MD36100 $MA_POS_LIMIT_MINUS, MD36130 $MA_POS_LIMIT_PLUS2 and MD36120 $MA_POS_LIMIT_MINUS2 and the NC/PLC interface signal for the selection DB380x DBX1000.3 / 1000.2 (1st/2nd software limit switch plus/minus) and correct, if necessary (PLC user program). 2. If the axis has not yet been referenced, it is possible to depart from the hardware limit switch in the opposite direction in JOG mode. 3. Check the PLC user program and the connection from the switch to the PLC input module, provided the axis has not reached the hardware limit switch at all.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 overlaid motion active at transformation switchover

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 transformation does not allow to traverse the pole
desc_en: The preset curve passes through the pole or a forbidden area of the transformation. Modify the part program (if the alarm has occurred in AUTO mode). To escape from the alarm position, transformation must be deselected (it is not enough to try a RESET if the transformation remains active when RESET is applied).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] As from block %2 transformation active: overlaid motion too great
desc_en: The share of overlaid motion on the transformation-related axes is so high that the path movement planned by the preparation no longer sufficiently corresponds to the actual ratio for the interpolation. Strategy of singularities, monitoring of working range limitation and dynamic Look Ahead are possibly no longer correct. With overlaid motion, keep a sufficiently large path safety distance with regard to poles and working range limitations.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 transformation active: motion not possible
desc_en: The machine kinematics do not allow the specified motion. Transformation-dependent error causes may be: With TRANSMIT: There is a circular area around the pole, where positioning is not possible. This area exists because the tool reference point cannot be traversed into the pole. The area is defined by the following factors: - Machine data (MD249.. $MC_TRANSMIT_BASE_TOOL_...) - Active tool length compensation (see $TC_DP..). Whether the tool length compensation is included in the calculation depends on the selected working plane (see G17,..). The machine stops at the edge of the area where positioning is not possible. For TRAINT: An attempt was made to activate a TRAINT transformation with Y(WCS)<>0. (The Y axis must be set to WCS=0 when calling TRAINT). NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 Emergency braking ramp activated
desc_en: An axial emergency braking ramp was activated for the specified axis/spindle The following causes are possible for the activation of the emergency braking ramp: Alarm 26052: Path velocity for auxiliary function output too high Alarm 1012 : System error with ID 550006 550006 Alarm 1016 : System error with ID 550003, 550005 and 550010 With master/slave coupling, MD30132 $MA_IS_VIRTUAL_AX (axis is virtual axis) has been set. Braking request with priority 13 may have been requested by the OEM application. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Remove or reset the cause of the alarm.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 The constant transformation axis %3 has moved.
desc_en: An axis whose position must remain constant for the transformation in the current block has moved. Change part program if alarm has occurred in AUTO mode. The alarm is cancelled with RESET. If the transformation is retained beyond RESET, the constant axis goes into the transformation with its new position. If that is not wanted, the transformation must be deselected, and the axis position changed in this state. The transformation can then be reactivated.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 overlaid motion not allowed
desc_en: An overlaid motion was requested for the axis, however, this is not allowed due to the MD32074 $MA_FRAME_OR_CORRPOS_NOTALLOWED. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 conflict between SYNACT: $AA_OFF and CORROF
desc_en: When deselecting the position offset ($AA_OFF) via the part program command CORROF (<axis>, "AA_OFF") an active synchronized action is detected that immediately sets $AA_OFF for the axis (DO_$AA_OFF [<axis>] =<value>). Deselection is executed and $AA_OFF not set again. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 impermissible motion on change of tool direction and $AA_TOFF active
desc_en: If an offset is active in tool direction via $AA_TOFF[i] there must not be a geometry axis movement in a block in which the tool orientation is changed abruptly. Abrupt changes of the tool orientation, whereby a movement of the geometry axes can be programmed simultaneously, can, for example, occur during a plane change, tool change, or activation and deactivation of an orientable tool carrier. - Modify part program - Program TOFFOF()

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %3 axis %2 touch probe already deflected, edge polarity not possible

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %3 axis %2 measurement not possible
desc_en: Measurement level 2 (MEASA, MEAWA, MEAC). There is an error in the programmed measurement task. Possible causes: - Invalid measurement mode - Invalid probe - Invalid encoder - Invalid number of measurement signal edges - Identical measurement signal edges are only programmable in mode 2 - Invalid FIFO number - Mismatch between the number of FIFOs programmed and the number of probes used in the measurement task. Further causes: A measurement task is already active (e.g. from a synchronized action). Correct the measurement tasks.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

title: ЧПУ · указатель

desc_en: The number of programmed auxiliary functions has exceeded the maximum permissible amount. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Workpiece setpoint %2 reached
desc_en: This alarm is activated via MD27880 $MC_PART_COUNTER, bit 1: The number of counted workpieces ($AC_ACTUAL_PARTS or $AC_SPECIAL_PARTS) is equal or already greater than the programmed value for the number of required workpieces ($AC_REQUIRED_PARTS). At the same time, the channel VDI signal "Workpiece setpoint reached" is output. The value for the number of counted workpieces ($AC_ACTUAL_PARTS) is reset, while the value of $AC_SPECIAL_PARTS is retained. Note: The setpoint/actual comparison of the workpieces requires $AC_REQUIRED_PARTS > 0. If $AC_REQUIRED_PARTS has a negative value, all workpiece counts activated through MD27880 $MC_PART_COUNTER are frozen at the values they have reached, and the nominal/actual comparison is discontinued. No program interrupt. Delete alarm display.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Spindle %3 Gear stage change in %4 not possible
desc_en: A gear stage change for the spindle will not be possible, if: - thread cutting (G33, G34, G35) is active - the spindle is active as master or slave spindle in a coupling - the spindle is being positioned - interpolation turning transformation (TRAINT) is active The gear stage is to be set prior to the corresponding machining step. If it is necessary, however, to change the gear stage within one of the above mentioned functions, this function must be switched off for the time of the gear stage change. Thread cutting is deselected with G1; synchronous spindle coupling is switched off with COUPOF; the spindle positioning operation is exited with M3, M4 or M5, interpolation turning transformation (TRAINT) is switched off with TRAFOOF. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Axis %3: Braking time %6 [s] longer than Stop D time. Reason: %5.
desc_en: The current axis dynamic response and/or parameterized Stop D time are not sufficient to come to a standstill on time when a Stop D is triggered. Note: Parameter 4 contains the descriptions of parameters 5 and 6 separated by the "|" character. Parameter 5 = Reason, possible values: 1: MD32300 $MA_MAX_AX_ACCEL too low. 2: MD32431 $MA_MAX_AX_JERK too low. 3: Excessive acceleration reduction activated with ACC or subsequent to FXST. 4: Excessive jerk reduction programmed with JERKLIMA. Parameter 6 = Braking time [s] The displayed time is the expected braking time determined for the current type of movement or the dynamic response setting of the axis. Increase Stop D time in the drive (p9553). Increase MD32300 $MA_MAX_AX_ACCEL and MD32431 $MA_MAX_AX_JERK. Increase programmed acceleration (ACC) or jerk (JERKLIMA). Correct torque and acceleration reduction subsequently to FXST. Alarm can be suppressed with MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2 bit 13.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Spindle %2: Braking time %6 [s] longer than Stop D time with gear stage %3. Reason %5
desc_en: The dynamic response values configured for the spindle and/or the parameterized Stop D time are not sufficient to come to a standstill on time when a Stop D is triggered. Parameter 3 contains the gear stage whose braking time from the configured dynamic response values overshoots the Stop D time the most. Note: Parameter 4 contains the descriptions of parameters 5 and 6 separated by the "|" character: Parameter 5 = Reason, possible values: 10: Dynamic response for speed control: MD35130 $MA_GEAR_STEP_MAX_VELO_LIMIT, MD35200 $MA_GEAR_STEP_SPEEDCTRL_ACCEL 11: Dynamic response for position control: MD35135 $MA_GEAR_STEP_PC_MAX_VELO_LIMIT, MD35210 $MA_GEAR_STEP_POSCTRL_ACCEL. Excessive acceleration reduction programmed subsequent to FXST. 21: Dynamic response for tapping with G331, G332: MD35135 $MA_GEAR_STEP_PC_MAX_VELO_LIMIT, MD35212 $MA_GEAR_STEP_POSCTRL_ACCEL2 Parameter 6 = Braking time [s] The displayed time is the expected braking time determined for the current dynamic response values of the spindle.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action %3 spindle %4 selected gear stage not installed
desc_en: The first gear stage data block is active. The required gear stage is not installed in the 1st gear stage data block. The number of installed gear stages is configured in MD35090 $MA_NUM_GEAR_STEPS. Examples for the occurrence of the alarm with 3 gear stages installed (MD35090 $MA_NUM_GEAR_STEPS = 3): * ...DO M44 or DO M45 was programmed in synchronized action for the spindle concerned. * ...DO M70 was programmed and MD35014 $MA_GEAR_STEP_USED_IN_AXISMODE was larger than 3. Modify part program: Only those valid gear stages can be entered which have also been installed according to MD35090 $MA_NUM_GEAR_STEPS. Limit M70 configuration (MD 35014 $MA_GEAR_STEP_USED_IN_AXISMODE) to MD35090 $MA_NUM_GEAR_STEPS.

desc_en: A gear stage change for the spindle will not be possible, if: - thread cutting (G33, G34, G35) is active - the spindle is active as master or slave spindle in a coupling - the spindle is being positioned The gear stage is to be set prior to the corresponding machining step. desc_en: With the 'DryRun', 'ProgramTest' and 'SearchRunByProgTest' functions deselected, it is not possible in the REPOS module to carry out a gear stage change to a previously programmed gear stage. This is the case, if the spindle is in the deselection block not active in speed control mode, as a slave axis or in a transformation. Execution of a gear stage change is avoided if the above mentioned functions are deselected by resetting bit 2 of MD35035 $MA_SPIND_FUNCTION_MASK. Change deselection block or block search target block to speed control mode (M3, M4, M5, SBCOF). Set bit 2 of MD35035 $MA_SPIND_FUNCTION_MASK to 0.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 leading spindle %3 is in simulation.
desc_en: When coupling, no synchronism can be achieved if the lead spindle/axis is in simulation mode and the following spindle/axis is not. Switch the following spindle/axis to simulation mode or do not simulate the lead spindle/axis (MD30130$MA_CTRLOUT_TYPE). If the differing settings have been selected on purpose, the alarm can be suppressed with MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit 21 = 1 or with CP programming by setting CPMALARM[FAx] bit 3 = 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 dependent spindle %3 is in simulation.
desc_en: When coupling, no synchronism can be achieved if the following spindle/axis is in simulation mode and the lead spindle/axis is not. Switch the leading spindle/axis to simulation mode or do not simulate the following spindle/axis (MD30130 $MA_CTRLOUT_TYPE). If the differing settings have been selected on purpose, the alarm can be suppressed with MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit 21 = 1 or with CP programming by setting CPMALARM[FAx] bit 4 = 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2. The dynamics of leading spindle %3 and dependent spindle %4 is too variably
desc_en: If the spindles / axes differ strongly in their dynamic behavior during coupling, synchronism cannot be achieved. The dynamics are dependent on many settings: default feedforward control, parameter block data, first of all the servo gain factor, symmetrizing time, etc., feedforward control mode and feedforward setting parameter, FIPO mode, jerk filter and dynamic filter settings, DSC on/off. Among these are the following machine data: MD32620 $MA_FFW_MODE, MD32610 $MA_VELO_FFW_WEIGHT, MD33000 $MA_FIPO_TYPE, VEL_FFW_TIME, MD32810 $MA_EQUIV_SPEEDCTRL_TIME, MD32200 $MA_POSCTRL_GAIN, MD32410 $MA_AX_JERK_TIME, MD32644 $MA_STIFFNESS_DELAY_TIME, MD37600 $MA_PROFIBUS_ACTVAL_LEAD_TIME, MD37602 $MA_PROFIBUS_OUTVAL_DELAY_TIME, MD10082 $MN_CTRLOUT_LEAD_TIME Use spindles/axes with identical dynamic responses. If the differing settings have been selected on purpose, the alarm can be suppressed with MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit 21 = 1 or with CP programming by setting CPMALARM[FAx] bit 5 = 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 following spindle %3 No dynamic response for supplementary motion
desc_en: The differential motion of the following spindle cannot be executed due to a lack of available velocity. The coupling consumes the entire available dynamic response. The following spindle is already rotating at maximum speed. In the part program a deadlock might occur. The alarm can be suppressed with MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit 26 = 1 or with CP programming by setting CPMALARM[FAx] bit 6 = 1. Reduce the speed of the master spindle

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 following spindle %3 in the range of reduced acceleration capability
desc_en: The following spindle is driven with position control. Additional motion components of the following spindle should not leave the linear range of the motor used. If they do, deviations may occur in the contour and servo alarms could even be output. Monitoring is based on the configuration in MD35220 $MA_ACCEL_REDUCTION_SPEED_POINT. If the situation is being managed by the user, the alarm can be suppressed with MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit 25 = 1 or with CP programming by setting CPMALARM[FAx] bit 7 = 1. Use coupling type VV and safeguard SPCOF for master and following spindle.

This gear stage is checked whenever the spindle is switched into axis mode. The configured gear stage is compared with the gear stage output by the PLC (NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX2000.0 - .2 (Actual gear stage A through C)). title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Spindle %3 tapping: PLC signal 'invert M3/M4' changed after %4
desc_en: When loading a G331 block it was detected that the NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX2001.6 (invert M3/M4) had changed during part program execution. An alarm was output to prevent a tool break. The current value of the NC/PLC interface signal is displayed as parameter 4. A change in the NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX2001.6 (invert M3/M4) during part program execution should be avoided. If MD35035 SPIND_FUNCTION_MASK bit 22 is set, the NC/PLC interface signal DB380x DBX2001.6 (invert M3/M4) is then no longer evaluated during tapping with G331, G332. The alarm is no longer output. desc_en: The following situation occurred during 'Correct synchronism': - Diagnostics 1: An existing override motion is terminated on key reset. - Diagnostics 2: The override motion has been deleted. - Diagnostics 3: Writing of override value not allowed. Synchronism override is deleted. - Diagnostics 4: Override motion is stopped temporarily (e.g. G74 reference point approach) - Diagnostics 5: Delay of override motion: acceleration capacity used up by other motions. - Diagnostics 6: Delay of override motion: velocity used up by other motions. - Diagnostics 7: Delay of override motion: the maximum speed is limited to 0. MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK activates this alarm: - Bit 9 = 1 for diagnostics 1 to 6 - Bit 12 = 1 for diagnostics 7 to 8 Deactivate the alarm with MD 11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK Bit9 = 0 or Bit12 = 0.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: Ensure that the specified tool is contained in the desired magazine. Select another tool to be changed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

desc_en: The desired tool change is not possible. The specified tool is not contained in the specified magazine. NCK cannot contain tools that are not assigned to a magazine. With this kind of tool, no operations (motion, change) can be performed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Tool management: tool change not possible since there is no tool available in tool group %2
desc_en: The desired tool change is not possible. The specified tool group does not contain a tool which is ready for use and could be used for tool change. It is possible that all of the tools in question have been set to the "Disabled" state by the tool monitoring function. - Ensure that the specified tool group contains a tool that is ready for use when the tool change is requested. - For example, replace disabled tools or enable a disabled tool manually. - Check whether the tool data are correctly defined. Have all intended tools in the group been defined with the specified identifier and loaded?

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Tool management: no tool available in tool group %3 cause %4
desc_en: The specified tool group does not contain a ready-to-use replacement tool that could be used for tool change. It is possible that all tools in question have been set to the "Locked" status by the tool monitoring function. The alarm can occur, for example, in conjunction with alarm 14710 (error during INIT block generation). In this case, NCK attempts, for example, to replace the locked tool on the spindle with an available replacement tool, which, however, does not exist in this error case. If this conflict occurs, the operator must, for example, remove the tool on the spindle from the spindle using a move command (e.g. with an HMI operation). If the spindle tool is checked during Init block generation and it is not ready for use, the cause is shown in parameter 4. Possible reasons: 1 - Tool is not released 2 - Tool is locked 3 - Tool is to be unloaded 9 - The magazine location of the tool is locked 10 - Tool is in a non-released multitool 11 - Tool is in a locked multitool 12 - Tool is in a multitool that is to be unloaded 13 - Tool is in a multitool on which another tool to be unloaded is located

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 tool management: No tool available in tool group %3, program %4
desc_en: The specified tool group does not contain a tool which is ready for use and could be used for tool change. It is possible that all of the tools in question have been set to the 'Disabled' state by the tool monitoring function. Parameter %4 = program name facilitates the identification of the program containing the programming command (tool selection) that caused the error. This can be a subprogram or cycle, etc., which can no longer be identified from the display. If the parameter is not specified, it is the currently displayed program. - Ensure that the specified tool group contains a tool that is ready for use when tool change is requested. - This can be achieved, for example, by replacing disabled tools, or - by releasing a disabled tool manually. - Check whether the tool data are correctly defined. Have all intended tools in the group been defined with the specified identifier and loaded?

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [TO unit %1: ] Please change tool %2 into magazine. Repeat data backup
desc_en: The alarm can only occur when the tool management function is active in the NCK. (TOOLMAN = tool management) A data backup of the tool/magazine data has been started. During the backup, the system detected that tools are still located in the buffer magazine (= spindle, gripper, ...). During the backup, these tools will lose the information which defines the magazine and location to which they are allocated. It is therefore practical -assuming that the data are to be stored exactly as before - to ensure that all tools have been deposited in the magazine before the data backup! If this is not the case, some magazine locations will have the "reserved" status when the data are loaded again. This "reserved" status must then be reset manually. For tools with fixed location coding, the loss of the information allocating their location in the magazine has the same effect as a general empty location search when they are returned to the magazine. Ensure that there are no tools in the buffer magazine before making the data backup. Repeat the data backup after removing the tools from the buffer magazine.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %3 spindle %2 chuck speed exceeded
desc_en: The actual spindle speed is higher than the maximum speed configured in MD35100 $MA_SPIND_VELO_LIMIT plus a tolerance of 10 percent (fixed setting). The alarm should not occur after correct optimization of the drive actuator and gear configuration. This alarm can be reconfigured with MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready to operate) to 'BAG not ready'. Note: Reconfiguring affects all alarms with alarm response 'Chan not ready'. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check the setup and optimization data of the drive actuator in accordance with the Installation and Start-up Guide and make corrections. Increase the tolerance window in MD35150 $MA_SPIND_DES_VELO_TOL.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %3 Spindle %2 axis stopped during tapping
desc_en: When tapping with compensating chuck (G63) the drilling axis was stopped via the NC/PLC interface and the spindle continues to rotate. The thread and possibly also the tap were damaged as a result. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %3 Spindle %2 axis stopped during thread cutting
desc_en: The thread cutting axis has been stopped while a thread block was active. The stop can be caused by VDI signals that cause the feed to be interrupted. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check the axis-specific/spindle-specific stop DB380x DBX4.3 (Spindle stop).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 thread cutting: Maximum speed axis %3 exceeded %4
desc_en: Thread cutting with G33, G34, G35: The thread axis (pitch axis) velocity calculated exceeds the maximum permissible axis velocity MD32000 $MA_MAX_AX_VELO. The calculated axis velocity is displayed. The velocity of the thread axis is dependent upon: - The current spindle speed - The programmed thread pitch - The programmed thread pitch change and thread length (G34, G35) - The spindle override (path and individual axis overrides are ineffective) Reduce the spindle speed or thread pitch (thread pitch change).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 thread cutting: Maximum speed axis %3 exceeded %4

title: ЧПУ · указатель

desc_en: Thread cutting with G33, G34, G35: Block length too short for predefined thread pitch. Block length is displayed. Reduce thread pitch (thread pitch change).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 zero velocity of thread axis at position %3 reached
desc_en: An axis standstill was reached at the specified position during thread cutting with G35 due to the linear decrease in the thread pitch. The standstill position of the thread axis depends on: - Programmed thread pitch decrease - Thread length Change at least one of the above factors.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] In block %2: Prog. acceleration path too short %3, %4 required
desc_en: In order to stay within the programmed acceleration path, the acceleration caused an overload on the thread axis. In order to accelerate the axis with the programmed dynamic response, the length of the acceleration path must be at least as large as the value in parameter %4. The alarm is of the technological type and is output whenever bit 2 in MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK is enabled. The HMI softkey 'Technology support' sets and clears this bit in the MD. Modify part program or reset MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK bit 2.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] In block %2: Prog. thread block too short to comply with the dynamic limit values %3, %4 is required
desc_en: If programming requires a dynamic response adjustment from one thread element to the next thread element, a check is made to see if the path length is long enough to comply with the dynamic limit values. Only a part of the programmed path length can be taken for this smoothing because the programmed target speed of the thread block for the required thread geometry (thread pitch, spindle speed) has to be reached and output. The dynamic limit values are exceeded for the dynamic response adjustment to the required thread geometry. The alarm is only output if it is not suppressed by bit 25 of MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2. 1. Change part program and lengthen the path of thread block %2 or the next block. There is a danger of collision as a result of path lengthening, especially for female threads. This must be checked. 2. Lengthen the smoothing length of the thread block with DITRB = -1. 3. Set MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2 bit 25. 4. Set setting data SD42010 $SC_THREAD_RAMP_DISP[2] = 0.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Spindle operation for transformed spindle/axis %2 not possible (reason: error code %3).
desc_en: It is impermissible to start a spindle as long as it is being used by a transformation. Reason: spindle usage in a transformation requires axis operation, which must not be exited. This alarm may have the following reasons: - - Error code 11 : DB380x DBX5006.0 (Spindle stop); - Error code 12 : DB380x DBX5006.1 (Spindle start clockwise rotation); - Error code 13 : DB380x DBX5006.2 (Spindle start counterclockwise rotation; - Error code 14 : DB380x DBX5006.4 (Spindle positioning). Resolve the conflict, for example by deactivating transformation prior to spindle start.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Changeover of the operating mode of the axis/spindle %2 using PI service not possible, Cause %3
desc_en: 1: The required axis/spindle is not known in the channel. 2: The required axis/spindle is not available in the channel. 3: The required axis/spindle is defined as virtual axis. 4: The required axis is not defined as spindle. Therefore, it is not possible to change over the operating mode of the axis. 5: The required axis/spindle is a permanently assigned PLC axis/spindle. 6: The required axis/spindle is an active slave axis/spindle. 7: Spindle operation is not possible for transformed spindle/axis. 8: The required axis/spindle is not available as command axis. Reaction: Alarm display. 1: Please select the PI service again. 2: Please select the PI service again. 3: Reset MD 30132 IS_VIRTUAL_AX. 4: When required, configure axis as spindle. 5: Axis/spindle enabled by the PLC. 6: Deactivate coupling of the slave axis/spindle. 7: Deactivate transformation. 8: Wait until the axis is again available.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 drive fault
desc_en: For PROFIdrive: The drive signals a serious fault which prevents the drive from being ready. The exact cause of the fault can be found by evaluating the output drive alarms (It may be necessary to activate these diagnostic alarms by parameterizing the MDs MD13070 $MN_DRIVE_FUNCTION_MASK, MD13140 $MN_PROFIBUS_ALARM_ACCESS etc): Alarms 380500 and 380501 (or the corresponding alarm numbers implemented on the HMI side). The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Evaluation of the drive alarms.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 waiting for drive
desc_en: Drive group error (self-clearing). For PROFIdrive only: Wait for the drive. This alarm reveals similar problems to alarm 25201 (see that alarm). It is continuously active during power- up if the drive does not communicate (e.g. if the PROFIBUS connector has fallen out). Otherwise, the alarm is active only briefly and is replaced by alarm 25201 after an internal timeout in the event of a permanent problem.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 gear ratio changed with ESR enabled
desc_en: Because a change in the gear ratio has an effect on the retraction path traveled by the drive, no changes may be made to the gear ratio during the following periods of time: - Between the last programming of the retraction path with ESRR and the ESR enable - As from ESR enable The following machine data define the gear ratios of an axis MD31050 $MA_DRIVE_AX_RATIO_DENOM MD31060 $MA_DRIVE_AX_RATIO_NUMERA MD31064 $MA_DRIVE_AX_RATIO2_DENOM MD31066 $MA_DRIVE_AX_RATIO2_NUMERA The gear ratio must not be changed during the periods of time described above, e.g. by changing the parameter set.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 clamping monitoring
desc_en: The clamped axis has been pushed out of its setpoint position. The permissible difference is defined in the axis-specific MD36050 $MA_CLAMP_POS_TOL. Clamping an axis is activated with the axis-specific interface signal DB380x DBX2.3 (Clamping process active). The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Determine the position deviation to the setpoint position and, depending on the results, either increase the permissible tolerance in the MD or mechanically improve the clamping (e.g. increase clamping pressure).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 parameterization error: friction compensation
desc_en: The parameterization of the adaptation characteristic in the quadrant error compensation is not allowed because acceleration value 2 (MD32560 $MA_FRICT_COMP_ACCEL2 is not between acceleration value 1 (MD32550 $MA_FRICT_COMP_ACCEL1) and acceleration value 3 (MD32570 $MA_FRICT_COMP_ACCEL3). The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check the setting parameters of the quadrant error compensation (friction compensation), if necessary switch off the compensation with MD32500 $MA_FRICT_COMP_ENABLE.
