title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 parameterization error: lead screw pitch
desc_en: The pitch of the ballscrew/trapezoidal leadscrew set in the axis-specific MD31030 $MA_LEADSCREW_PITCH is zero. The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Determine the leadscrew pitch (specify the machine manufacturer or pitch measurement with spindle cover removed) and enter it in the MD31030: $MA_LEADSCREW_PITCH (mostly 10 or 5 mm/rev.).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 encoder %2 parameterization error: grid point distance with linear encoders
desc_en: The scale division of the linear scale set in the axis-specific MD31010 $MA_ENC_GRID_POINT_DIST is zero or differs from the corresponding drive parameters. For a better understanding of the interrelations see the explanations for alarm 26002, which refer to rotatory encoders. The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Enter the encoder grid point distance according to the data given by the machine (or measuring device) manufacturer in the MD31010 $MA_ENC_GRID_POINT_DIST.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 parameterization error: output rating
desc_en: For analog drives: The output evaluation of the analog speed setpoint set in the MD32250 $MA_RATED_OUTVAL or in MD 32260 $MA_RATED_VELO is zero. The effective output evaluation of the speed setpoint interface is zero: a. MD32260 $MA_RATED_VELO is zero although a standardizing reference value needs to be defined on account of the setting MD32250 $MA_RATED_OUTVAL>0 b. The corresponding drive-side standardizing parameter is zero, invalid or unreadable/unavailable although an automatic interface scaling adjustment has been selected on account of MD32250 $MA_RATED_OUTVAL=0. The drive parameter defining the standard is not determined by PROFIdrive, but is specific to the manufacturer (see the relevant drive documentation: For SINAMICS: p2000). The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. The nominal output voltage in [%] of the maximum setpoint value (10 V) is entered in the MD32250 $MA_RATED_OUTVAL, at which the rated motor speed in [degrees/s] is to be reached (MD32260 $MA_RATED_VELO).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 QEC: invalid coarse increment
desc_en: The course increment for QEC must be within the range 1 <= course increment <= maximum value of MD18342 $MN_MM_QEC_MAX_POINTS (currently 1025), because a greater number of values would exceed the available memory space. Modify the system variable $AA_QEC_COARSE_STEPS accordingly.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 QEC: invalid fine increment
desc_en: The fine increment for quadrant error compensation $AA_QEC_FINE_STEPS must be in the range 1 <= fine increment <= 16 because this value has an influence on the computation time of the QEC. Modify the system variable $AA_QEC_FINE_STEPS accordingly.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 QEC: memory overflow
desc_en: The product of the data $AA_QEC_COARSE_STEPS+1 and $AA_QEC_FINE_STEPS must not exceed the maximum number of the characteristic curve points (MD38010 $MA_MM_QEC_MAX_POINTS). With a direction-dependent characteristic, this criterion applies to 2 * ($AA_QEC_COARSE_STEPS+1) * $AA_QEC_FINE_STEPS! Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Either increase MD38010 $MA_MM_QEC_MAX_POINTS or reduce $AA_QEC_COARSE_STEPS and/or $AA_QEC_FINE_STEPS. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 QEC: invalid acceleration characteristic
desc_en: $AA_QEC_ACCEL_1/2/3: The acceleration characteristic is divided into three areas. In each area there is a different quantization of the acceleration steps. The defaults should be changed only if compensation is inadequate in these acceleration areas. The defaults are as follows: - $AA_QEC_ACCEL_1 with approx. 2% of maximum acceleration ($AA_QEC_ACCEL_3), - $AA_QEC_ACCEL_2 with approx. 60% of maximum acceleration ($AA_QEC_ACCEL_3), - $AA_QEC_ACCEL_3 with maximum acceleration (MD32300 $MA_MAX_AX_ACCEL). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Enter the values correctly: 0 < $AA_QEC_ACCEL_1 < $AA_QEC_ACCEL_2 < $AA_QEC_ACCEL_3.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 QEC: invalid measuring periods
desc_en: $AA_QEC_MEAS_TIME_1/2/3: measuring time to determine the error criterion. The measuring period begins when the criterion for activating the compensation value has been satisfied (the desired velocity changes the sign). The end is defined by the machine data values. In general, different measuring times are required for the three characteristic ranges. The presettings should be changed only if a problem occurs. The three data apply in each case for the three corresponding acceleration ranges. 1. $AA_QEC_MEAS_TIME_1 specifies the measuring time (for determining the error criterion) for accelerations in the range between 0 and $AA_QEC_ACCEL_1. 2. $AA_QEC_MEAS_TIME_2 specifies the measuring time in the range from $AA_QEC_ACCEL_1 to $AA_QEC_ACCEL_2. 3. $AA_QEC_MEAS_TIME_3 specifies the measuring time in the range from $AA_QEC_ACCEL_2 to $AA_QEC_ACCEL_3 and beyond. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Enter the values correctly: 0 < $AA_QEC_MEAS_TIME_1 < $AA_QEC_MEAS_TIME_2 < $AA_QEC_MEAS_TIME_3.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 QEC: feed forward control not active
desc_en: The error criterion for determining the quadrant error necessitates a correctly set feedforward control. The alarm can be reprogrammed in the MD11412 $MN_ALARM_REACTION_CHAN_NOREADY (channel not ready). Switch on feedforward control and set it correctly.

message_en: Axis %1 encoder %2 measurement not possible with this controller module
desc_en: If the MD MD13100 $MN_DRIVE_DIAGNOSIS[8] contains a value not equal to zero, then the control has found at least one control module which does not support measuring. Measuring was programmed from the part program for the associated axis. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error. - Modify the measuring motion so that the axis concerned does not have to travel. Ensure that you do not program this axis in the measuring block. It is no longer possible to query the measured value for this axis. - Replace the control module with one that supports the measurement. See MD13100 $MN_DRIVE_DIAGNOSIS[8].

You can no longer query a measured value for this axis. - Ensure that measurement is not made with simulated encoders (MD30240 $MA_ENC_TYPE).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 SINAMICS drive parameter P2038 value is not allowed.
desc_en: For SINAMICS drives only: The interface mode, which is set via drive parameter P2038, has not been set to SIMODRIVE 611 universal. The alarm can be disabled by MD13070 $MN_DRIVE_FUNCTION_MASK - bit15. However, the following must be noted: - The device-specific assignment of the bits in the control and status words may be different. - The drive data sets can be created at will, and need not be subdivided into groups of 8. (For details see also SINAMICS Commissioning Manual). So the parameters of motors 2-4 may be incorrectly assigned. - Set P2038 = 1 or - Set P0922 = 100...199 or - Set bit 15 of MD13070 $MN_DRIVE_FUNCTION_MASK (note the boundary conditions, see above) and execute a Power-On in each case.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 encoder %2 absolute position lost
desc_en: The absolute position of the absolute encoder has become invalid because - on changing parameter block, a changed gear stage ratio was identified between encoder and processing or - the encoder has been replaced (the absolute encoder's serial number was changed, see MD34230 $MA_ENC_SERIAL_NUMBER, and drive-specific parameters). - of an internal number format limitation in MD34090 $MA_REFP_MOVE_DIST_CORR. Remedy: reduce MD10210 $MN_INT_INCR_PER_DEG or MD10200 $MN_INT_INCR_PER_MM. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Rereferencing/resynchronization of the absolute encoder; attach absolute encoder on the load side and configure correctly (e.g. MD 31040 $MA_ENC_IS_DIRECT).

desc_en: The alarm is output when the same machine axis has been configured as a master and a slave axis. Each of the axes in the master/slave link can be operated either as master or slave. - Check machine data for all linked axes and correct if necessary: - MD 37250 $MA_MS_ASSIGN_MASTER_SPEED_CMD - MD 37252 $MA_MS_ASSIGN_MASTER_TORQUE_CTR.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 master-slave not configured
desc_en: The master-slave coupling could not be activated because of incomplete configuration. Check the current configuration of the master-slave coupling. The configuration can be modified via the MASLDEF instruction or the machine data MD37250 $MA_MS_ASSIGN_MASTER_SPEED_CMD and MD37252 $MA_MS_ASSIGN_MASTER_TORQUE_CTR.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 filter %2 limited
desc_en: The position controller cycle is too small or position setpoint filters activated with the specified machine data are parameterized too large and are limited internally. Change parameterization: Increase position controller cycle (or system cycle), deactivate filter in the specified machine data, or reduce parameterization of the used filters (e.g. used filter time constant).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 encoder parameterization MD %2[%3] has been adjusted.
desc_en: The parameterization of the encoder in P979 read out from the drive and displayed in the MD does not match the NCK parameterization. The corresponding NCK-MD has been adapted. Power-On required. This alarm only occurs when the NC-MD is set unequal to the drive parameter.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 parameter set change from %2 to %3 not possible
desc_en: The parameter block change cannot be performed without jumps. This is due to the content of the parameter block to be switched on, e.g. different load gear factors. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] In block %2 unanticipated stop crossed in continuous path mode
desc_en: The path interpolation did not stop, as required, at the end of the block, but only decelerates to a standstill in the next block. This error situation occurs if the stop at the end of the block was not planned by the path interpolation or was not detected early enough. One possible cause is that the PLC changed the spindle speed when MD35500 $MA_SPIND_ON_SPEED_AT_IPO_START > 0, and the machine has to wait until the spindle has returned to the setpoint range. Another possible cause is that a synchronized action needs to be finished before path interpolation continues. The alarm is only output if MD11400 $MN_TRACE_SELECT = 'H400'. The alarm output is normally suppressed. - MD11400 $MN_TRACE_SELECT has SIEMENS password protection. MD35500 $MA_SPIND_ON_SPEED_AT_IPO_START = 1. Program G09 before the alarm output in the block to allow the path interpolation to stop as planned.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] In block %2: path velocity too high for auxiliary function output (%3)
desc_en: This alarm usually occurs in a block with auxiliary function output during a movement. In this case, the wait for acknowledgment of the auxiliary function was longer than planned. The alarm also occurs if internal control inconsistencies cause continuous path mode (G64, G641, ...) to be blocked unexpectedly. The path interpolation stops abruptly at the end of the block indicated in the message (regenerative stop). Alarm 21620 is often triggered as a follow-up alarm. If not, the path continues after the block change. - The time calculated for the auxiliary function output during the movement comes from the PLC in most systems. Otherwise, MD10110 $MN_PLC_CYCLE_TIME_AVERAGE is used for this purpose. - The alarm can basically be avoided by programming in the block G09 indicated in the message. This stops the path interpolation briefly at the end of the block.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 interpolation problem in Look Ahead (module %3, identifier %4)
desc_en: Synchronism between interpolation and preparation is incorrect. Please contact Siemens.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 interpolation warning in Look Ahead (module %3, problem %4)
desc_en: The computer performance is inadequate to create a smooth path velocity profile. This can lead to drops in velocity. Change parameterization. Increase interpolation cycle.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 cannot be controlled by the PLC, max. number exceeded
desc_en: An attempt was made to define more axes than allowed as PLC-controlled axes. Check the option 'Number of PLC-controlled axes' and correct if necessary or reduce the number of requests for PLC- controlled axes.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 cannot be controlled by the PLC
desc_en: Axis cannot be made a PLC-controlled axis. For the time being, the axis cannot be controlled at any state from the PLC. Use Release or Waitp to make the axis a neutral one.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Switching off PLC control of axis %2 not allowed in the current state
desc_en: The PLC can return the control rights for an axis to program processing only, if the axis is in READY state. Reset VDI interface signal "PLC controls axis", then activate "Axial reset" and repeat process.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Axis %3 not available for the NC program, as exclusively controlled by the PLC
desc_en: The axis is exclusively controlled by the PLC. Therefore, the axis is not available for the NC program. Have the axis not exclusively controlled by the PLC, but only temporarily. Change MD30460 $MA_BASE_FUNCTION_MASK, bit 4.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Axis %3 not available for NC program, firmly assigned PLC axis
desc_en: The axis is a firmly assigned PLC axis. The axis is therefore not available for the NC program. Do not define axis as a firmly assigned PLC axis. Change of MD30460 $MA_BASE_FUNCTION_MASK bit5.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 not available for the NC program, as exclusively controlled by the PLC
desc_en: The axis is exclusively controlled by the PLC. Therefore, the axis is not available for the NC program. Have the axis not exclusively controlled by the PLC, but only temporarily. Change MD30460 $MA_BASE_FUNCTION_MASK, bit 4. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 not available for NC program, firmly assigned PLC axis
desc_en: The axis is a firmly assigned PLC axis. The axis is therefore not available for the NC program. Do not define axis as a firmly assigned PLC axis. Change of MD30460 $MA_BASE_FUNCTION_MASK bit5.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Retraction position of axis %2 not programmed or invalid
desc_en: No retraction position has been programmed for the axis trigger time or the position became invalid. Preset value by means of POLFA(Axis,Type,Pos), with type = 1 (absolut) or type = 2 (incremental); type = 0 specifies the position as invalid.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis trigger of axis %2 was activated, but axis is not PLC-controlled
desc_en: The axis trigger for single axis was initiated. However, the axis is not PLC-controlled at the trigger time (therefore no single axis) or the position became invalid. Preset axis PLC-controlled (declare single axis).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] ESR for PLC-controlled axis %2 has been triggered
desc_en: An axial ESR has been triggered for an individual axis (PLC-controlled axis): The display can be suppressed by MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit28 = 1. The individual axis is in axial stop after the ESR movement. If an axial reset is performed for the individual axis, the alarm will be deleted and the individual axis can be traversed again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 drive %2 sign of life missing
desc_en: Special case: The output of drive number=0 indicates that a computing timeout occurred on the IPO level (see also alarm 4240) Restart drive, check drive software.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 drive %2 communication failure
desc_en: For PROFIdrive only: The drive is not communicating. - Check the bus configuration. - Check the interface (connector removed, option module inactive, etc.).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 drive %2 sign of life missing
desc_en: For PROFIdrive only: The sign-of-life cell is no longer being updated by the drive. - Check the cycle settings (recommendation: e.g. MD10062 $MN_POSCTRL_CYCLE_DELAY = 0.0) - Increase the cycle time if necessary. - Power-up the drive again. - Check drive software. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Drive of axis %1 not found
desc_en: For PROFIdrive only: The drive configured for the specified axis could not be found. For example, a PROFIBUS slave was configured on the NC but is not contained in the PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration. Possible causes: - MD30130 $MA_CTRLOUT_TYPE not equal to 0 as a result of an oversight; the drive should actually be simulated (= 0). - MD30110 $MA_CTRLOUT_MODULE_NR entered incorrectly, i.e. the logical drive numbers were exchanged and an invalid value is stored for this drive in MD13050 $MN_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDRESS (see 3.) or a drive number which does not exist on the bus was entered (check the number for slaves, for example). - MD13050 $MN_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDRESS contains values which were not configured on PROFIBUS/PROFINET or different addresses of the input and output slots of the drives were selected in the PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Encoder %2 of axis %1 not found
desc_en: For PROFIdrive only: The encoder configured for the specified axis could not be found. For example, a PROFIBUS slave was configured on the NC but it is not contained in the PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration or defective hardware was reported for it. Possible causes: - MD 30240 $MA_ENC_TYPE not equal to 0 as a result of an oversight; the encoder should actually be simulated (= 0). - MD 30220 $MA_ENC_MODULE_NR entered incorrectly, i.e. the logical drive numbers were transposed and an invalid value is stored for this drive in MD 13050 $MN_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDRESS (see next paragraph), or a drive number which does not exist on the bus was entered (check the number for slaves, for example). - MD 13050 $MN_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDRESS contains values which were not configured on the PROFIBUS/PROFINET or different addresses were selected for the input and output slots of the drive in the PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration. - A fatal encoder error was detected during the selection of the encoder (encoder defective, removed), so that park status cannot be left (in such a case, this alarm is triggered instead of alarm 25000/25001 - please refer to them for other possible causes of the error).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Independent drive stop/retract triggered
desc_en: For SINAMICS only: Informational alarm: At least in one axis, a "drive-autonomous shutdown or retraction" was triggered. Deselect drive-autonomous stop or retration. acknowledge alarm with reset.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 $AA_ESR_ENABLE = 1 but axis should be set to NEUTRAL
desc_en: One axis with ESR configuration and $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 1 should be set to NEUTRAL. However, neutral axes (apart from single axes) cannot execute an ESR. Set $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 0 before setting axis to NEUTRAL. Alarm can be suppressed via MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2 bit 6 = 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 is NEUTRAL and $AA_ESR_ENABLE = 1 should be set
desc_en: $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 1 should not be set to neutral axes (apart from single axes). Neutral axes (apart from single axes) cannot execute an ESR. Do not apply $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 1 to neutral axes (apart from single axes). Alarm can be suppressed via MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2 bit 6 = 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2, $AA_ESR_ENABLE = 1, axis exchange not executed in this state
desc_en: With $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 1 axis exchange not permitted. Set $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 0 before axis exchange.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2 axis %3: ESRR or ESRS could not be executed, error code %4
desc_en: Writing the data of the part program commands ESRR or ESRS could not be executed. Error code: 1: The indicated axis is not assigned to any axis. 2: One or more ESR parameters in SINAMICS are not available. 3: Writing of one or more ESR parameters in SINAMICS was prevented. Error code: 1: Check the assignment of the NC axes to the drives. 2: One or more ESR parameters in SINAMICS are not available. Check the assignment of the NC axes to the drives. Programming of ESRR or ESRS is possible only for SINAMICS as from V4.4. The function module "drive-autonomous stop and retract" in SINAMICS not active. 3: Writing one or more ESR parameters in SINAMICS was prevented. Activate the output of additional information alarms through MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK, bit 1 = 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The ROOT chain element was not found.
desc_en: The kinematic chain element with the name specified in MD16800 $MN_ROOT_KIN_ELEM_NAME was not found. This error does not occur if kinematic chain elements have not been defined, i.e. if all system variables $NK_NAME[n] are empty. Change the content of machine data MD16800 $MN_ROOT_KIN_ELEM_NAME so that it refers to an existing, kinematic chain element, or adapt the name of a kinematic chain element to the content of the specified machine data.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The names of the kinematic chain links $NK_NAME[%3] and $NK_NAME[%4] are the same
desc_en: There are (at least) two kinematic chain links with the same name. The names of the kinematic chain links must be clear and identifiable. NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The chain element %3 referred to in $NK_NEXT[%4] is already contained in the chain
desc_en: In one chain link, the next link of the chain is indicated as a chain link already in existence in the chain. This allows you to define a not permitted closed chain. Define the kinematic chain in such a way that no closed chain results.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Chain element %3, referred to in $NK_NEXT[%4], was not found
desc_en: The chain link indicated as the next link in a kinematic chain was not found. Indicate in $NK_NEXT[...] the name of an existing chain link.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Chain element %3, referred to in $NK_PARALLEL[%4], was not found
desc_en: The specified parallel chain element was not found. In $NK_PARALLEL[...], specify the name of an existing chain element.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: $NK_SWITCH_INDEX[%3] is too large.
desc_en: The content of $NK_SWITCH_INDEX of a chain element of type "SWITCH" must be greater than or equal to -1 and less than the content of machine data MD18882 $MN_MM_MAXNUM_KIN_SWITCHES. Enter a permissible value in $NK_SWITCH_INDEX.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The axis direction in chain element %3 has not been defined.
desc_en: The chain element describes an axis, the direction of which is defined by the value included in $NK_OFF_DIR and $NK_OFF_DIR_FINE. The definition is valid only if the value of the sum vector and the value of the basic vector $NK_OFF_DIR are higher than 1.0e-6. Enter valid vectors in $NK_OFF_DIR and/or $NK_OFF_DIR_FINE, or change the type of the chain element.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Invalid name in %3[%4]
desc_en: A system variable of type STRING contains an invalid name. Use a permissible name. The permissible names can be found in the documentation of the system variables involved.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: unknown element type in $NK_TYPE[%3]

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: $NP_CHAIN_ELEM[%4] = %3 refers to a chain element of type SWITCH.
desc_en: The component $NP_CHAIN_ELEM of the specified protection area refers to a chain element of type "SWITCH". Protection areas must not be attached to chain elements of this type. Attach the protection area to another element in the kinematic chain. For example, an additional element of the type OFFSET with zero length can be inserted before the chain element of the type SWITCH.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Collision of the two protection areas %3 and %4
desc_en: The two protection areas named collide in the indicated block, i.e. the distance between the two protection areas is smaller than the value defined by MD10619 $MN_COLLISION_TOLERANCE. Change NC program or definition of the protection areas involved.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] The two protection areas %2 and %3 collide

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Collision of the two protection areas %3 and %4
desc_en: The two protection areas named collide in the indicated block, i.e. the distance between the two protection areas is smaller than the value defined by MD10619 $MN_COLLISION_TOLERANCE. Change NC program or definition of the protection areas involved.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Collision of the two protection areas %2 and %3
desc_en: All axles were stopped due to risk of collision. Move axes out of the danger zone.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The axis name %3 contained in $NK_AXIS[%4] is unknown or invalid
desc_en: An unknown or invalid name was entered in the element of a kinematic chain in the component $NK_AXIS[...]. The name entered must be a machine axis identifier. The alarm also occurs if the name entered in $NK_AXIS[...] exists, but the named element is not of the type defined in $NK_TYPE[...]. Example: $NK_TYPE[...] contains type "AXIS_ROT" and $NK_AXIS[...] the machine axis identifier of a linear axis, e.g. "X1". Enter a valid name in $NK_AXIS[...] (machine axis identifier). Enter the type of element in $NK_TYPE[...] that is referred to by the content of $NK_AXIS.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 risk of collision %3 %4
desc_en: The indicated axis was stopped due to the risk of collision. In JOG mode: Retract axis from danger zone. In automatic mode: Determine reason for the risk of collision and eliminate. Possible reasons: wrong NC program, too large handwheel overrides, axis couplings and vice-versa impairing of two channels.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 risk of collision %3 %4
desc_en: The stated axis was stopped due to the risk of collision. The programmed path may have been left because it was not possible to stop in time on the path (exceptional situation). In JOG mode: Retract axis from danger zone. In automatic mode: Determine reason for the risk of collision and eliminate. Possible reasons: wrong NC program, too large handwheel overrides, axis couplings and vice-versa impairing of two channels.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Emergency stop due to collision %3 %4
desc_en: All axes were stopped via emergency stop due to a collision. In Jog mode: move axis out of the collision.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 risk of collision preactivated protection areas %3 and %4
desc_en: A collision was detected involving at least one preactivated protection area. Such a collision can occur if the interface signal assigned to a preactivated protection area has been activated. In other words, if a preactivated protection area has become an active protection area. Either a preactivated and a (static) active protection area can be involved in the collision, or two preactivated protection areas can be involved. The names of the protection areas are output in the alarm test. Reset activating interface signals. Redefine protection areas. Retract

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The maximum number of %3 protection areas has been exceeded by %4.
desc_en: The maximum permissible number of protection areas has been exceeded. The permissible number of protection areas is determined by option data OD19830 $ON_COLLISION_MASK. Install corresponding option.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Maximum number of %3 protection area elements has been exceeded by %4.
desc_en: The maximum permissible number of protection area elements has been exceeded. The permissible number of protection area elements is determined by option data OD19830 $ON_COLLISION_MASK. Retrofit the corresponding option.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The maximum number %3 of 3D collision pairs has been exceeded by %4.
desc_en: The maximum permissible number of 3D collision pairs has been exceeded. The permissible number of 3D collision pairs is determined by option data OD19830 $ON_COLLISION_MASK. Install the corresponding option.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Loss of sign-of-life of the external collision avoidance.
desc_en: The configured timeout (MD16903 $MN_COLLISION_EXT_TIMEOUT) for communication with the external collision avoidance has expired. Check external system for errors, if necessary lengthen timeout.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: External collision avoidance: Waiting for connection.
desc_en: An external collision avoidance was configured. NCK is waiting for the system to connect. External system start, check connection if necessary.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Collision avoidance: Calculation not completed in time. Function code: %1
desc_en: The collision check is active, but individual calculations could not be completed in time. As a result, braking on the programmed path may not be possible if there is a risk of collision. In this case, an axial quick stop will be initiated. Check and adjust the configuration of the control. Suppress alarm with MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2 Bit 29. Increase the value in MD10623 $MN_COLLISION_PREV_IPO_RATIO step by step.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Risk of collision cannot be ruled out.
desc_en: The collision check could not be completed. Therefore, the risk of a collision cannot be ruled out. An axial quick stop will be initiated with alarm 26285. NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Conflict of functions in collision avoidance.
desc_en: The Protect MyMachine /Open and Protect MyMachine /3D Primitives/STL functions cannot be enabled at the same time. Exception: if MD18953 $MN_MM_COLL_PREV_CHECK_ACTIVE=false is set. Disable one of the PMM functions. Or set MD18953 $MN_MM_COLL_PREV_CHECK_ACTIVE=false.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2: Emergency stop due to collision %3 %4
desc_en: PLC-controlled axis was stopped by emergency stop due to collision. In Jog mode: move axis out of the collision.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Collision braking active because protection area is movable
desc_en: Collision braking has been disabled for this channel by the user. In the event of a collision, braking will still occur because the channel can move protection areas. Remove the corresponding axis from the channel or remove the protection area from the kinematic chain.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

desc_en: The external system is signaling an error on an inactive tool. Check external system and rectify reported error.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 SW limit switch deactivated
desc_en: Via the HMI, the SI acceptance test Safe limit position has been started, for example with the acceptance test wizard. For these acceptance tests, the single-channel software limit switches are deactivated for the axis/spindle, in order to assure that the safe limit positions can be approached. Deselect the acceptance test, for example with the acceptance test wizard, or wait until completed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 parameterisation of MD %2[%3] invalid, error code %4
desc_en: The parameterization of the specified machine data is incorrect. An additional indication is the array index of the machine data. If the machine data is a single machine data item, a zero is specified as the array index. This alarm occurs in accordance with the displayed error code in the following connections: 43: For an axis with safety functions, no PROFIdrive drive has been parameterized for the setpoint/actual value channel assignment in MD30100 $MA_CTRLOUT_SEGMENT_NR. 44: For an axis with safety functions, an invalid value was parameterized for the basic address assignment in MD37954 $MA_SAFE_INFO_MODULE_NR. Check and change the specified MD. Reset the enable of the SIC/SCC connection (MD37950 $MA_SAFE_INFO_ENABLE).

desc_en: The NCK-side Safety mode does not match the value of the PLC configuration. Align Safety mode between NCK and PLC. - The Safety mode defined in the PLC configuration is not permitted. The PLC configuration must be changed. - Operation as F-PLC is not possible. The function enable in MD19500 $ON_SAFE_PLC_LOGIC must be reset.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 Parameterizing error: MD %2 [%3] invalid
desc_en: The parameterization of the displayed machine data is incorrect. This alarm occurs in the following contexts: - During evaluation of the SIC/SCC telegram number in MD13376 $MN_SAFE_INFO_TELEGRAM_TYPE or in drive parameter p60122, an invalid SIC/SCC telegram number was found (not equal to 701). - The check of the logical base addresses from MD13374 $MN_SAFE_INFO_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDR has indicated that a slot with this address does not exist, or the SIC/SCC telegram has an incorrect length and "SIC/SCC" communication cannot be enabled. - No PROFIdrive drive was parameterized for the setpoint/actual value channel assignment in MD30130 $MA_CTRLOUT_TYPE. Parameterize a valid SIC/SCC telegram number (701). Configure or parameterize with valid logical basis addresses for the SIC/SCC slots.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 Control not ready for the drive-integrated safe brake test
desc_en: The motion control rejects the request for the drive-integrated "safe brake test" via the VDI interface. Possible causes: - When the brake test was selected via the VDI, the interpolator or the axis had not stopped, therefore the axis in motion or exact stop was not (no longer) given. - A new brake test was requested, but the previous brake test had not yet finished in the control. - Another axis was in motion in the channel. The alarm disappears automatically if the conditions in the motion control for performing the drive-integrated "safe brake test" are fulfilled, or the request for the drive-integrated "safe brake test" is withdrawn.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: A test stop is required on at least one axis
desc_en: A request for forced dynamization (test stop) was detected for at least one of the axes operated with Safety Info Channel (SIC operation enabled via MD37950 $MA_SAFE_INFO_ENABLE). See also definition of drive message A01697. This alarm can be suppressed via MD 13380 $MN_SAFE_ALARM_MASK Bit0 = 0. Perform test stop. The alarm disappears automatically if there is no test stop request for any of the axes.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Transformation not active: %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. The specified transformation is not active. You have to activate the transformation data set before you can use it. TRAORI before CYCLE832: The multi-axis program was selected in the High Speed Setting mask. This assumes that a TRAORI is active during machining. If CYCLE832 is called before TRAORI, incorrect rotary axes may be used to consider the compressor. A mandatory TRAORI call must be made before the CYCLE832 call. The rotary axes of the active TRAORI are only used with this sequence. If no TRAORI is active before the CYCLE832 call, the rotary axes of the 1st and 2nd transformation found on the basis of the machine data and the 1st and 2nd TRAORI/ TRAORI_DYN found are generally assumed for the consideration of the compressor. This can result in incorrectly decelerated rotary axes, for example. If compatibility is required, the alarm can be suppressed with Bit5 SD55220 $SCS_FUNCTION_MASK_MILL_TOL_SET

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Swivel plane with active turning tool not possible
desc_en: Swiveling the plane is not possible when a turning tool is active. Load a milling tool before you swivel the plane. The alarm can be suppressed using SD 55410 $SCS_MILL_SWIVEL_ALARM_MASK. For Y-turning tools, the alarm cannot be suppressed.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Positioning a milling tool with active turning tool is not possible

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool cannot be aligned - error code: %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Error code: A: Only new swivel plane permitted, see parameter _ST B: Angular range >= 360 -> angular range of the B axis >= 360 degrees C: Rotary axis vector V1 is not equal to 0 1 0 -> rotary axis vector V1 must rotate around Y See setup of swivel CYCLE800 D: Rotary axis vector V2 -> rotary axis vector V2 must rotate around X (1 0 0) or Z (0 0 1) See setup of swivel CYCLE800 E: WCS ROT Y > 90 -> active rotation of the Work (WCS) around Y is >90 degrees. -90 to +90 is permitted F: If geometry axis Y is not available -> SD55221 set Bit 5 = 1 G: Initial setting defines ($TC_CARR37] HUNDREDTHOUSANDS digit -Z or -X) -> SD55221 set Bit 5 = 1 See setup of swivel CYCLE800 H: Align tool, but active plane not G18 I: 1st turning technology (MD52200=1) and no Y axis available -> mirroring not allowed J: 1st turning technology (MD52200=1) and no Y axis available -> rotation around Y not possible K: Grinding technology (MD52200=3) and align tool -> SD55221 set Bit 5 = 1 L: Grinding technology (MD52200=3) and align tool -> set MD20186 = 1 Cycle alarms Alarms

F: Retraction in tool direction: no tool axis available Missing geometry axis (tool axis) Z with G17, Y with G18 or X with G19 G: Retraction in tool direction max.: negative retraction path H: Retraction in tool direction incremental: negative retraction path not permitted I: Retraction setup of swivel CYCLE800 not set up J: Retraction in tool direction is not permitted, because current Work (WCS) is mirrored Tool carrier is active K: Retraction and swivel plane and transformation on basic kinematic chain are active Retraction with transformation only if align turning tool is active L: Retraction in tool direction and align tool are only permitted if setting data 42954 $SC_TOOL_ORI_CONST_M=0 Transformation on basic kinematic chain is active M: Retraction in tool direction and align tool are only permitted if setting data 42956 $SC_TOOL_ORI_CONST_T=0 Transformation on basic kinematic chain is active N: Retraction in tool direction and swivel plane toward counterspindle are not possible Turning machine with active tool carrier and initial setting -X (see swivel setup) O: Retraction in tool direction, align tool with counterspindle is not possible P: Retraction in tool direction in G18 toward counterspindle is not possible Q: Retraction in tool direction is not permitted because the current Work (WCS) is mirrored Align turning tool with milling/turning machine (transformation on basic kinematic chain) active R: Retraction in tool direction is not possible with align tool Align turning tool with milling/turning machine (transformation on basic kinematic chain) active

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Allowance
desc_en: The difference between actual and setpoint measurements is greater than the upper tolerance limit (screen parameter TUL): - TUL is the upper tolerance limit of the measurement difference. - TUL is always related to the material, irrespective of whether external or internal machining is involved. - The hole/pocket is thus too small and the spigot is too large. - This means that further material can be removed. - The measuring cycle parameter TUL corresponds to "upper deviation", the usual term used in mechanical engineering for fits and tolerances. Programm continuation: Clear alarm with the RESET key. Restart part program

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check probe type
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Measurement of workpiece: Check tool type of measuring probe in the tool management. When measuring workpiece milling, tool types 710, 712, 713 or 714 should preferably be used. But a type 1xy can also be used. Type 710 is permitted for workpiece measurement in all measuring cycles. Types 712, 713 and 714 are intended for special measuring tasks. When measuring workpiece turning, tool type 580 should preferably be used. However, a type 1xy can also be used, but only if setting data $SC_TOOL_LENGTH_TYPE=2 is set. Measurement of tool: - For measuring tool milling, no permissible tool probe type is entered in SD54633 $SNS_MEA_TP_TYPE[S_PRNUM-1] or SD54648 $SNS_MEA_TPW_TYPE[S_PRNUM-1]. For probe type "Disk" the permissible working plane G17...G19 must be checked. - "Cube" is the only tool probe type permitted on milling/turning machines: SD54633 $SNS_MEA_TP_TYPE=0 and SD54648 $SNS_MEA_TPW_TYPE=0

desc_en: When measuring the workpiece for the technology turning, cutting edge positions 7 and 8 are allowed for probe type 580. When measuring the tool for the technology turning with orientable toolholders, the active cutting edge position of the probe is evaluated. title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2: check tool name / number
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. - Check parameter S_TNAME. With active tool management, parameter S_TNAME is empty or the specified tool name is unknown to the tool management.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check WO memory number
desc_en: The work offset to be corrected does not exist. Or a correction should be made to the coordinate rotation of a global work offset. Global work offsets have only linear offsets and no rotational offsets. It is therefore not possible to correct measured angles or other rotational offsets in them. Check the number of the work offset to be corrected that is specified in the measuring cycle mask. Check also the parameters S_KNUM and S_KNUM1 in the measuring cycle interface. If the machine data 18601 $MN_MM_NUM_GLOBAL_USER_FRAMES is greater than zero, all work offsets are globally defined. In this case, no coordinate rotation can be corrected. If you want to correct a coordinate rotation, the machine data 18601 must be set to zero so that the work offsets are defined according to the specific channel. For this the machine data 18601 $MN_MM_NUM_GLOBAL_USER_FRAMES and 28080 $MC_MM_NUM_USER_FRAMES must be checked Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check 4th digit of _KNUM
desc_en: The stated digit of _KNUM includes invalid values. Also check _MVAR. Check parameter for the tool offset target (_KNUM) and the measurement variant (S_MVAR).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check 5th digit of _KNUM
desc_en: The stated digit of _KNUM includes invalid values. Also check _MVAR. Check parameter for the tool offset target (_KNUM) and the measurement variant (S_MVAR).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check 6th digit of _KNUM
desc_en: The stated digit of _KNUM includes invalid values. Also check _MVAR. Check parameter for the tool offset target (_KNUM) and the measurement variant (S_MVAR).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check measuring axis/offset axis
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check the parameter for the measuring axis (X, Y, Z).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check measuring direction
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Milling measuring cycles: - Check the measuring direction (+/-) entered in the mask. Turning measuring cycles: - Check the current pre-positioning of the workpiece probe with reference to the entered inner or outer measurement (setpoint).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Program reset required
desc_en: NC reset required. Execute NC reset.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check D number
desc_en: The D number in parameter _KNUM is larger than the maximum value in the machine data 18105 $MN_MM_MAX_CUTTING_EDGE_NO. Only cutting edges 1 and 2 are permitted for the "simultaneous measurement" function. Check the parameter for the tool offset target (S_KNUM1). Check the value in the machine data 18105 $MN_MM_MAX_CUTTING_EDGE_NO.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check rotary axis
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Coordinate rotation active
desc_en: No measuring possible in the rotated coordinate system. Check the conditions for measuring.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Angle too large, change measuring axis
desc_en: The parameter Start angle (alpha 0) is too large for the specified measuring axis. Select a different measuring axis or check the value for the start angle.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Modify tool tip position
desc_en: The tool tip is below the measuring probe surface (e.g. for a ring gauge or cube). Place the tool above the measuring probe surface.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check calibration block number
desc_en: The _CALNUM parameter is too large.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check safety area
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check parameters for the protection area: -XS -YS -ZS

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Reserved
desc_en: Alarm triggered: Reserved reserved

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Geometry axes do not exist
desc_en: Not all the geometry axes required for measurement or machining are configured. Machine data 20060[0..2] $MC_AXCONF_GEOAX_NAME_TAB must be checked and, if necessary, changed.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check measuring input
desc_en: Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Positioning speed equal to zero
desc_en: In some measuring variants, e.g. measuring spigots (CYCLE977), intermediate paths are generated in addition to the actual measuring paths. These are traversed at a specific feed rate. The values for the feed rate can be found in the setting data 55634 $SCS_MEA_FEED_PLANE_VALUE, 55636 $SCS_MEA_FEED_FEEDAX_VALUE and 55640 $SCS_MEA_FEED_CIRCLE. Check the values for the feed rate in the setting data 55634 $SCS_MEA_FEED_PLANE_VALUE, 55636 $SCS_MEA_FEED_FEEDAX_VALUE and 55640 $SCS_MEA_FEED_CIRCLE.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2:Correction factor for rapid traverse speed = 0
desc_en: The correction factor for rapid traverse speed is 0. Check setting data 55632 $SCS_MEA_FEED_RAPID_IN_PERCENT.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Incorrect alarm number
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Internal error in measuring cycles.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe not calibrated in active plane or wrong calibration data record
desc_en: The probe is not calibrated in the active plane or an incorrect calibration data set has been selected. Calibrate the probe before measuring. Check the number of the probe calibration data field in parameter S_PRNUM. Note planes G17, G18 and G19. Only G18 is permitted for workpiece measurement when turning. Check: Setting data 54611 $SNS_MEA_WP_FEED[S_PRNUM-1] > 0 after calibration

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Upgrade NCK software version
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Upgrade NCU software version.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: %[[channel %1: ] block %2:%]Tool does not exist: %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check the tool name.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Several tools are active
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Remove tool from another spindle.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: D number of tool offset, too many digits
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Reduce the D number in _KNUM or check MD of flat D number.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Distance between starting point and measuring point is smaller than or equal to zero
desc_en: The distance between the starting point and the measuring point is less than or equal to 0. The parameters X1 or X2 are not occupied or smaller than 0. Check parameters X1 and X2.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Angle 1st edge - 2nd edge equals 0
desc_en: The parameter following angle (alpha 1) is 0. Check the parameter following angle (alpha 1).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Angle rel. to reference edge equals 0
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Programm continuation: Clear alarm with the RESET key. Restart part program Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Distance upper probe edge - measuring position = 0 for tool radius measurement
desc_en: The distance between the upper edge and lower edge of the tool probe is 0. This is relevant for radius measurement. Check the setting data 54634 $SNS_MEA_TP_CAL_MEASURE_DEPTH.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Feed, speed not programmed for tool measurement with rotating spindle
desc_en: No feed rate or spindle speed is programmed for tool measurement with rotating spindle. Check parameters F1 and S1.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool length or radius is 0
desc_en: The active tool length or the active tool radius is 0. Cutter: - Check length and radius of the active tool in the compensation data memory Drill: - Check length of the active tool in the compensation data memory - Radius or tip angle of the active tool must be predefined in the compensation data memory

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Path for logfile not permitted
desc_en: The specified path for the log file is incorrect. Check the programmed path specification. Check parameter _PROTNAME[0]. Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Path for logfile not found
desc_en: The specified directory does not exist or the specified path is incorrect. Check the programmed path specification. Check parameter _PROTNAME[0].

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Log file not found
desc_en: No name specified for the log file. Check the programmed path specification. Check parameter _PROTNAME[0].

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Incorrect file type for logfile
desc_en: The file extension for the log file is incorrect. The file extensions .txt and .csv are permitted. Check parameter _PROTNAME[0].

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Logfile is being used
desc_en: The log file is already used by an NC program.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: %[[Channel %1: ] Block %2: %] Not enough NC memory or too many files/directories in the NC
desc_en: There is not enough NC memory available or there are too many files or directories in the NC file system. Delete files whose names are comprised exclusively of numbers, e.g. "201202100938202_MPF", in the directory / _N_WKS_DIR/_N_TEMP_WPD. Also check whether other files in this directory can be deleted. Check, and if required, increase machine data 18320: $MN_MM_NUM_FILES_IN_FILESYSTEM.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Error during logging: WRITE command %4
desc_en: Internal error caused by the WRITE command. Causes of error codes: 10 The file size specified in MD11420 $MN_LEN_PROTOCOL_FILE has been reached (file is full). Machine data MD11420 must be set to a value of at least 20 kB, and this sets the maximum size of the log file. - Increase the value in MD11420 or - Select log data "new" in cycle150 (data are overwritten) or - Delete log file or - Create new log file (change the name of the log file in CYCLE150) Error code 10 occurs only when logging in the passive file system of the NC. 13 The protection level must be greater than or equal to the Write right of the stated log file. 16 Check the path of the log file (invalid external path). Other errors: See Programming Guide: WRITE command Save measurement results: After eliminating the cause of the error, the associated log can be generated with the function "Report last measurement".

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Error recording in table format: %4
desc_en: Internal error

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Error recording in JOG: %4
desc_en: Internal error Call the hotline!

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Error reporting last measurement %4
desc_en: Internal error Call the hotline!

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tolerance of the linear vector %4 exceeded
desc_en: If the error comes from CYCLE996 or CYCLE9960: The tolerance of the linear vectors is exceeded during the measurement of the kinematics. The value of the tolerance is transferred in parameter TLIN. If TLIN=0 or tolerance (check) = no, the measured vectors are not monitored. A 2nd measurement with a larger tolerance can be made for the analysis. The kinematic data should not be overwritten. The newly measured vectors are documented in the measurement log (data file).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tolerance of the rotary axis vector %4 exceeded
desc_en: The rotary axis orientation is also calculated during kinematic measurement. If the deviation is negligible and only the tolerance range is too small, this can be changed in $SN_CORR_TRAFO_DIR_MAX. A deviation of the rotary axis orientation can also have a mechanical cause. Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check distance between measuring points %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. In automatic mode, the Distance measuring points (_ID) parameter must be checked. In JOG mode, the selected measuring points are congruent. The measuring points must be redefined.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check circular feed
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check parameter SD55640 $SCS_MEA_FEED_CIRCLE

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Direction of rotation for tool measurement with rotating spindle not specified.
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check setting data 54674 $SNS_MEA_CM_SPIND_ROT_DIR. Permissible values are 3 (corresponds to M3) or 4 (corresponds to M4)

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2: parameters %4 are identical
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Specify different positions for the relevant points of P1(X1,Y1), P2(X2,Y2), P3(X3,Y3) and P4(X4,Y4).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2: straights through parameter %4 do not intersect
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Specify different positions for the relevant points of P1(X1,Y1), P2(X2,Y2), P3(X3,Y3) and P4(X4,Y4).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Position of corner not clearly definable, check parameter %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Define points P1(X1,Y1) and P2(X2,Y2) or P3(X3,Y3) and P4(X4,Y4) so that the intersection of the straight lines passing through these points lies outside the sections formed by P1(X1,Y1) and P2(X2,Y2) or P3(X3,Y3) and P4(X4,Y4).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Product of column width and number of columns is greater than %4 characters per line
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check user programming in CUST_MEAPROT.SPF.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: selected meas.variant requires SPOS-capable spindle
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Change the measuring variant or check the machine equipment. If the error message comes from CYCLE9960: Calibration of the probe on ball is not possible with non-SPOS-capable spindle. Select measuring variant without calibration.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: No SPOS-capable spindle available
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. - Check configuration/parameterization of the spindle axis - If the intention to use a 3D workpiece probe at a "non-SPOS capable spindle", then check the setting of MD 52207 $MCS_AXIS_USAGE_ATTRIB[n], bit 9 (also see Commissioning instructions, cycles) - If a 3D workpiece probe is attached to the machine outside the spindle, then check the setting of MD 51740 $MNS_MEA_FUNCTION_MASK, bit 4. (also see Commissioning instructions, cycles)

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe not calibrated in axis direction %4
desc_en: The probe is not calibrated in the specified axis direction. The result of the axis calibration is deleted if the following conditions change between two calibration processes: - Measuring speed - Spindle position - Rotations of the coordinate system - Reference of probe length to ball end or center (MD51740 Bit 1) - Correction of ball diameter in tool or calibration data (MD54740 Bit 3) Calibrate the probe in the specified axis direction. Check part program and make sure that no condition mentioned above has been changed between two calibrations.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Trigger values of measuring sensor are incompatible
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Trigger values of the tool measuring sensor must be fully described either via the _TP[] / _TPW[] fields or via the setting data (SD: 54625-54632 or SD: 54640-54647). A mixture of the two variants is not permitted.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Number of teeth missing from tool parameters
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Enter the number of teeth of the tool in the tool management.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Dimensional tolerance %4 exceeded
desc_en: Error message is displayed while measuring the kinematics of a grinding machine: When the kinematics are measured (CYCLE496), it is checked whether the measured vectors lie within the tolerance value of setting data $SCS_GRIND_MEA_KIN_TOL. Error message is displayed while measuring the kinematics of a grinding machine: Enter the vectors of the kinematics in advance so that the tolerance value in setting data 55844 $SCS_GRIND_MEA_KIN_TOL is not exceeded during the following measuring process.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool spindle is not the master spindle
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Before calling the measuring cycles, the tool spindle must be defined as master spindle (SETMS...). Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Too many teeth
desc_en: Tools with a maximum of 100 teeth can be measured. Check the number of teeth of the tool in tool management.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool probe width too small
desc_en: The width of the tool probe is too small. Check the following machine data: 51781 $MNS_MEA_T_PROBE_THICKNESS[n]

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Coupling the spindle position with coordinate rotation around %4 not executable
desc_en: The alarm relates to the cross-measuring tasks measuring cycle function "Coupling of spindle position with coordinate rotation around the infeed axis". This function requires a positionable spindle. If a positionable spindle is not available for holding the workpiece probe, the function "Coupling the spindle position with coordinate rotation around the infeed axis" can be deactivated with setting data 55740 $SCS_MEA_FUNCTION_MASK, bit 1=0.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 probe is attached to the machine, measuring variant is not possible
desc_en: The measuring variant cannot be executed with a probe permanently mounted on the machine. The selected measuring variant requires rotational positioning/alignment of the probe. Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Rotary axis 1: Diameter tolerance of calibration ball of measurement %4 exceeded
desc_en: CYCLE996: See measured diameter in the parameters _OVR[72] to _OVR[74] or the value in the SD $SCS_MEA_KIN_DM_TOL CYCLE9960: See measured diameter in the parameters _OVR[72] or the value in the SD $SCS_MEA_KIN_DM_TOL Check the calibration data or recalibrate the 3D probe. Check also the mechanical structure (stiffness) of the calibration ball in the machine.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Rotary axis 2: Diameter tolerance of calibration ball of measurement %4 exceeded
desc_en: CYCLE996: See measured diameter in the parameters _OVR[75] to _OVR[77] or the value in the SD $SCS_MEA_KIN_DM_TOL CYCLE9960: See measured diameter in the parameters _OVR[75] or the value in the SD $SCS_MEA_KIN_DM_TOL Check the calibration data or recalibrate the 3D probe. Check also the mechanical structure (stiffness) of the calibration ball in the machine.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe not calibrated in the coordinate system
desc_en: Probe has not been calibrated in the coordinate system set in MD52000 $MCS_DISP_COORDINATE_SYSTEM. Calibrate the probe before measurement.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Invalid protection level for executing measuring cycles %4
desc_en: The protection level is inadequate for the execution of measuring cycles. Check machine data 51742 $MNS_MEA_ACCESS_EXEC and 11160 $NM_ACCESS_EXEC_CST.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Internal execution error
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Call the SIEMENS hotline

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe does not switch, path reduced by software end position %4
desc_en: The traversing path would extend beyond the software end position on the current measuring axis. The traversing path has currently been shortened, and does not reach the position specified as a setpoint. Alarm 61401 is output after 5 unsuccessful contact attempts. - Check setpoint value specification. - Reduce the measuring distance (DFA). - Place the workpiece further away from the software end position.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe collision, path reduced by software end position %4
desc_en: This alarm is only output with external measurements (web, spigot, ball) in conjunction with a possible collision in the infeed axis. The collision is caused by the reduction of the path in the measuring axis of the working plane, before lowering the infeed axis to the measuring height. The probe was switched during the following infeed in the infeed axis. If the path had not been reduced, the traversing movement would have extended beyond the software end position of the working plane, and the corresponding NCK alarm 10722 would have been triggered. Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Work offset correction not executed
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. The measurement result contains more than one rotation component around the geometry axes of the coordinate system. However, only one of the rotation components of a rotary axis can be corrected. To prevent any consequential position errors, the offset of the selected rotary axis is not performed. "Correction into the coordinate system" must be selected as the bypass.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool correction not executed
desc_en: The offset of the selected tool could not be executed because of the current tool status. The following applies to tools without a tool status: - Must not be disabled, must have been active and in use. The following applies to tools that form a tool grouping: - Must not be disabled, must have been active and in use. Check the tool state and adapt accordingly.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool environment does not exist
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Correct the name of the tool environment (_TENV) or create this environment. Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check DL number
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check parameter DL. Check also the number of the sum and setup offset.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check 7th digit and higher of _KNUM
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. - Check parameter _KNUM. - Check the the number of the sum offset and that of the setup offset.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: total offsets not present
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Set MD 18080, Bit 8=1

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: set up offsets not present
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Set MD 18112, Bit 4=1 Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 access to nonexistent tool element or property
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. The variable to be corrected requires an option or an increase in MD values.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check the distribution of measuring points on the plane.
desc_en: The measuring points are poorly distributed on the measured plane. Possible causes: - All measuring points are in a row on one axis - The measuring points are too close together The setpoint and actual values must be checked and distributed differently if necessary.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: channel basic frame not present
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Set machine data 28081 $MC_MM_NUM_BASE_FRAMES > 0 or check $P_CHBFRMASK > 0.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: check setpoint of ball diameter, %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 : distortion of triangle over limit
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check the setpoint and actual values.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check probe / machining plane

title: Циклы · указатель

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check probe calibration L1 with reference to center of ball/ circumference of ball.
desc_en: Setting in MD 51740 $MNS_MEA_FUNCTION_MASK Bit 1 does not match calibration status in setting data 54610 $SNS_MEA_WP_STATUS_GEN[S_PRNUM]. Check the THOUSANDS digit: 1 = circumference; 0 = TCP (Tool Center Point) Check machine data 51740 $MNS_MEA_FUNCTION_MASK Bit 1 Remedy: 1. Recalibrate probe 2. Change probe number S_PRNUM 3. Adjust MD51740 Bit 1

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check calibration of multi/mono probes.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Software release of measuring cycles or NCK inadequate or set up incorrectly - error code %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Causes of error: Error code see %4 A -> _OVR[] - parameter field too small. Check GUD definition. B -> $SCS_MEA_KIN_MODE? SD55645 not set up

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2: parameter measuring variant incorrect - error code: %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Causes of error: See error code %4 A -> CYCLE996 _MVAR = 9x identifiers CYCLE996 measure kinematics or A -> CYCLE996 _MVAR ONES digit outside the value range 0..4 B -> CYCLE996 _MVAR (parameter for normalization) HUNDRED THOUSANDS digit (dec6) or B -> CYCLE996 ONE MILLION digit(dec7) outside the value range 0..3 C -> CYCLE996 Measurement version "compute kinematics" active, but rotary axes 1 and/or 2 not measured (see also parameter _OVR[40]) or rotary axis 2 exists and no rotary axis vectors (V2xyz) are set up. D -> CYCLE996 _MVAR TEN THOUSANDS digit (parameter rotary axis 1,2 or vector chain open, closed) outside the value range 0..3 1 -> CYCLE9960 S_MVAR ONES to TEN THOUSANDS digit outside the value range 2 -> CYCLE9960 S_MVAR TENS digit not compatible with the ONES DIGIT 3 -> CYCLE9960 S_MVAR TENS digit outside the value range 0,2

Causes of error: See error code %4 Check the overview of active offsets ($P_ACTFRAME) Delete offsets in the rotary axes A -> sum of the translatory offsets of geometry axes <> 0 B -> sum of the fine offsets of the geometry axes <> 0 C -> sum of the rotary components of the geometry axes <> 0 D -> sum of the translatory offsets of rotary axis 1 <> 0 E -> sum of the translatory offsets of rotary axis 2 <> 0

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Measuring axis (rotary axis 1 or 2) not in basic or intended position - Error code: %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Error causes: See Error code %4 A -> Rotary axis 1 not in basic position for 1st measurement B -> Rotary axis 2 not in basic position for 1st measurement C -> Rotary axis 2 not rotated for the 2nd or 3rd measurement with reference to the 1st measurement -> see parameter _OVR[63 to 65] D -> Rotary axis 1 not rotated for the 2nd or 3rd measurement with reference to the 1st measurement -> see parameter _OVR[60 to 62] 1 (RA1) -> CYCLE9960 Rotary axis 1 initially not in basic position 2 (AMODE DEC5) -> Selected basic position is not permissible

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Kinematic vectors not computed - Error code: %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Causes of error: see error code %4 A -> Plausibility of the input points PM1, PM2, PM3 not fulfilled, resulting side lengths must not be equal to zero (Notice: even in the case of side lengths not equal to zero, there is a risk of not being able to form a triangle => check PM1...3!) B -> Enclosed angle at PM1 between the spread vectors PM1PM2 and PM1PM3 is equal to 0. Starting points do not form a triangle. C -> Enclosed angle at PM2 between the spread vectors PM2PM1 and PM2PM3 is equal to 0. Starting points do not form a triangle. D -> Enclosed angle at PM3 between the spread vectors PM3PM1 and PM3PM2 is equal to 0. Starting points do not form a triangle. E -> Normalizing interpolation point: Invalid axis name defined for computation F -> Normalizing interpolation point: Invalid plane defined for computation G -> If the computed angle is smaller than the limiting value of the angular segment of the rotary axis in parameter TVL. The computed limit angle and the name of the rotary axis are displayed. With values of TVL < 20 degrees, inaccuracies are to be expected as a result of measuring inaccuracies in the micrometer range of the probe. Example: "61429 .. G Axis:C->TVLmin=12.345" Remedy: Adjust angular value of rotary axis in user program or parameter TVL. With complete measurement of kinematics with CYCLE9960, the value for the limit angles is entered in SD $SCS_MEA_KIN_MIN_ANG_TRIANGLE (minimum internal angle of the measuring triangle) "CC Option ? " -> Option compile cycle "Measurement of kinematics" not set "$MN_CC_ACTIVE_IN_CHAN_C996[0] ? " -> machine data for compile cycle not set "License ? " -> License for "Measurement of kinematics" not set When measuring head kinematics without offset (spindle extension), an alternative calculation is performed with error message A or G. This applies on condition that the rotary axis to be measured has been repositioned H -> Conditions for alternative calculation not fulfilled (rotary axis not positioned -> see _OVR[60] to _OVR]62] or SD55648 $SCS_MEA_KIN_MIN_ANG_POS smaller than the difference of the rotary axis positions in _OVR[60] to _OVR]62] I -> Conditions for alternative calculation not fulfilled (rotary axis not positioned -> see _OVR[60] to _OVR]62]

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: %4 not active or not created
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. The transformation / tool carrier to be measured must be active before CYCLE9960 is started. Check whether the specified transformation / tool carrier has been created. If this is the case, check whether the transformation / tool carrier was activated before calling CYCLE9960. It is also possible that an incorrect transformation / tool carrier is active. or S_TNAME=0 -> No TCARR or no transformation was specified for measuring.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Position of cutting edge cannot be determined
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. A turning tool with a cutting edge position between 1 and 8 must be used as the tool type. Check the entered cutting edge position with reference to the basic position of the tool carrier.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Position of cutting edge is not in the machining plane.
desc_en: The cutting edge position of the turning tool (cutting edge plate) is no longer in the machining plane (interpolation plane), e.g. caused by an orientable tool carrier. Check the tool carrier position and, if necessary, correct it! Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2025, A5E40876606B AJ

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool carrier not parallel to the geometry axes
desc_en: After positioning the orientable tool carrier, the tool lengths L1, L2 and L3 are not parallel to the geometry axes. Check the positioning behavior of the rotary axes (e.g. blocking) of the tool carrier.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Advance angle %4 or greater/less than +/-90° or +/-120°
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check the value in the alpha 1 advance angle parameter! If 3-point measurement is selected, alpha 1 must not be greater/smaller than +/-120°, and if 4-point measurement is selected, alpha 1 must not be greater/smaller than +/-90°! The parameter of the advance angle alpha 1 must always be set to a value other than "zero".

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Current measuring speed is not identical to the calibration speed
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. The relevant calibration speed is also stored in each calibration data record. The current measuring speed with feedrate override of 100% is not equal to the calibration speed. After calibration, the calibration speed value must be in the following setting data. For workpiece measurement: SD 54611 $SNS_MEA_WP_FEED[S_PRNUM-1] > 0 For tool measurement: SD 54636 $SNS_MEA_TP_FEED[S_PRNUM-1] > 0 for calibration in the machine coordinate system SD 54651 $SNS_MEA_TPW_FEED[S_PRNUM-1] > 0 for calibration in the workpiece coordinate system Recalibrate probe or specify new S_PRNUM.

title: Циклы · указатель

For cutting edge positions 1-4, the holder angle must be greater than or equal to 90° and less than 180°, for cutting edge positions 5-8, it must be greater than 0° and less than 90°.
