title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 tool radius compensation activated without tool number
desc_en: A tool T... must be selected so that the control can make allowance for the associated compensation values. A correction data block (D1) containing the correction values (parameter P1 - P25) is automatically assigned to each tool (T number). Up to 9 correction data blocks can be assigned to a tool by specifying the required data block with the D number (D1 - D9). The cutter radius compensation (CRC) is allowed for if function G41 or G42 is programmed. The correction values are contained in parameter P6 (geometry value) and P15 (wear value) of the active correction data block Dx. Before calling the TRC with G41/G42, program a tool number under the address T... NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 danger of collision due to tool radius compensation
desc_en: The "Bottleneck detection" (calculation of intersection for the following compensated traversing blocks) has not been able to calculate a point of intersection for the reviewed number of traversing blocks. It is therefore possible that one of the equidistant paths violates the workpiece contour. Inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check the part program and, if possible, modify the programming so that inside corners with smaller paths than the correction value are avoided. (Outside corners are not critical because the equidistants are lengthened or intermediate blocks are inserted, so that there is always a point of intersection). Increase the number of reviewed traversing blocks via machine data MD20240 $MC_CUTCOM_MAXNUM_CHECK_BLOCKS (default: 3), this increases the amount of computing capacity required and consequently also the block change time. Further possible remedies: - Program CDOF2 for 3D-WRK(CUT3DC) - Program CDOF for 2D-WRK - Program CUT2DF instead of CUT2D (default) for 2D-WRK using frames with rotation

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 overflow of local block buffer with tool radius compensation (%3, %4)
desc_en: The tool radius compensation must buffer a variable number of intermediate blocks in order to enable calculation of the equidistant tool path for each NC block. The size of the buffer cannot be determined by simple means. It depends on the number of blocks without traversing information in the compensation plane, the number of contour elements to be inserted and the shape of the curvature in spline and polynomial interpolation. The size of the buffer must not exceed the size of the system memory. Additional information about the error state Error code (3rd parameter). 0 = Overrun of the local block buffer for tool radius compensation. 1 = Local block buffer is presumably parameterized too large by the number of missing blocks (4th parameter).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 selection of the tool radius compensation only possible in linear block
desc_en: Selection of tool radius compensation with G41/G42 may only be performed in blocks where the G function G00 (rapid traverse) or G01 (feed) is active. In the block with G41/G42, at least one axis in the plane G17 to G19 must be written. It is always advisable to write both axes because, as a rule, both axes are traversed when selecting the compensation. Correct the NC program and put the compensation selection in a block with linear interpolation.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 deselection of the tool radius compensation only possible in linear block
desc_en: Deselection of tool radius compensation with G40 can only be performed in blocks where the G function G00 (rapid traverse) or G01 (feed) is active. In the block with G40, at least one axis in the plane G17 to G19 must be written. It is always advisable to write both axes because, as a rule, both axes are traversed when deselecting the compensation. Correct the NC program and put the compensation selection in a block with linear interpolation.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 selection of the tool radius compensation via KONT not possible at the current starting point

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 deselection of the tool radius compensation via KONT not possible at the programmed end point
desc_en: On deselection of the cutter radius compensation, the programmed end point is within the compensation circle. If this point were in fact to be approached without compensation, there would be a contour violation. If the cutter radius compensation is deselected via G40, the approach behavior (NORM or KONT) determines the compensation movement if the programmed end point is behind the contour. With KONT, a circle is drawn with the cutter radius about the last point at which the compensation is still active. The tangent passing through the programmed end position and not violating the contour is the retraction movement. If the start point is within the compensation circle around the target point, no tangent passes through this point. Place deselection of the CRC such that the programmed end point comes to rest outside the compensation circle around the last active compensation point. The following possibilities are available: Deselection in the next block Insert intermediate block Select retract behavior NORM

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Impermissible change of orientation while tool radius compensation is active
desc_en: An orientation change has been programmed which is not permissible with the active tool radius compensation type (G code of group 22, e.g. CUT2D or CUT2DF). As a rule, changes to the tool orientation are only permissible and useful if 3D tool radius compensation is active. An (impermissible) orientation change can also be triggered by a change of machining plane (G17 - G19). NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curvature radius with variable compensation value too small
desc_en: The current cutter radius compensation (the cutter used) is too large for the programmed path radius. In a block with variable tool radius compensation, a compensation must be possible either anywhere or nowhere on the contour with the smallest and the largest compensation value from the programmed range. There must be no point on the contour in which the curvature radius is within the variable compensation range. If the compensation value varies its sign within a block, both sides of the contour are checked, otherwise only the compensation side. Use smaller cutters or allow for a part of the cutter radius at the time of contour programming.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 path is parallel to tool orientation
desc_en: In a block with spline or polynomial interpolation, the corrected path runs parallel to the tool orientation in at least one point, i.e. the path has a tangent perpendicular to the compensation plane. The tangent at a point on a path is regarded as parallel to the tool orientation if the angle between the two directions is less than the limit value defined by MD21080 $MC_CUTCOM_PARALLEL_ORI_LIMIT. However, in circumferential milling, single straight lines running parallel to the tool orientation are permissible, as well as circles with a circle plane perpendicular to the compensation plane (application with smooth retraction from the groove). Also only individually, if the circle contains a point with a tangent parallel to the tool orientation. If a compressor (COMPCAD, COMPSURF) is active, the programmed straight lines (and possibly circles) are shown as non- linear polynomials, and that means a block with polynomial interpolation (see above). Straight lines in the direction of the tool orientation are not permissible in face milling (CUT3DF, CUT3DFS, CUT3DFF, CUT3DFD). Do not use splines or polynomials when writing the contour section, but straight lines and circles instead. Divide up the tool piece geometry and deselect the cutter radius compensation between the various sections.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 helical axis is not parallel to tool orientation
desc_en: With active tool radius compensation a helix is only permissible if the helix axis is parallel to the tool, i.e. the circle plane and the compensation plane must be identical. Orient helix axis perpendicular to the machining plane.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 tool radius compensation for ellipse with more than one revolution not possible
desc_en: When machining the inside of an ellipse, in parts of the ellipse the curvature radii are greater than or smaller than the cutter radius compensation. In ellipses, in this case the block would be split up into 4 subblocks with curvature radii that are greater than and less than the compensation radius. Over several revolutions, there would be a tremendous increase in the amount of calculation required by the unlimited number of resulting subblocks, and therefore this situation is rejected by the error message. If compensation is possible everywhere or nowhere on the ellipse, then ellipses are also permissible that cover more than one full revolution. Use cutter with smaller radius or program motion block on blocks with no more than one revolution.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 too many empty blocks between two traversing blocks with active tool radius compensation
desc_en: The maximum permissible number of empty blocks is limited by a machine data. - Modify part program - Modify machine data - Check whether SBL2 is activated. With SBL2, a block is generated from each part program line which can lead to exceeding the maximum permissible number of empty blocks between two traversing blocks.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 path component of the block in the compensation plane becomes zero
desc_en: Due to collision monitoring with active tool radius compensation, the path component of the block in the compensation plane becomes zero. If the original block contains no motion information perpendicular to the compensation plane, it means that this block is excluded. The alarm is a warning by default. It shows or writes in the alarm log which blocks are omitted, as information for the customer. Machining is not stopped. The alarm can be suppressed with MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit1 = 1. The alarm can be configured with MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK Bit16 = 1 so that the machining is stopped. This setting has priority over the above-mentioned behavior of MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK Bit1. - The behavior is correct at narrow places that cannot be machined with the active tool. - Modify the part program if necessary. - Use tool with smaller radius if necessary. - Program CDOF/CDOF2 if bottleneck detection is active.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 discontinuous path with active tool radius compensation
desc_en: This alarm occurs when, with active tool radius compensation, the starting point used for calculating the compensation is not identical to the end point of the preceding block. This situation can occur, for example, when a geometry axis is traversed between two positions as a positioning axis or when, with an active kinematic transformation (e.g. 5-axis transformation) the tool length compensation is altered. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Illegal change of surface orientation between block %2 and block %3
desc_en: This alarm occurs with 3D face milling when, at the time of block transition, the surface defined in the first block is continued in the second block with the rear side of the surface defined there. The block number in the alarm designates the second block. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 processing with tilt angle unequal 0 not possible
desc_en: When face milling with a torus milling cutter, the tilt angle must be 0 if the surface normal vector and the tool orientation include an angle that is less than the limiting angle given by the MD21082 $MC_CUTCOM_PLANE_PATH_LIMIT, i.e. in this case only the lead angle may be unequal to 0. Modify the part program. If necessary, use another tool (ball end mill).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal tool orientation with 3D tool radius compensation
desc_en: This alarm may occur during 3D face milling: the angle between the surface normal vector of the surface to be machined and the largest surface normal vector of the tool surface is smaller than the limit value given by MD21080 $MC_CUTCOM_PARALLEL_ORI_LIMIT, or the tool is oriented such that machining would have to be performed from the rear side of the surface. In this case, the largest surface normal vector is the vector the direction of which deviates most from the direction in the tool point (i.e. parallel to the tool longitudinal axis). With cylindrical tools or tools which end in a cylindrical part (e.g. the standard torus milling cutter), this vector is positioned perpendicular to the tool vector. For this type of tool, the alarm indicates that the angle between the tool longitudinal axis of, for example an envelope line of the cylinder, and the surface to be machined is smaller than the minimum permissible value. With tools the (valid) surface of which ends in a tapered part instead of a cylindrical part (e.g. a beveled cutter or a torus milling cutter where the torus is defined to be smaller than 90 degrees), this alarm indicates that the angle between an envelope line of the taper and the surface to be machined is smaller than the minimum permissible value. Modify the part program. If necessary, use another tool.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Illegal surface normal vector with 3D tool radius compensation
desc_en: In 3D face milling, surface normal vector and path tangent vector must theoretically be perpendicular to one another, i.e. they must be at 90° to one another. Since both vectors can be programmed independently of each other, deviations from this angle are possible and allowed. This alarm is generated when the angle between surface normal vector and path tangent vector becomes less than the limit angle given by the MD21084 $MC_CUTCOM_PLANE_ORI_LIMIT. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 change of corner type due to change of orientation with active tool radius compensation
desc_en: The type of a corner (inside or outside corner) depends not only on the programmed path but also on the tool orientation. For this purpose, the programmed path is projected in the plane perpendicularly to the actual tool orientation and the corner type is determined there. If a change in orientation is programmed (in one or several blocks) between two traversing blocks, resulting in the type of corner at the end of the first traversing block being different from that at the start point of the second block, the above error message is issued. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 overflow of local block buffer due to orientation smoothing
desc_en: This error occurs when more blocks must be buffered than memory space is available. This error can only occur when the software has been incorrectly configured. Increase size of local buffer area.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal orientation change when activating or deactivating 3D face cutting
desc_en: In face milling, no intermediate blocks with pure orientation change are allowed between the activation block and the first correction block or between the last correction block and the deactivation block (3D tool radius compensation). Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Illegal tool orientation in block %2 at inside corner with block %3

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Illegal tool dimensions with face cutting in block %2
desc_en: This alarm occurs when illegal tool dimensions are programmed for face milling, e.g. negative tool radius, rounding radius zero or negative for tool types that require a rounding radius, taper angle zero or negative for tapered tools. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Illegal tool change with face cutting in block %2
desc_en: This alarm occurs when a tool change has been programmed while 3D tool radius compensation is active with the result that the tool type changes or, if the tool type remains unchanged, at least one relevant tool dimension has changed as compared with the deselected tool. Depending on the tool type, relevant tool dimensions can be the tool diameter, the rounding radius or the taper angle. Changes to the tool length are allowed. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block%2 axis %3 must be geometry axis if tool radius compensation is active
desc_en: This alarm occurs when an axis that is required for tool radius compensation is not a geometry axis. With CUT2DF, the axis can be a positioning axis perpendicular to the machining plane; with all other types of compensation (CUT2DF, CUT3DC, CUT3DF, CUT3DFF), all geometry axes must be operated as such. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 tool radius compensation: too many blocks with suppression of compensation
desc_en: The maximum permissible number of blocks with active compensation suppression with tool radius compensation is limited by MD20252 $MC_CUTCOM_MAXNUM_SUPPR_BLOCKS. - Modify the part program. - Modify the machine data. - Check whether SBL2 is selected. If SBL2 is selected, a block is generated from each part program line. This can lead to exceeding the maximum permissible number of empty blocks between two traversing blocks.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 preprocessing stop with active tool radius compensation
desc_en: If a preprocessing stop is detected with active tool radius compensation (either programmed by the user or generated internally) and the SD42480 $SC_STOP_CUTCOM_STOPRE is set, then this warning is issued because in this situation machine movements which were not intended by the user can occur (termination of radius compensation and new approach). - Continue the machining with CANCEL and Start. - Modify the part program. - Set SD42480 $SC_STOP_CUTCOM_STOPRE to FALSE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Inadmissible tool for 3D circumferential milling with TRC.
desc_en: For 3D circumferential milling with active tool radius compensation (CUT3DC), tools with the relevant cutting edge position, e.g. turning and milling tools, tool types 400 - 599, are not permissible. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 impermissible change of a turning or grinding tool with active tool radius compensation
desc_en: A tool change in which the edge offset (difference between edge center and edge reference point) changes, is only permissible in straight and polynomial blocks. A tool change is not permissible in circular blocks, involute blocks and in blocks including rational polynomials with maximum permissible numerator and denominator degrees. - Continue machining with CANCEL and Start. - Modify the part program. - Set SD42480 $SC_STOP_CUTCOM_STOPRE to FALSE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal orientation of involute with tool radius compensation
desc_en: Tool radius compensation is possible for involutes only if the compensation plane matches the involute plane. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal curve type with tool radius compensation
desc_en: This alarm occurs, if an attempt is made to apply the tool radius compensation to a curve type for which this function is not implemented. The only cause at present: Involute with 3D tool radius compensation.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 tool radius compensation type requires orientation transformation
desc_en: This alarm occurs, if an attempt is made to activate a tool radius compensation which must enable a tool orientation change and the _Orientation transformation_ option is not available. This alarm can only occur if one of the following G code is active in the G code group 22: - CUT3DC - CUT3DCC - CUT3DCCD - Modify part program - Install "Orientation transformation" option

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal tool for tool radius compensation with constraint surface
desc_en: When activating the tool radius compensation with constraint surface, an illegal tool type is active. Only cutting tools of the tool types 1 to 399 are admitted with the following exceptions: - 111 ball end milling cutter - 155 torus milling cutter - 156 torus milling cutter - 157 torus milling cutter Use another tool.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Impermissible tool for TRC with difference tool
desc_en: Neither a turning nor a grinding tool nor any other tool with a relevant cutting edge position is permitted during the activation of the tool radius compensation with a difference tool.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Surface normal vector has not been programmed
desc_en: A function (for example 3D TRC face milling) requires the presence of a surface normal, but this has not been programmed. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Machine data for interpolation of the surface normals via polynomials not set
desc_en: A function (for example 3D TRC face milling) requires smoothed surface normal vectors. The machine data MD28291 $MM_SMOOTH_SURFACE_NORMALS (enable interpolation of the surface normals via polynomials) activates the required display of the surface normals via polynomials, but this has not been set. Set machine data MD28291 $MM_SMOOTH_SURFACE_NORMALS (enable interpolation of the surface normals via polynomials).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 plane change during linear programming with angles
desc_en: The active plane was changed between the first and second subblock when programming two straight lines with angle parameters. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 invalid angle during linear programming

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal interpolation type during linear programming with angles
desc_en: Only spline or linear interpolation is permitted for programming two straight lines with angle specification. Circular or polynomial interpolation is not allowed. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 second block missing during linear programming with angles
desc_en: The second block is missing during programming of two straight lines with angle specification. This situation only occurs if the first subblock is also the last block of a program, or if the first subblock is followed by a block with a preprocessor stop. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 angle specification missing in 2nd block during linear interpolation with angles
desc_en: The angle is missing from the second block when programming two straight lines with angle specification. This error can only occur if an angle was programmed in the preceding block, but no axis of the active plane was programmed in that block. The cause of the error may therefore also have been the intention to program a single straight line with an angle in the previous block. However, in this block, exactly one axis of the active plane must be programmed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 end point specification during angle programming contradictory
desc_en: The programming of a straight line specified both positions of the active plane and an angle. The position of the end point is thus over-specified. The alarm may also be output if the position of the programmed coordinate cannot be reached with the specified angle. If a contour consisting of two straight lines is to be programmed with angles, it is possible to specify the two axis positions of the plane and an angle in the second block. The error can also occur if, due to a programming error, the preceding block cannot be interpreted as the first subblock of such a contour. A block is interpreted as the first block of a two-block contour if an angle, but not an axis of the active plane, was programmed, and if the block itself is not already the second block of a contour. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 repositioning after switch of geometry axes or transformation
desc_en: In the asynchronous subroutine the assignment of geometry axes to channel axes was changed or the active transformation modified. Modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 master spindle not defined
desc_en: The function "Revolutional feedrate" (with G95 or G96), or "Rigid tapping" (with G331/G332) has been programmed, although no master spindle is defined from which the speed could be derived. For the definition the MD 20090 $MC_SPIND_DEF_MASTER_SPIND is available for the default or the keyword SETMS in the part program, thus allowing each spindle of the channel to be redefined as master spindle.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Rotary axis/spindle %2 not defined
desc_en: A revolutional feedrate has been programmed for path and synchronized axes or for an axis/spindle. However, the rotary axis/spindle from which the feedrate is to be derived is not available. Modify the part program or set SD43300 $SA_ASSIGN_FEED_PER_REV_SOURCE correctly.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 feedrate not programmed
desc_en: A traversing velocity has not been programmed for the displayed traversing block. Feed F or FZ: With the traversing velocity defined by feed F or FZ, F or FZ was not reprogrammed after the feed type changed, for example linear feed G94 after revolutional feedrate G95 F or G95 FZ. Modal feed FRCM: With modal traversing velocity FRCM defined for rounding RND or chamfering CHF, feed FRCM was not reprogrammed after the feed type changed, for example linear feed G94 after revolutional feedrate G95, or revolutional feedrate G95 F after tooth feedrate G95 FZ. Program feedrate in accordance with the interpolation type. - G93: The feedrate is specified as a time-reciprocal value under address F in [rev/min]. - G94 and G97: The feedrate is programmed under address F in [mm/min] or [m/min]. - G95: The feedrate is programmed as revolutional feedrate under address F in [mm/revolution] or under the address FZ in [mm/tooth]. - G96: The feedrate is programmed as cutting speed under address S in [m/min]. It is derived from the current spindle speed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %3 velocity of positioning axis %2 is zero
desc_en: No axis velocity has been programmed and the positioning velocity set in the machine data is zero. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Enter a different velocity in MD32060 $MA_POS_AX_VELO.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 master spindle also used as path axis
desc_en: A contour has been programmed that also includes the master spindle as contouring axis. However, the velocity of the contour is derived from the rotational speed of the master spindle (e.g. G95). Modify the program so that no reference is possible to the program itself.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 FZ active, but no tool offset, tool %3
desc_en: For the displayed traversing block a tooth feedrate is active, but no tool offset. Traversing can be performed after the error has been acknowledged. For calculation of the effective feedrate one tooth per revolution will be assumed. Check the NC program for correct tool selection and correct it, if required; then continue the program with NC start. Or: Continue the NC program with NC start. For calculation of the effective feedrate one tooth per revolution is assumed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 FZ is active, but the number of teeth of the active D number %4 of tool %3 is zero.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 facing axis for constant cutting speed not defined
desc_en: Constant cutting speed was selected although no transverse axis was applied as reference axis for constant cutting speed or assigned through SCC[AX]. Constant cutting speed can be activated as follows: - Basic position G96, G961 or G962 of G group 29 during booting - Programming of G96, G961 or G962 A reference axis for G96, G961 or G962 can be applied as a transverse axis in MD20100 $MC_DIAMETER_AX_DEF or defined through the instruction SCC[AX]. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check MD20100 $MC_DIAMETER_AX_DEF. Before programming G96, G961 or G962 a transverse axis must be defined as a reference axis for constant cutting speed via MD20100 $MC_DIAMETER_AX_DEF or SCC[AX].

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 too many empty blocks between two traversing blocks when inserting chamfers or radii
desc_en: Between 2 blocks containing contour elements and which are to be joined with a chamfer or a radius (CHF, RND), more blocks without contour information have been programmed than provided for in the MD20200 $MC_CHFRND_MAXNUM_DUMMY_BLOCKS. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Modify the part program in order that the permissible number of dummy blocks is not exceeded or adapt the channel-specific machine data MD20200 $MC_CHFRND_MAXNUM_DUMMY_BLOCKS (dummy blocks with chamfers/radii) to the maximum number of dummy blocks.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 overflow of local block buffer in the case of chamfers or radii
desc_en: Between 2 blocks containing the contour elements and to be joined with a chamfer or a radius (CHF, RND), so many dummy blocks have been programmed without contour information that the internal buffer is too small. Modify part program such that the number of dummy blocks is reduced.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 activation of chamfers or radii (non-modal) without traversing movement in the block
desc_en: No chamfer or radius has been inserted between 2 linear or circle contours (edge breaking) because: There is no straight line or circle contour in the plane There is a movement outside the plane A plane change has taken place The permissible number of empty blocks without traversing information (dummy blocks) has been exceeded. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Correct the part program according to the above error description or change the number of dummy blocks in the channel-specific MD20200 $MC_CHFRND_MAXNUM_DUMMY_BLOCKS to comply with the maximum number allowed for in the program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 chamfer or fillet has to be reduced
desc_en: This alarm is output if, when inserting chamfers or radii, at least one of the relevant blocks is so short that the contour element to be inserted must be reduced from its originally programmed value. The alarm occurs only if bit 4 is set in MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK. Otherwise, the chamfer or rounding is adapted without an alarm being output. Modify NC program of continue program without modifications after CANCEL and Start or with Start alone.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 overflow of local block buffer when calculating splines
desc_en: The maximum permissible number of empty blocks is limited by a machine data. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 multiplicity of node is greater than its order
desc_en: In the B spline the distance between nodes PL (node = point on spline at which 2 polynomials meet) has been programmed with zero too often in succession (i.e. the "multiplicity" of a node is too great). In the quadratic B spline the node distance may not be specified more than twice with 0 in succession, and in the cubic B spline not more than 3 times. Program the node distance PL = 0 in succession no more than the degree of the B spline used.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 no S value programmed for constant cutting speed
desc_en: If G96 is active, the constant cutting speed under address S is missing. Program constant cutting speed under S in [m/min] or deselect the function G96. For example, with G97 the previous feed is retained but the spindle continues to rotate at the current speed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 irregular velocity waveform of one path axis

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 transformation prohibits to traverse the pole
desc_en: The given curve passes through the pole of the transformation. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 negative feed profile is ignored
desc_en: The specified feedrate profile is in part negative. However, a negative path feedrate is not allowed. The feedrate profile is ignored. The specified feedrate block end value is taken when traversing over the entire block. Check the specified feedrate profile for incorrect programming, and correct it.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: movement not possible while transformation active.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Preparation problem in LookAhead (Identifier %3, Details %4)
desc_en: The NCK was incorrectly parameterized (under certain circumstances, the parameterized memory is not sufficient), which is why LookAhead can no longer be operated in the expansion mode. Change parameterization (increase LookAhead memory and/or IPO buffer, change tolerances). Use standard LookAhead. Contact Siemens if necessary.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Preparation problem in LookAhead (Identifier %3, Details %4)
desc_en: The NCK was incorrectly parameterized (under certain circumstances the parameterized memory is not sufficient), this is the reason that the generated profile is not as smooth and uniform as it could be. Change the parameterization (increase the LookAhead memory and/or IPO buffer, change tolerances). 1010: Increase IPO buffer to at least 50 blocks, or maximum number of blocks in the braking ramp times 2. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Warning of COMPSURF function (code %3, details %4)
desc_en: COMPSURF was only able to work with restrictions. The warning is only displayed if MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK bit1 is set. 1: Modify parameterization (smaller tolerance, larger block buffer).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 interpolation type not allowed in stock removal contour
desc_en: The following types of interpolation are allowed in the contour program for stock removal: G00, G01, G02, G03, CIP, CT In the contour subroutine, program only path elements that consist of straight lines and arcs.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 incorrect stock removal contour
desc_en: The following errors occurred in the subroutine for the contour during stock removal: - Full circle - Overlapping contour elements - Wrong start position The errors listed above must be corrected in the subroutine for the stock removal contour.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 preparation of contour has been restarted
desc_en: The first contour preparation/contour decoding run must be terminated with EXECUTE. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 contour programm does not contain enough contour blocks
desc_en: The contour program contains: - Less than 3 contour blocks with CONTPRON - No contour blocks with CONTDCON Increase the size of the program with the stock removal contour to include at least 3 NC blocks with movements in both axes of the current machining plane.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 array for contour segmentation is set too small
desc_en: During contour segmentation (activated with the keyword CONTPRON), the field for the contour table has been detected as too small. For every permissible contour element (circle or straight line) there must be a row in the contour table. Base the definition of the field variables of the contour table on the contour elements to be expected. The contour segmentation divides some NC blocks into as many as 3 machining cuts. Example: N100 DEF TABNAME_1 [30, 11] Field variables for the contour table provide for 30 machining cuts. The number of columns (11) is a fixed quantity.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: delete/overwrite not possible
desc_en: The curve table can only be deleted if it is not active in a link. Deactivate all links that use the curve table that is to be deleted.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Curve table %3: NC SRAM memory full, type %4
desc_en: There is Insufficient free dynamic memory available for definition of the curve table. The object type parameter specifies for which curve table object the memory is insufficient: 1: Number of curve tables too small (MD18400 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_TABS) 2: Number of linear curve table segments too small (MD18403 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEG_LIN) 3: Number of polynomial curve table segments too small (MD18402 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEGMENTS) 4: Number of curve table polynomials too small (MD18404 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_POLYNOMS) Inform the authorized personnel / service department. Delete curve tables that are no longer required, or reconfigure the memory space for the curve tables. Then define the curve table again with the following machine data: MD18400 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_TABS, MD18402 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEGMENTS, MD18403 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEG_LIN, MD 18404 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_POLYNOMS.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: illegal instruction during definition
desc_en: Various illegal command sequences cause this alarm to be output during the definition of the curve table. For example: The definition of a curve table cannot be completed with M30 before the CTABEND command has been programmed. Correct the part program and start it again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: direction reversal of lead value in the block not allowed
desc_en: The conditions for converting a programmed contour to a curve table were not fulfilled in this block. Correct the part program and start it again. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: illegal transformation
desc_en: It is impermissible to use a transformation in a curve table if the leading axis or following axis programmed in CTABDEF is involved in the transformation. Exception: TRAANG. Correct the NC part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: no contour defined
desc_en: No movement for the leading axis was programmed between CTABDEF and CTABEND. A curve table is not permitted without a contour. Correct the part program and start it again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: contour not continuous
desc_en: The contour in a curve table must be continuous. Incontinuity can occur, for example, as a result of activating a transformation. Correct the part program and start it again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: position jump at end of period
desc_en: A periodic curve table was defined in which the position of the following axis at the end of the table was different to the position at the start of the table. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: missing master axis motion
desc_en: A slave axis motion has been programmed without a master axis motion. Correct the part program and start it again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Calculation of arc length function too inaccurate
desc_en: With active polynomial interpolation, the arc length function could not be calculated with the required accuracy. Increase MD20262 $MC_SPLINE_FEED_PRECISION. Reserve more memory for the representation of the arc length polynomials. Use MD28540 $MC_MM_ARCLENGTH_SEGMENTS to specify how many polynomial segments can be used per block in order to approximate the arc length function.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: following value period is zero
desc_en: -- Check that the table specification is correct.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: missing master axis motion
desc_en: A slave axis motion has been programmed without a master axis motion. This can also occur if, with active radius compensation, a block is created in which the slave axis moves but not the master axis. The alarm is for information only and can be suppressed by setting MD20900 $MC_CTAB_ENABLE_NO_LEADMOTION = 2.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3: NC memory limit DRAM reached type %4.
desc_en: Insufficient memory in the DRAM while defining the curve table. The object type parameter specifies for which curve table object the memory will not suffice: 1: Number of curve tables too small (MD18406 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_TABS_DRAM) 2: Number of linear curve table segments too small (MD18409 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEG_LIN_DRAM) 3: Number of polynomial curve table segments too small (MD18408 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEGMENTS_DRAM) 4: Number of curve table polynomials too small (MD18410 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_POLYNOMS_DRAM) Delete the curve tables that are no longer required in DRAM or reconfigure the memory space for the curve tables. The curve table must then be redefined. Machine data for memory configuration of the curve tables in DRAM: MD18406 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_TABS_DRAM, MD18408 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEGMENTS_DRAM, MD18409 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEG_LIN_DRAM, MD18410 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_POLYNOMS_DRAM.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Lin. curve table %2, memory type %3 includes %4 polynomial segments.
desc_en: On generating the curve table with the specified ID in the specified memory type (1 = SRAM, 2 = DRAM), polynomial segments were used instead of possible linear segments. By increasing the number of linear curve table segments by the indicated number, the curve table can be saved in a better way. The following machine data are involved depending on the memory type: 1 (SRAM): MD18403 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEG_LIN 2 (DRAM): MD18409 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEG_LIN_DRAM The indicated curve table can be created and optimized for the memory by increasing MD18403 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEG_LIN or MD18409 $MN_MM_NUM_CURVE_SEG_LIN_DRAM and repeating table generation.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

desc_en: Smoothing by COMPSURF is not optimal because limited by internal memory sizes. The alarm only occurs if MD11400 $MN_TRACE_SELECT bit10 is set; otherwise only warning 10917 is output. Reduce tolerance (CTOL, OTOL, ATOL) in the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

desc_en: 1. When COMPSURF is active, more axes are traversed than are permissible for this system. 2. CUT3DFD is not permitted for this system. Reaction: Local alarm reaction. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Interpreter stop 1. Program fewer axes per block. 2. Deactivate CUT3DFD.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 continuous-path mode active during punching
desc_en: The active continuous-path mode G64x is ignored during punching/nibbling. Disable continuous-path mode with G60 during punching/nibbling.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Orientation function not possible
desc_en: This alarm can have the following causes: 1. Orientation smoothing cannot be activated with OSD or OST, because MD28580 $MC_MM_ORIPATH_CONFIG = 0. This MD must have the value 1. 2. The path-relative orientation cannot be activated with ORIPATH/ORIPATHS and MD21094 $MC_ORIPATH_MODE = 1 because MD28580 $MC_MM_ORIPATH_CONFIG = 0. This MD must have the value 1 if MD21094 $MC_ORIPATH_MODE = 1.. 3. The path-relative orientation interpolation cannot be activated with ORIROTC with 6-axis kinematics because MD28580 $MC_MM_ORIPATH_CONFIG = 0 but MD21094 $MC_ORIPATH_MODE = 1. If MD21094 $MC_ORIPATH_MODE = 1 then MD28580 $MC_MM_ORIPATH_CONFIG = 1 must also be set. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 orientation smoothing not possible with ORISON
desc_en: This alarm has the following cause: The smoothing of the orientation with ORISON is only possible if MD MD28590 $MC_MM_ORISON_BLOCKS >= 4. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель

desc_en: CPRECON is active, but for one axis with FIR filter (MD32402 $MA_AX_JERK_MODE=5) no memory space was provided with MD38020 $MA_MM_CPREC_FIR_POINTS. This is a configuration error. Provide memory space for the function with MD38020 $MA_MM_CPREC_FIR_POINTS.
