Modify part program: Only those valid gear stages can be entered which have also been installed according to MD35090 $MA_NUM_GEAR_STEPS. Limit M70 configuration (MD 35014 $MA_GEAR_STEP_USED_IN_AXISMODE) to MD35090 $MA_NUM_GEAR_STEPS.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 spindle %3 inserted gear stage %4 for tapping not installed
desc_en: The second gear stage data block has been activated for tapping with G331. However, the current gear stage has not been installed in the second gear stage data block. The number of gear stages installed is configured in MD35092 $MA_NUM_GEAR_STEPS2. The gear stage cannot be changed in traversing blocks. The gear stage appropriate for the speed must be loaded before the traversing block. Procedure for automatically engaging the suitable gear stage prior to thread cutting: * Program the spindle speed (S) in a G331 block without axis motions and prior to thread cutting, e.g. G331 S1000. * Activate M40 for the spindle.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 spindle %3 gear stage %4 expected
desc_en: G331 activates the second gear stage data block for tapping. The programmed speed (S) of the master spindle lies outside the speed range of the active gear stage in the current traversing block. The gear stage cannot be changed in the traversing block. The gear stage appropriate for the speed must be loaded prior to the traversing block. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 SPCON not programmed
desc_en: For the programmed function (rotary axis, positioning axis), the spindle must be in position control mode. Program position control of the spindle with SPCON in the previous block.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 spindle/axis %3 SPCOF not executable
desc_en: For the programmed function, the spindle must be in the open-loop control mode. In the positioning or axis mode, the position control must not be deselected. Put the spindle into open-loop control mode in the preceding block. This can be done with M3, M4 or M5 for the relevant spindle.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 for following spindle %3 coupling as leading spindle/axis already existing
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on in which the following spindle/axis has already been active as leading spindle/axis in another coupling. Chained couplings cannot be processed. Check in the part program whether the following spindle/axis is already active as leading spindle/axis in another coupling.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 for leading spindle %3 coupling as following spindle/axis already existing
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on in which the leading spindle/axis has already been active as following spindle/axis in another coupling. Chained couplings cannot be processed. Check in the part program whether the leading spindle/axis is already active as following spindle/axis in another coupling.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 S value missing
desc_en: No spindle speed has been given for rigid tapping (G331 or G332). Program the spindle speed under address S in [rpm] (in spite of axis mode); the direction of rotation is given by the sign of the spindle lead: - Positive thread pitch: Rotational direction as M03. - Negative thread pitch: Rotational direction as M04 N2.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis/spindle %3 not programmable in the channel
desc_en: Mistake in programming: The axis/spindle cannot be programmed in the channel at this time. This alarm can occur when the axis/spindle is being used by another channel or by the PLC. Modify the part program. Use "GET()".

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 spindle %3 thread function is active
desc_en: Incorrect programming: the spindle function can currently not be executed. This alarm occurs when the spindle (master spindle) is linked with the axes by an interpolation function.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 programmed speed is illegal (zero or negative)
desc_en: A spindle speed (S value) was programmed with the value zero or with a negative value. Program the speed (S value) with a positive value. Depending on the application case, the value zero may be permissible, e.g. G25 S0.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 following spindle/axis missing
desc_en: The following spindle/axis has not been written in the part program. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 string cannot be interpreted
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on in which a non-interpretable string has been written (e.g. block change behavior). Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 leading spindle/axis missing
desc_en: The master spindle/axis has not been programmed in the part program. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 too many couplings for axis %4
desc_en: For the specified axis/spindle, more master axes/spindles have been defined than are allowed. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 no measuring system available
desc_en: One of the following spindle functions has been programmed, the position control requires: SPCON, SPOS, SPOSA, COUPON, G331/G332. The position control requires at least one measuring system. No measuring system has been configured in MD30200 $MA_NUM_ENCS of the programmed spindle. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Retrofit a measuring system.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %3 following axis %2 overlaid movement not enabled
desc_en: No gear synchronization and no overlay movement can be executed for the stated axis because this is not enabled at the VDI interface. This alarm can be supressed with MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2 bit17 = 1 or for CP programming with CPMALARM[FAx] bit11 = 1. Set the NC/PLC interface signal DB31, ... DBX26.4 (enable following axis overlay). NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 is the slave axis, the coupling is being opened
desc_en: The axis is active as a following axis in a coupling. In REF operating mode, the coupling is opened. The alarm can be suppressed with MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit 29 = 1 or with CP programming by setting CPMALARM[FAx] bit 0 = 1. The coupling will be closed again after having exited the REF operation mode.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 is the following axis. The axis/spindle disables of leading axes %3 and %4 differ from one another.
desc_en: The axis is active in a coupling as a following axis. The leading axes have different states regarding axis/spindle disable. The alarm can be suppressed with MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2, bit 0 = 1 or with CP programming by setting CPMALARM[FAx] bit 1 = 1. Set the same axis/spindle disable for all master axes.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Synchronization canceled for slave axis/spindle %2
desc_en: For the indicated axis, the synchronization procedure (EGONSYN or EGONSYNE) was canceled. There are several reasons for canceling the synchronization process: - RESET - End of program - Axis goes to follow-up mode - Rapid stop caused by an alarm If canceling the synchronization procedure can be tolerated or is intended, the alarm can be suppressed with MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit 31 = 1 or with CP programming by setting CPMALARM[FAx] bit 2 = 1. Only applicable for electronic gear (EG): If it is not possible to cancel the synchronization procedure, specify the block change criterion FINE in EGONSYN or EGONSYNE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 axis %4 no measuring system available
desc_en: One of the following spindle functions has been programmed, the position control requires: SPCON, SPOS, SPOSA, COUPON, G331/G332. The position control requires at least one measuring system. No measuring system has been configured in MD30200 $MA_NUM_ENCS of the programmed spindle. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Retrofit a measuring system.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table %3 does not exist for axis %4
desc_en: An attempt was made to couple axis %4 with curve table number %3, but no curve table of this number exists. Modify the NC part program so that the required curve table exists when axis coupling is to be activated.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 coupling: Ring coupling at following axis %3 and leading axis %4 impermissible
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on which results in a cyclic coupling, allowance being made for further couplings. This cyclic coupling cannot be uniquely computed. Inform the authorized personnel/service department. Configure the coupling in accordance with MD21300 $MC_COUPLE_AXIS_1 or correct the NC part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 coupling: too many couplings for axis %3, see active leading axis %4
desc_en: More leading axes and spindles were defined for the specified axis/spindle than are allowed. The last parameter to be specified is a leading value object/leading axis to which the specified axis/spindle is already linked. Correct the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 following spindle/axis missing
desc_en: The following spindle/axis has not been written in the part program. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 master spindle/axis missing
desc_en: The master spindle/axis has not been programmed in the part program. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 following spindle/axis %3 not available
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on in which the slave spindle/axis is currently not available. Possible causes: - The spindle/axis is active in the other channel. - The spindle/axis has been accessed by the PLC and has not yet been released. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Put the master spindle/axis with spindle/axis exchange into the necessary channel or release from the PLC.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 master spindle/axis %3 not available
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on in which the master spindle/axis is currently not available. Possible causes: - Setpoint linkage has been selected and spindle/axis is active in the other channel. - The spindle/axis has been accessed by the PLC and has not yet been released. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Put the master spindle/axis with spindle/axis exchange into the necessary channel or release from the PLC.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 identical spindles/axes %3
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on in which the following spindle/axis is identical to the master spindle/axis. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. - Configure link accordingly in MD21300 $MC_COUPLE_AXIS_1 - or modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 coupling parameter not changeable
desc_en: The specified coupling is write-protected. Therefore, the coupling parameters cannot be modified. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. - Remove write protection (see channel MD21340 $MC_COUPLE_IS_WRITE_PROT_1) - or modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 cyclic coupling
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on which results in a cyclic coupling, allowance being made for further couplings. This cyclic coupling cannot be uniquely computed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Parameter is zero or missing
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on in which a relevant parameter has been specified with zero or has not been written (e.g. denominator in the transmission ratio, no slave axis). Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. - Configure link accordingly in SD42300 $SC_COUPLE_RATIO_1 - or correct part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 parameter is not relevant
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on in which a non-relevant parameter has been written (e.g. parameter for ELG). Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 too many couplings for axis/spindle %3
desc_en: For the specified axis/spindle, more master axes/spindles have been defined than are allowed. Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 coupling of axis %3 prohibits transformation change
desc_en: The specified axis is a slave axis in a transformation grouping. When the coupling is switched on, the transformation cannot be changed to another one. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 coupling of axis/spindle %3 prohibits reference point approach
desc_en: The specified axis is a (gantry) slave axis and cannot therefore approach the reference point. Modify part program. Switch off coupling(s) of this axis before reference point approach or do not reference. A gantry slave axis cannot reference for itself.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 string cannot be interpreted
desc_en: A coupling has been switched on in which a non-interpretable string has been written (e.g. block change behavior). Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 coupling not defined
desc_en: A coupling is to be switched the parameters of which have neither been programmed nor configured. Inform the authorized personnel/service department. Correct the NC part program or MD, program the coupling with COUPDEF or configure by means of MD.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 coupling is active
desc_en: An operation is to be performed in which no coupling may be active, e.g. COUPDEL or TANGDEL must not be used on active couplings. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 is following axis and prohibits axis container rotation
desc_en: The programmed axis/spindle is active as a slave axis/spindle in a coupling. When the coupling is active, the axis container cannot be rotated. Correct the part program. Deactivate the coupling(s) for this axis/spindle before rotating the axis container or rotate the axis container at a later time.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 is master axis and prohibits axis container rotation
desc_en: The programmed axis/spindle is active as a master axis/spindle in a coupling. When the coupling is active, the axis container cannot be rotated. Correct the part program. Deactivate the coupling(s) for this axis/spindle before rotating the axis container or rotate the axis container at a later time.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 traverse instruction DC/CDC for axis %3 not allowed
desc_en: The keyword DC (Direct Coordinate) can only be used for rotary axes. This causes approach of the programmed absolute position along the shortest path. Example: N100 C=DC(315)

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 traverse instruction ACP for axis %3 not allowed
desc_en: The keyword ACP (Absolute Coordinate Positive) is only allowed for "modulo axes". It causes approach of the programmed absolute position in the specified direction. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. In the displayed NC block, replace the keyword ACP by specifying AC (Absolute Coordinate). If the alarm display is based on an incorrect axis definition, the axis with the axis-specific MD30300 $MA_IS_ROT_AX and MD30310 $MA_ROT_IS_MODULO can be declared a rotary axis with modulo change. Corresponding machine data: Modify MD30320 $MA_DISPLAY_IS_MODULO

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 traverse instruction ACN for axis %3 not allowed
desc_en: The keyword ACN (Absolute Coordinate Negative) is only allowed for "modulo axes". It causes approach of the programmed absolute position in the specified direction. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. In the displayed NC block, replace the keyword ACN by specifying AC (Absolute Coordinate). If the alarm display is based on an incorrect axis definition, the axis with the axis-specific machine data MD30300: $MA_IS_ROT_AX and MD30310: $MA_ROT_IS_MODULO can be declared a rotary axis with modulo change. Corresponding machine data: MD30320: $MA_DISPLAY_IS_MODULO

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 incorrect position programmed for axis/spindle %3
desc_en: A position beyond the range of 0 - 359.999 has been programmed for a modulo axis. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Program control: action '%2<ALNX>' not allowed in the current state
desc_en: The operation (program, JOG, block search, reference point, etc.) cannot be started or continued in the current status. Check the program status and the channel status.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Program control: action '%2<ALNX>' not allowed
desc_en: Operation cannot be started or continued. A start is only accepted when an NCK function can be started. Example: A start is accepted in JOG mode when, for example, the function generator is active or a JOG movement has first been stopped with the Stop key. Check the program status and the channel status.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Program control: action '%2<ALNX>' is canceled due to an alarm
desc_en: The action was canceled due to an alarm. Eliminate the error and acknowledge the alarm. Then restart the operation.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' only possible in stop state
desc_en: This action may only be performed in Stop state. Check the program status and the channel status.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' only possible in reset state or at the block end

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' not allowed in current mode
desc_en: A different operating mode must be activated for the activated function. Check operation and operating mode.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Mode change is not allowed
desc_en: The change from overstoring into another operating mode is not allowed. Terminate the "Overstore" function to change to another operating mode.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Program control: action '%2<ALNX>' only possible in reset state
desc_en: This action can only be performed in Reset state. Example: Program selection through HMI or channel communication (INIT) can only be performed in Reset state. Reset or wait until processing has finished.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Mode group %1: ] [Channel %2: ] Mode change: action '%3<ALNX>' not allowed
desc_en: The change to the desired mode is not permitted. The change can only take place in the Reset state. Example: Program processing is halted in AUTO mode by NC Stop. Then there is a mode change to JOG mode (program status interrupted). From this operating mode, it is only possible to change to AUTO mode and not to MDI mode! Either actuate the Reset key to reset the program execution, or select the mode in which the program was previously being executed.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Mode group %1: ] [Channel %2: ] Mode change: action '%3<ALNX>' not allowed
desc_en: Incorrect mode change, e.g.: Auto -> MDIREF. Check the operation and/or the selected mode.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' not allowed in the current block
desc_en: If traversing blocks are interrupted by asynchronous subroutines, then it must be possible for the interrupted program to continue (reorganization of block processing) after termination of the asynchronous subroutine. The 2nd parameter describes which action wanted to interrupt block processing. Let the program continue to a reorganized NC block or modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Repositioning: action '%2<ALNX>' not allowed in the current state
desc_en: Repositioning of block processing is presently not possible. A mode change cannot take place. The 2nd parameter describes which action should be used to perform repositioning. Let the program continue to a repositioned NC block or modify the part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] For action '%2<ALNX>' all channels must be in reset state
desc_en: All channels must be in the initial setting in order to carry out the action! (For example, for machine data loading) Either wait until the channel status is canceled or press the Reset key.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' is not allowed due to a pending alarm
desc_en: This action cannot be performed due to an alarm, or the channel is in the fault condition. Press the Reset key.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' is already active
desc_en: An identical action is still being processed. Wait until the previous procedure has been completed and then repeat the operation.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Mode group %2: ] [Channel %1: ] Machine data: channel/mode group assignment not allowed or assigned twice
desc_en: On powering up, an illegal channel/mode group assignment was detected. Inform the authorized personnel/service department. Check MD10010 $MN_ASSIGN_CHAN_TO_MODE_GROUP.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Subprograms: action '%2<ALNX>' maximum nesting depth exceeded
desc_en: Various actions can cause the current procedure to be interrupted. Depending on the action, asynchronous subroutines are activated. These asynchronous subroutines can be interrupted in the same manner as user programs. Unlimited nesting depth is not possible for asynchronous subroutines due to memory limitations. Example: An interrupt interrupts the current program processing. Other interrupts with higher priorities interrupt processing of the previously activated asynchronous subroutines. Possible actions are: DryRunOn/Off, DecodeSingleBlockOn, delete distance-to-go, interrupts ..... Do not trigger the event on this block.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Program control: action '%2<ALNX>' not allowed in the current state
desc_en: The current processing cannot be stopped since a preprocessing process is active. This applies, for example, to the loading of machine data, and in block searches until the search target is found. Cancel the procedure by pressing Reset. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Caution: program test modifies tool management data
desc_en: Tool management data is changed during program testing. It is not possible to automatically rectify the data after termination of the program testing. Inform the authorized personnel/service department. Save the tool data on HMI and reimport this data after "ProgtestOff".

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Program control: action '%2<ALNX>' not allowed in the current state, action '%3<ALNX>' active
desc_en: The action has been rejected since a mode or sub-mode change (change to automatic mode, MDI, JOG, overstoring, digitizing, etc.) is taking place. Example: This alarm message is output if the Start key is pressed during a mode or sub-mode change from, for example, automatic to MDI, before the NCK has confirmed selection of the mode. Repeat the action.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Channel coordination: action %2 not allowed in block %3, marker %4 is already set
desc_en: The action was denied, the marker was already set. Check the program. Example: SETM(1) ; CLEARM(1) ; Marker must be reset first. SETM(1) Repeat the action.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' at active interrupt treatment not allowed
desc_en: This action may not be activated during interrupt processing (e.g. mode change).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Interrupt treatment: action '%2<ALNX>' not possible
desc_en: A program interrupt has been activated in a non REORG capable block. Examples of possible program interrupts in this case: - Traversing to fixed stop - Vdi channel delete distance-to-go - Vdi axial delete distance-to-go - Measuring - Software limit - Axis interchange - Axis comes from tracking - Servo disable - Gear stage change at actual gear stage unequal to setpoint gear stage. The block affected is a: - collection block from block search (except for the last collection block) - Block in overstore interrupt. Do not trigger the event on this block.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Preceding block and current block %2 must be separated through an executable block
desc_en: The language functions WAITMC, SETM, CLEARM and MSG must be programmed in separate NC blocks. To avoid velocity dips, these blocks are attached to the next NC block internally in the NCK (for WAITMC to the previous NC block). For this reason, there must always be an executable block (not a calculation block) between the NC blocks. An executable NC block always includes e.g. travel movements, a help function, STOPRE, dwell time etc. Note: This does not apply to the programming of MSG with the additional parameter "1". In this case a separate block is generated, which interrupts the continuous-path mode. Program an executable NC block between the previous and current NC blocks. Example: N10 SETM. N15 STOPRE ; insert executable NC block. N20 CLEARM.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Subprograms: action '%2<ALNX>' maximum nesting depth exceeded
desc_en: Various actions can cause the current procedure to be interrupted. Depending on the action, asynchronous subroutines (ASUBs) are activated. These ASUBs can be interrupted in the same manner as the user program. Unlimited nesting depth is not possible for ASUBs due to memory limitations. Example: In the case of an approach block in a repositioning procedure do not interrupt repeatedly, instead wait until processing is completed. Possible actions are: mode change, SlashOn/Off, overstoring. Initiate a block change and repeat the action.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Conflict when activating user data type %2
desc_en: The "activate user data" function (PI service _N_SETUDT) modifies a data block (tool offset, settable work offset or base frame) which is also written by the NC blocks in preparation. In the event of a conflict, the value entered by the HMI is reset. Parameter %2 specifies which data block is affected: 1: Active tool offset 2: Base frame 3: Active work offset Check the inputs on the HMI and repeat the procedure if necessary.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Interrupt treatment: action '%2<ALNX>' not allowed in the current state
desc_en: If a temporary standstill has occurred because of a Reorg event across block boundaries, it is possible that a block without Reorg capability has been loaded. In this situation, it is unfortunately necessary to cancel the Reorg event handling! Reorg events are, e.g. cancelation subprogram, delete distance-to-go and interrupts. Cancel program with the RESET key.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Interrupt treatment: action '%2<ALNX>' not possible due to stop

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' not possible due to search run
desc_en: The action is not allowed as block search is currently running via program test. Block search via program test: "PI Service _N_FINDBL with mode parameter 5. With this block search type, it is not permissible to activate program test or dry run feedrate. Activate the action after block search is terminated.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' not possible due to active dry run
desc_en: This action is not allowed as dry run feedrate is currently active. Example: It is not permissible to activate block search via program test (PI service _N_FINDBL with mode parameter 5) when dry run feedrate is active. Cancel program with the RESET key.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' not possible due to program test
desc_en: This action is not allowed as program test is currently active. Example: It is not permissible to activate block search via program test (PI service _N_FINDBL with mode parameter 5) when program test is active. Deactivate program test.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' canceled due to active gear change

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' rejected because no program event has been executed yet
desc_en: The setting of the MD20108 $MC_PROG_EVENT_MASK forces an asynchronous subprogram to be triggered automatically on RESET or Power-On. The implicitly triggered asynchronous subprograms are normally called "Event-triggered program call" or "Program event". In the alarm situation, this asynchronous subprogram could not yet be activated; that is why the action (normally start of part program) must be rejected. Reasons for the fact that the asynchronous subprogram could not be triggered: 1. The asynchronous subprogram does not exist (/_N_CMA_DIR/_N_PROG_EVENT_SPF) 2. The asynchronous subprogram is allowed to start in the referenced state only (see MD11602 $MN_ASUP_START_MASK) 3. READY is missing (because of alarm) Load program Check MD11602 $MN_ASUP_START_MASK Acknowledge alarm

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Start program command action '%2<ALNX>' not possible
desc_en: Currently, the alarm occurs only in combination with the SERUPRO action. SERUPRO stands for search via program test. SERUPRO is currently searching the target and has therefore switched this channel to the program test mode. With the START program command in channel 1, another channel 2 would actually be started, which means that axes would really be started during the search action. If this alarm is switched off (see help), the user can make use of the above behavior by initially selecting via PLC the program test mode in channel 2, leaving channel 2 executing until its natural end, stopping channel 2 in order to deselect program test again. Alarm can be switched off with MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK bit 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' not possible due to ASUB
desc_en: The action in the 2nd parameter was rejected, since an asynchronous subprogram is currently active. Currently, only the integrated search run is rejected with this alarm. The integrated search run is activated, if search run is triggered in the Stop program state. In other words: Parts of a program have already been executed and a following program part is "skipped" with search run in order to continue the program afterwards. The event is not possible if the program is stopped within an asynchronous subprogram or if an asynchronous subprogram had been selected before the event. An asynchronous subprogram is selected, when the triggering asynchronous subprogram event arrives, but the asynchronous subprogram cannot be started (e.g. the asynchronous start program is not started because of a read-in disable or because the Stop key is active). In this case, it is irrelevant whether a user ASUB or a system ASUB has been triggered. User ASUBs are activated via FC-9 or via the fast inputs. The following events lead to system ASUBS: - Mode change - Overstore on - Canceling subprogram level - Switching on of single block, type 2 - Setting machine data effective - Setting user data effective - Change skip levels - Dry run on/off - Program test off - Correction block alarms - Editing modi in Teach - External work offset - Axis exchange - Delete distance-to-go - Measuring Repeat the action after the end of the asynchronous subprogram.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' not possible due to active search blocks
desc_en: The NCK is currently processing either the action blocks of the search run or the approach motion after the search run. In this situation, the action (2nd parameter of the alarm) must be rejected. Currently, only the integrated search run is rejected with this alarm. The integrated search run is activated, if search run is triggered in the Stop program state. In other words: Parts of a program have already been executed and a following program part is "skipped" with search run in order to continue the program afterwards. Repeat the action after the approach motion of the search run.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Action '%2<ALNX>' delayed up to the block end
desc_en: The currently executing action (e.g. dry run on/off, change skip levels, etc.) should be active immediately, but it can become active not earlier than at the end of the block, since a thread is currently being machined. The action is activated with a slight delay. Example: Dry run is started in the middle of the thread, then traversing at high speed does not start before the next block. Alarm can be switched off via MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit17==1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Start via START is not allowed
desc_en: This alarm is active with "Group Serupro" only. "Group Serupro" is activated by means of MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK, Bit 2 and enables the retrace support of entire channel groups during block search. The MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START specifies which channel is generally started from the PLC and which channel is only allowed to be started from another channel via the START part program command. This alarm occurs if the channel was started via the START part programm command and MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START==FALSE was set. Modify MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START of switch off "Group Serupro" (see MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Start via PLC is not allowed
desc_en: This alarm is active with "Group Serupro" only. "Group Serupro" is activated by means of MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK, Bit 2 and enables the retrace support of entire channel groups during block search. The machine data MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START specifies which channel is generally started from the PLC and which channel is only allowed to be started from another channel via the START part program command. This alarm occurs if the channel was started via the PLC and MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START==TRUE was set. Modify MD22622 $MC_DISABLE_PLC_START of switch off "Group Serupro" (see MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] dependent channel %2 still active
desc_en: This alarm is active with "Group Serupro" only. "Group Serupro" is activated by means of MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MODE, bit 2 and enables the retrace support of entire channel groups during block search. A _dependent channel_ is a channel that had indirectly been started by the currently active channel. The currently active channel was started via PLC. This channel m_u_s_t be terminated (i.e. reached M30) before the current channel is terminated. This alarm occurs if the currently active channel is terminated before the dependent channel. Switch off "Group Serupro" (see MD10708 $MN_SERUPRO_MASK) or install WAITE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Correspondence between marker of channel %1 and channel %2 is invalid.
desc_en: This channel defines a WAIT marker with other channels, which on their part have no correspondence with this wait marker. This channel's WAIT marker has no explicit counterpart in the other channel; i.e. the channels do not mutually wait. ============================================================ Example Ch 3 Ch 5 Ch 7 WAITM(99,3,5) WAITM(99,3,5) WAITM(99,5,7) The wait markers in channels 3 and 5 mutually wait for each other and channel 7 only waits for channel 5. Therefore, channel 7 may continue when 5 and 7 have reached the wait marker, but channel 3 is still far in front of the wait marker. When it continues, channel 7 deletes its wait marker. When wait marker 99 is reached again, you can no longer determine the behavior precisely. ============================================================ In each wait marker, list all channels with which you want to synchronize, or suppress the alarm with MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK, bit 23. ============================================================ Sample solution A: Ch 3 Ch 5 Ch 7 WAITM(99,3,5,7) WAITM(99,3,5,7) WAITM(99,3,5,7) ============================================================ Sample solution B: Ch 3 Ch 5 Ch 7 WAITM(99,3,5) WAITM(99,3,5) WAITM(88,5,7) WAITM(88,5,7) ============================================================ Sample solution C: Ch 3 Ch 5 Ch 7 WAITM(88,5,7) WAITM(88,5,7) WAITM(99,3,5) WAITM(99,3,5)

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Search run in a protected program section.
desc_en: A part programmer can define protected part program sections with the language commands IPTRLOCK and IPTRUNLOCK. Every search run in these program sections will then be acknowledged with alarm 16951. In other words: When the alarm appears, the user has started a search run (Serupro type) and the search target lies in a protected area. A protected area can also be defined implicitly with the MD22680 $MC_AUTO_IPTR_LOCK. Note: The alarm can only be generated if the simulation has been completed during the search run. The alarm cannot be output immediately at the start of the search run. MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK, MD22680 $MC_AUTO_IPTR_LOCK and language command IPTRLOCK

title: ЧПУ · указатель

This occurs every time, when braking into a stop Stop-Delay area, i.e. a braking process starts before the Stop-Delay area and ends not earlier than in the Stop-Delay area. If the Stop-Delay area is entered with override 0, the Stop-Delay area can also not be activated Example: a G4 before the Stop-Delay area allows the user to reduce the override to 0. The next block in the Stop-Delay area then starts with override 0 and the alarm situation described occurs. MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK, bit 7 switches on this alarm. title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Machine data %2[%3] contains invalid syntax, error code: %4
desc_en: A syntax rule was violated when defining an auxiliary function or a subprogram name. The error code helps pinpoint the problem: 1 - An auxiliary function definition must start with M, D, H or T. 2 - An auxiliary function definition needs an extension or a value. 3- If present, an auxiliary function extension must be a a wild card '*' or a natural number enclosed in square brackets '[', ']'. A natural number is only allowed for 'T' auxiliary functions when $MC_T_M_ADDRESS_EXT_IS_SPINO = TRUE or with active magazine management (MD18080 $MN_MM_TOOL_MANAGEMENT_MASK, MD20310 $MC_TOOL_MANAGEMENT_MASK). 4 - If present, the value of an auxiliary function must be a natural number or a wild card '*' after an equals sign '='. 5 - With active tool management (MD18080 $MN_MM_TOOL_MANAGEMENT_MASK, MD20310 $MC_TOOL_MANAGEMENT_MASK), a numerical value must not be given for 'T', only a wild card '*' is allowed. 6 - Other entries as auxiliary functions are interpreted as subprogram names. A subprogram name must be a valid NC subprogram name with the prefix '_N_', without path specification and without '/'. It must not contain special or control characters. It must not be a keyword of the NC language (e.g. POSA). 7 - '_N_ASUP1' and '_N_ASUP2' are not permitted as subprogram definitions because these are the subprogram names from system ASUBs. - Examples of correct auxiliary function definitions are: 'H[3]=7', 'M[22]', 'D[*]=4', 'T[*]=*', 'T=*', . An example of a correct subprogram name is '_N_TOOL_TWIST'. Please notify the authorized personnel/service department. Enter auxiliary function definition or subprogram name with correct syntax in the displayed MD. - CFG_STOP positions: SD42220 $SC_CFG_STOP_ARRAY

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 no memory left for tool/magazine data. Data type: %3 %4
desc_en: Data type: 1-Tools, 2-Cutting edges, 3-Multitools, 4-Multitool locations, 5-Sum or setup offsets, 6-Adapters, 7-Magazines, 8-Magazine locations, 9-Wear group, 10-Magazine distance Cause (only if data type is "tool"): 1-Tool count limit reached, 2-Tool list handles, 3-Tool bodies, 4-Tool groups handles, 5-Tool groups The number of the following tool/magazine data variables in the NC is specified using machine data: - Number of tools + number of grinding data blocks: MD18082 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL - Number of cutting edges: MD18100 $MN_MM_NUM_CUTTING_EDGES_IN_TOA Tools, grinding data blocks, cutting edges can be used independently of the tool management. The memory for the following data is available only if the corresponding bit has been set in MD18080 $MN_MM_TOOL_MANAGEMENT_MASK. - Number of monitoring data blocks: MD18100 $MN_MM_NUM_CUTTING_EDGES_IN_TOA - Number of magazines: MD18084 $MN_MM_NUM_MAGAZINE - Number of magazine locations: MD18086 $MN_MM_NUM_MAGAZINE_LOCATION - Number of adapters: MD18104 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL_ADAPTER and MD18103 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL_ADAPTER_TYPE2 The following variable is determined by the software configuration: Number of magazine spacing data blocks: P2 permits 32 such spacing data blocks. Definition: - 'Grinding data blocks': Grinding data can be defined for a tool of type 400 to 499. A data block of this type occupies as much additional memory as that provided for a cutting edge. - 'Monitoring data blocks': Each cutting edge of a tool can be supplemented with monitoring data. - If the alarm occurs while writing one of the parameters $TC_MDP1/$TC_MDP2/$TC_MLSR, check whether machine data MD18077 $MN_MM_NUM_DIST_REL_PER_MAGLOC / MD18076$MN_MM_NUM_LOCS_WITH_DISTANCE has been set correctly. MD18077 $MN_MM_NUM_DIST_REL_PER_MAGLOC defines the number of different Index1 statements that may be made for an Index2 value. MD18076 $MN_MM_NUM_LOCS_WITH_DISTANCE defines the number of different buffer locations that may be named in Index2. If a multitool or its locations are to be generated, the alarm indicates that either more multitools need to be generated than are permitted by the setting of MD18083 $MN_MM_NUM_MULTITOOL or, if the alarm occurs when the multitool locations are being generated, that more multitool locations need to be generated than is permitted by the setting of MD18085 $MN_MM_NUM_MULTITOOL_LOCATIONS. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. - Modify machine data - Modify NC program, i.e. reduce number of rejected variable.

message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 T no.= %3, D no.= %4 not existing
desc_en: A programmed D number was not recognized by the NC. By default, the D number refers to the specified T number. If the flat D number function is active, T= 1 is output. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: - The program is incorrect: Eliminate the error with a correction block and continue the program. - The data block is missing: Load a data block for the specified T/D values onto the NCK via HMI with overstore, and continue the program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal sum correction number
desc_en: An attempt was made to access a non-defined total offset of the current tool edge.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 H number already available in T no.= %3, D no.= %4
desc_en: Each H number (except for H=0) must be assigned in a TO unit only once. The indicated edge already has the H number. If the H number shall be assigned more than once, MD10890 $MN_EXTERN_TOOLPROG_MODE, bit 3 must be set = 1. - Change program: - Select different H number

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Tool %3, Duplo no. %5, D no.= %6 does not exist
desc_en: A D number has been programmed that does not exist for the selected tool. If the selected tool does not contain the programmed D number, * the data block for the cutting edge can be loaded into the NC (via HMI, with overstore) or * the cutting edge can be created subsequently, or, * if necessary, the D number and/or the tool identifier can be corrected in the displayed block, and the NC program can be continued..

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] D number %2 defined in tool T no. %3 and %4
desc_en: The specified D number %2 in the TO unit of channel %1 is not unique. The specified T numbers %3 and %4 each have an offset with number %2. If tool management is active: The specified T numbers belong to tool groups with different names. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: 1. Use unique D numbering within the TO unit. 2. Use another command. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] D number %2 of tools defined on magazine/location %3 and %4
desc_en: The specified D number %2 in the TO unit of channel %1 is not unique. The specified T numbers %3 and %4 each have an offset with number %2. If tool management is active: The specified T numbers belong to tool groups with different names. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: 1. Use unique D numbering within the TO unit. Rename the D numbers if necessary. 2. Use another command.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal T number %3
desc_en: In the displayed block, a tool is accessed that is not defined and is therefore not available. The tool has been named by its T number, its name or its name and duplo number. If the function T=magazine location is activated and programmed, the programmed T number indicates the magazine location number. The alarm can then indicate that the programmed magazine location number is illegal. If the function T=magazine location is activated and programmed, and the multitool function is also activated and programmed in the program line MTL, the alarm can also indicate that there is no multitool at the location programmed with T=magazine location or that there is no tool at the multitool location programmed with MTL. Check tool call in the NC part program: - Is the correct tool number T.. programmed? - T=magazine location programming: Is the correct magazine location number programmed? - MTL programming: Is there a multitool at the programmed magazine location or is there a tool at the programmed multitool location? - Are tool parameters P1 - P25 defined? Description of the system variables $P_DP x [n, m] n ... Associated tool number T m ... Tool edge number D x ... Parameter number P

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 T= %3 not existing, program %4

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [TO unit %1: ] Invalid tool designation of '%2', duplo no. %3. No more replacement tools possible in '%4'.
desc_en: The tool with the specified tool identifier, duplo number cannot accept the group identifier. Reason: The maximum number of replacement tools allowed has already been defined. The name allocation causes the tool to be reallocated to a tool group which already contains the maximum number of replacement tools allowed on this machine. Use fewer replacement tools or request a different maximum setting from the machine manufacturer.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 the active tool is no longer on toolholder no./spindle no. %3, program %4
desc_en: The tool at the specified toolholder/spindle at which the last tool change was carried out as master toolholder or master spindle, has been replaced. Example: N10 SETHTH(1) N20 T="Wz1" ; Tool change at master toolholder 1 N30 SETMTH(2) N40 T1="Wz2" ; Toolholder 1 is only a secondary toolholder. Changing the tool does not result in compensation deselection. N50 D5; New correction selection. At present, there is no active tool which D can refer to, i.e. D5 refers to T no. = 0, which results in zero correction.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 no suitable tool found
desc_en: - An attempt was made to access a tool which has not been defined. - The specified tool does not permit access. - A tool with the desired properties is not available. - MTL=MT location T=magazine location number was programmed. There is no multitool at the programmed location Check access to tool: - Are the parameters of the command correctly programmed? - Does the status of the tool prevent access?

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] block %2 illegal tool holder number %3
desc_en: In the displayed block, a tool holder that is not defined is accessed. Check the programming of the tool holder in the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool data cannot be deleted. Tool %3 Error ID: %4
desc_en: An attempt has been made to delete the tool data from the part program for a tool currently being processed. Tool data for tools involved in the current machining operation must not be deleted. This applies both for the tool preselected with T or that has been changed in place of another, and also for tools for which the constant grinding wheel peripheral speed or tool monitoring is active. The first part of parameter 4 ("Error reason") shows why the tool cannot be deleted. The possible values: 1 - Tool is active 2 - WZ is at a magazine location 3 - Tool is active and at a magazine location 4 - Tool is being moved 5 - Tool is active and is being moved 6 - Tool is at a magazine location and is being moved 7 - Tool is active, is at a magazine location, and is being moved NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 deleting magazine data not possible
desc_en: An attempt was made to delete magazine data which cannot currently be deleted. A magazine with the 'tool in motion' status active cannot be deleted. A tool adapter which is currently allocated to a magazine location cannot be deleted. A tool adapter cannot be deleted if MD18104 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOL_ADAPTER has the value -1. If an attempt to delete a magazine fails $TC_MAP1[ m ] = 0 ; Delete magazine with m=magazine no. $TC_MAP1[ 0 ] = 0 ; Delete all magazines $TC_MAP6[ m ] = 0 ; Delete magazines and all their tools you must ensure that the magazine does not have the 'tool in motion' status at the time of the call. If an attempt to delete a tool adapter fails $TC_ADPTT[ a ] = -1 ; Delete adapter with number a $TC_ADPTT[ 0 ] = -1 ; Delete all adapters then the data association with the magazine location or locations must first be canceled with $TC_MPP7[ m,p ] = 0 ; m = magazine no., p = no. of the location to which the adapter is assigned.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 access to variable not possible
desc_en: The variable cannot be written/read directly from the part program. It is allowed only in motion-synchronous actions. Example for variable: $P_ACTID (which planes are active) $AA_DTEPB (axial distance-to-go for reciprocating infeed) $A_IN (query input) Modify part program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Tool management: Load manual tool %3, duplo no. %2 onto spindle/toolholder %4

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Tool management: remove manual tool %3 from spindle/toolholder %2
desc_en: Indicates that the specified manual tool must be removed from the specified toolholder or spindle before the program continues. A manual tool is a tool whose data is known to the NCK but has not been assigned to a magazine location and is, therefore, not fully accessible to the NCK for automatic tool change or, in most cases, to the machine either. The specified manual tool may be a tool in a multitool. In this case the multitool has to be removed. Make sure that the specified tool is removed from the toolholder. The alarm is cleared automatically after PLC acknowledgment of the tool change on command. Manual tools can only be used efficiently if this is supported by the PLC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Tool management: Remove manual tool %3 from buffer location %2
desc_en: Indicates that the specified manual tool must be removed from the specified buffer location before the program continues. A manual tool is a tool whose data is known to the NCK but has not been assigned to a magazine location and is, therefore, not fully accessible to the NCK for automatic tool change or, in most cases, to the machine either. The specified manual tool may also be included in a multitool. In this case the multitool has to be removed. Make sure that the specified manual tool is removed from the buffer location. The alarm is cleared automatically after PLC acknowledgment of the tool change OFF command. Manual tools can only be used efficiently if this is supported by the PLC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Remove manual tool from toolholder %4 and load manual tool %3 %2
desc_en: Indicates that the specified manual tool must be loaded in the specified toolholder or spindle before the program is continued and that the manual tool located there must be removed. A manual tool is a tool whose data are known to the NCK but which is not assigned to a magazine location and is thus not fully accessible to the NCK, and usually also to the machine, for an automatic tool change. Make sure that the manual tools are exchanged. The alarm is cleared automatically after PLC acknowledgment of the tool change on command. Manual tools can only be used efficiently if this is supported by the PLC program. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Tool %3 cannot become a manual tool
desc_en: The specified tool has a dedicated location and/or a location has been reserved for this tool in an actual magazine. Therefore, it cannot become a manual tool. - Correct the NC program - Use the programming of "DELRMRES" to check that there is no reference to an actual magazine location

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 tool not existing
desc_en: This alarm occurs if a T no., the tool name or the tool name and duplo number is used in an attempt to access a tool that has not been defined or is yet to be defined (e.g. if tools are to be positioned in magazine locations by programming $TC_MPP6 = 'toolNo'). This will only be possible if both the magazine location and the tool specified with 'toolNo' have been defined. The tool which does not exist can also be a multitool (the multitool is treated like a tool). Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 tool T/D= %3 - tool type %4 is not permitted
desc_en: On this system, it is not possible to select tool offsets of the indicated tool types. The variety of tool types can both be limited by the machine OEM and be reduced on individual control models. Only use tools of the tool types permitted for this system. Check whether an error has occurred on defining the tool. Correct the NC program or correct the tool data

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Duplo no. already assigned
desc_en: If an attempt is made to write a tool Duplo number to the name of which another tool (another T number) already exists with the same Duplo number. Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal tool definition
desc_en: If an attempt is made to modify a tool data that would subsequently damage the data consistency or lead to a conflicting definition, this alarm will appear. Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal adapter definition
desc_en: Possible causes of the error: - For an old-type tool adapter (type 1), parameters belonging to the new-type adapter (type 2) cannot be written. - For a new-type tool adapter (type 2), parameters belonging to the old-type adapter (type 1) cannot be written. The adapter type can neither be changed nor set to less than 0 or greater than 2. - For an old-type tool adapter (type 1), only write parameters belonging to type 1. - For a new-type tool adapter (type 2), only write parameters belonging to type 2. - The adapter type can only be set once with the value 1 or 2.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal magazine definition
desc_en: If an attempt is made to modify a magazine data that would subsequently damage the data consistency or lead to a conflicting definition, this alarm will appear. Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 magazine location hierarchies have been deleted
desc_en: If $TC_MAMP2, bit 15 is changed, existing hierarchies may be deleted because of a change in meaning. Redefine magazine location hierarchies.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal magazine location definition
desc_en: This alarm occurs if an attempt is made to change a magazine location data which would subsequently damage data consistency irreparably or lead to a conflicting definition. Example: If parameter $TC_MPP1 (= type of location) is written with 'spindle/toolholder location', this may conflict with the limiting MD18075 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOLHOLDERS. The remedy is then either - if permitted by the control model - to increase the value of MD18075 $MN_MM_NUM_TOOLHOLDERS or to correct the magazine definition. A tool cannot be simultaneously: - Loaded in two different magazine locations. - A part of a multitool and in a magazine location. Correct the NC program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [TO unit %1: ] Not all the values of %3 from magazine %2 can be displayed.
desc_en: Not all user magazine location data ($TC_MPPCx[magNo, locNo] can be accessed via OPI. - Either reduce the number of OEM magazine location parameters. (MD18092 $MN_MM_NUM_CC_MAGLOC_PARAM) - Or reduce the number of magazine locations in the stated magazine. ($TC_MAP6[magNo], $TC_MAP7[magNo]) The product of the 3 stated parameters must not exceed 32767.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegal tool adapter operation (Cause: %3)

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 call-by-reference: illegal variable
desc_en: Machine data and system variables must not be transferred as call-by-reference parameters. Modify NC program: Assign the value of the machine data or of the system variable to a program-local variable and transfer this as parameter.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 is not an indexing axis

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 indexing axis %3 with Hirth tooth system is active
desc_en: The 'Hirth tooth system' function is activated for the indexing axis. This axis can therefore approach only indexing positions. A different traverse of the axis is not possible. It is not permissible to program PRESETON or PRESETONS. Inform the authorized personnel/service department. Correct the part program. Correct the call FC16 or FC18. Deselect MD30505 $MA_HIRTH_IS_ACTIVE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 indexing axis %3 with Hirth tooth system stop is delayed
desc_en: For the indexing axis, the 'Hirth tooth system' function is activated and the override has been set to 0 or another stop condition (e.g. VDI interface signal) is active. Since it is possible to stop only on indexing axes, the next possible indexing position is approached. The alarm is displayed until this position is reached or the stop condition is deactivated. You have the following possibilities of eliminating the error: Wait until the next possible indexing position is reached. Set the override > 0. Deactivate another stop condition. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 indexing axis %3 with Hirth tooth system and axis not referenced
desc_en: The "Hirth tooth system" function is activated for the indexing axis and the axis is to be traversed although it is not referenced. Reference the axis.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 indexing axis %4 is active with Hirth tooth system
desc_en: The 'Hirth tooth system' function is activated for the indexing axis. This axis can therefore approach only indexing positions, another travel movement of the axis is not possible. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Correct part program. Correct FC16 or FC18 call. Deselect machine data MD30505 $MA_HIRTH_IS_ACTIVE.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 invalid index for indexing axis %3
desc_en: The programmed index for the indexing axis is beyond the position table range. Example: Perform an absolute approach of the 56th position in the list allocated via the axis-specific MD30500 $MA_INDEX_AX_ASSIGN_POS_TAB with the 1st positioning axis, the number of positions is e.g. only 40 (MD10900 $MN_INDEX_AX_LENGTH_POS_TAB_1 = 40). N100 G.. U=CAC (56) Or, with equidistant distances, the programmed index is smaller or equal 0. Or, an attempt is made with a MOV movement to travel to a position outside the permitted area. Program the indexing axis position in the NC part program in accordance with the length of the current position table, or add the required value to the position table and adjust the length of the list.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 preset on transformed axis %3 not possible
desc_en: The programmed preset key axis is involved in the current transformation. This means that setting the actual value memory (PRESET) is not possible for this axis (valid for PRESETON and PRESETONS). Example: Machine axis A should be set to the new actual value A 100 at the absolute position A 300. : N100 G90 G00 A=300 N101 PRESETON A=100 Avoid preset actual value memory for axes which are participating in a transformation or deselect the transformation with the keyword TRAFOOF.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 preset not possible on axis %4
desc_en: Actual value preset not possible for this axis because - the axis is moving - the axis is involved in a transformation - the axis is currently being monitored for collision - the spindle traverse movement has not yet been completed - reference point approach (G74) is active - the geometry axis is not in the 'neutral axis' state Avoid actual value preset or put the relevant geometry axis in the 'neutral axis' state in good time with RELEASE(...).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronized action: %3 preset not possible on axis %4 in JOGREF mode
desc_en: The actual value cannot be preset for this axis if the mode group to which this axis is assigned is in JOG mode and if the machine function reference point approach is also selected.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronized action: %3 preset is only possible on a stationary axis %4 in JOG mode
desc_en: In JOG mode, an actual value can only be preset on stationary axes. Avoid setting an actual value while the axis is in motion; wait until the axis is stationary.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronized action: %3 preset not possible on active oscillating axis (axis %4)
desc_en: An actual value cannot be preset on an active oscillating axis controlled via synchronized actions. Avoid setting actual value during active oscillating movement.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 transformation active: inhibits rotation of axis container
desc_en: The programmed axis/spindle is active in a transformation and the axis container cannot be rotated for this reason. Modify part program. Deactivate the transformation for this axis/spindle before rotating the axis container or perform the axis container rotation later.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 axis %3 involved in the transformation, action cannot be carried out

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 approaching fixed point for transformed axis %3 not possible
desc_en: In the displayed block, an axis is programmed for the fixed point approach (G75) that is involved in the active transformation. Fixed point approach is not performed with this axis! Remove G75 instruction from the part program block or previously deselect transformation with TRAFOOF.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 referencing for transformed axis %3 not possible
desc_en: In the displayed block, an axis is programmed for reference point approach (G74) that is involved in the active transformation. Reference point approach is not performed with this axis! Remove G74 instruction, or the machine axes involved in transformation, from the part program block or previously deselect the transformation with TRAFOOF.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 spindle operation for transformed axis %3 not possible
desc_en: The axis programmed for the spindle operation is involved in the current transformation as geometry axis. This is not allowed. First disable the transformation function.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 machine axis %3 not programmable
desc_en: The machine axis cannot be used in an active transformation. You may be able to program the function in a different coordinate system. For example, it may be possible to specify the retraction position in the basic coordinate system or the workpiece coordinate system. The axis identifier is used to select the coordinate system. Deactivate the transformation or use another coordinate system.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 illegally coded position programmed
desc_en: The position number n specified with the keyword FP=n is not permissible. Two (2) absolute axis positions can be directly defined as fixed points by the axis-specific machine data MD30600 $MA_FIX_POINT_POS[n]. Or, if position numbers 3 and/or 4 are to be used, then machine data MD30610 $MA_NUM_FIX_POINT_POS must be set accordingly. Program keyword FP with machine fixed points 1 or 2. Example: Approach fixed point 2 with machine axes X1 and Z2. N100 G75 FP=2 X1=0 Z2=0 Or modify MD30610 $MA_NUM_FIX_POINT_POS and, if necessary, MD30600 $MA_FIX_POINT_POS[].

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 not referenced
desc_en: A function has been activated for the axis in JOG mode, e.g. fixed-point approach, JOG to position, JOG in circles, but the axis has not been referenced. Reference axis.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Fixed-point approach not possible for axis %2 in JOG, reason %3
desc_en: A 'fixed-point approach in JOG' has been requested for an axis. This is not possible because: Reason 1: The axis is involved in the active transformation. Reason 2: The axis is a following axis in an active coupling. The fixed point approach will therefore not be executed. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 fixed-point approach in JOG: Fixed point %3 changed
desc_en: 'Fixed-point approach in JOG' is active for the axis, but another fixed point has been selected, or the fixed-point approach has been deactivated. The approach motion is canceled. Trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 fixed-point approach in JOG and override motion active
desc_en: 'Fixed-point approach in JOG' is active for the axis, but another offset motion - for example a synchronization offset $AA_OFF - has been interpolated simultaneously. The position of the selected fixed-point is not reached if offset values are changed during the traversing motion. The target point then becomes "fixed-point position + change in offset value". The end point will be reached if the traversing motion is restarted after the offset value has been changed. (For example: incremental traversing in which the traversing motion stops intermittently). Reason: Restarting the motion takes the current offset value into account. Trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 fixed-point position not available
desc_en: No fixed-point position is available for the fixed point selected in JOG mode. See MD30610 $MA_NUM_FIX_POINT_POS. Adapt MD30610 $MA_NUM_FIX_POINT_POS and, if necessary, MD30600 $MA_FIX_POINT_POS[]. Deselect fixed-point approach or select a valid fixed point, and restart the JOG motion.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Indexing axis %1 fixed point %2 unequal indexing position

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 JOG to position and override motion active
desc_en: 'JOG to position' is active for the axis, but an offset motion - for example a synchronization offset $AA_OFF - has been interpolated simultaneously. The position of the SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION is not reached if offset values are changed during the traversing motion. The target point then becomes "Jog position + change in offset value". The position SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION will be reached if the traversing motion is restarted after the offset value has been changed. (For example: incremental traversing in which the traversing motion stops intermittently). Reason: Restarting the motion takes the current offset value into account. Trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 JOG to position: Position changed
desc_en: An axis motion is active for the axis with 'JOG to position' but the position, that is the content of SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION, has been changed. The approach motion is canceled. Trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 JOG to position deactivated
desc_en: An axis motion is active for the axis with 'JOG to position' but 'JOG to position' has been deactivated. The approach motion is canceled. Trigger JOG motion again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Indexing axis %1 $SA_JOG_POSITION unequal indexing position
desc_en: The axis is a referenced indexing axis and 'JOG to position' is activated in JOG mode, but SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION does not coincide with an indexing position. In JOG mode, referenced indexing axes approach indexing positions. Modify SD43320 $SA_JOG_POSITION or indexing positions.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] JOG in a circle is activated, but the axis %2 required for this is not a geometry axis.
desc_en: The function JOG in circles has been activated, but the axis required for this has not been defined as a geometry axis. Define axis as geometry axis.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] JOG a circle is not possible, reason %2
desc_en: The JOG in circles function was activated, but this is not possible because: 1. The current positions of the axes involved lie outside the selected pitch circle. 2. The current positions of the axes involved, with pitch circle selected and tool radius offset active, are too near to the center of the circle. 3. The current positions of the axes involved, with tool radius offset active, are too near to the limiting circle during internal machining. 4. The current positions of the axes involved, with tool radius offset active, are too near to the limiting circle during external machining. 5. The current positions of the axes involved in internal machining are outside the defined circle. 6. The current positions of the axes involved in external machining are inside the defined circle. 10. A rotation is acting on the current plane, that is the current plane is inclined in space. This is not currently supported. 20. JOG Retract is active. This mode is not supported. Define axis as geometry axis.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] JOG a circle is active and JOG circles deactivated
desc_en: A circular motion is active but 'JOG in circles' has been deactivated. The circular motion is canceled.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 motion synchronous action: %3 axis %4 is not a machine axis
desc_en: At this point, the block context calls for a machine axis. This is the case with: - G74 (reference point approach) - G75 (fixed point approach) - PRESETON/PRESETONS on GANTRY synchronous axis If a geometry or special axis identifier is used, then it must also be permitted as machine axis identifier (MD10000 $MN_AXCONF_MACHAX_NAME_TAB Use machine axis identifier when programming.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 NCK-specific protection area %3 wrong. Error code %4
desc_en: There is an error in the definition of the protection area. The error number gives the specific reason for the alarm: No. Meaning 1: Incomplete or conflicting contour definition. 2: Contour encompasses more than one surface area. 3: Tool-related protection area is not convex. 4: If both boundaries are active in the 3rd dimension of the protection area and both limits have the same value. 5: The number of the protection area does not exist (negative number, zero or greater than the maximum number of protection areas). 6: Protection area definition consists of more than 10 contour elements. 7: Tool-related protection area is defined as inside protection area. 8: Incorrect parameter used. 9: Protection area to be activated is not defined. 10: Incorrect modal G code used for protection area definition. 11: Contour definition incorrect or frame activated. 12: Other, not further specified errors. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Modify definition of the protection area and check MD.

desc_en: There is an error in the definition of the protection area. The error number gives the specific reason for the alarm. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Modify definition of the protection area and check MD.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table: block search stop not allowed with definition CTABDEF
desc_en: Program instructions that lead to a preprocessing stop are not allowed within a curve table definition. The system variable $P_CTABDEF can be queried to check whether a table definition is currently active. Put the block in parenthesis using "IF NOT($P_CTABDEF) ... ENDIF" or remove the instruction that causes the preprocessing stop. Then start the part program again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table: table %3 does not exist
desc_en: An attempt was made to use a curve table whose table number is not known in the system \par. Change the table number in the program instruction or define the curve table with the desired table number.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table: instruction CTABEND without CTABDEF not allowed
desc_en: The CTABEND instruction, with which the definition of curve tables is completed, is programmed in the program. However, a CTABDEF instruction was not programmed to start the definition of curve tables. Another cause of error may be that the CTABDEF and CTABEND instructions were not programmed in the same program level.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table: instruction CTABDEF not within CTABDEF
desc_en: In the program, the instruction CTABDEF that starts the definition of curve tables, is programmed within the definition part of a curve table. This is not allowed, as the current curve table must be completed with CTABEND first. Remove command CTABEND from program or insert instruction CTABDEF ( ..) at the relevant point in the program. The CTABDEF and CTABEND instructions must be programmed on the same program level (main program or subroutine). Restart the program.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 curve table: instruction SUPA/SUPD not within CTABDEF
desc_en: The G codes SUPA and SUPD are not allowed for the definition of a curve table, as they trigger a preprocessing stop. Remove G code SUPA/SUPD from the curve table definition. If possible, use G codes G53 or G153 instead of SUPA.
