title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 SINAMICS drive parameter P2038 value is not allowed.
desc_en: For SINAMICS drives only: The interface mode, which is set via drive parameter P2038, has not been set to SIMODRIVE 611 universal. The alarm can be disabled by MD13070 $MN_DRIVE_FUNCTION_MASK - bit15. However, the following must be noted: - The device-specific assignment of the bits in the control and status words may be different. - The drive data sets can be created at will, and need not be subdivided into groups of 8. (For details see also SINAMICS Commissioning Manual). So the parameters of motors 2-4 may be incorrectly assigned. - Set P2038 = 1 or - Set P0922 = 100...199 or - Set bit 15 of MD13070 $MN_DRIVE_FUNCTION_MASK (note the boundary conditions, see above) and execute a Power-On in each case.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Machine data %1[%2] value not permissible
desc_en: Machine data includes a value that is not valid. Repeat entry with correct value and then Power-On.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Machine data %1[%2] value not permissible
desc_en: Machine data includes a value that is not valid. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 encoder %2 absolute position lost
desc_en: The absolute position of the absolute encoder has become invalid because - on changing parameter block, a changed gear stage ratio was identified between encoder and processing or - the encoder has been replaced (the absolute encoder's serial number was changed, see MD34230 $MA_ENC_SERIAL_NUMBER, and drive-specific parameters). - of an internal number format limitation in MD34090 $MA_REFP_MOVE_DIST_CORR. Remedy: reduce MD10210 $MN_INT_INCR_PER_DEG or MD10200 $MN_INT_INCR_PER_MM. Please inform the authorized personnel/service department. Rereferencing/resynchronization of the absolute encoder; attach absolute encoder on the load side and configure correctly (e.g. MD 31040 $MA_ENC_IS_DIRECT).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 configuration error master-slave
desc_en: The alarm is output when the same machine axis has been configured as a master and a slave axis. Each of the axes in the master/slave link can be operated either as master or slave. - Check machine data for all linked axes and correct if necessary: - MD 37250 $MA_MS_ASSIGN_MASTER_SPEED_CMD - MD 37252 $MA_MS_ASSIGN_MASTER_TORQUE_CTR.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 master-slave not configured
desc_en: The master-slave coupling could not be activated because of incomplete configuration. Check the current configuration of the master-slave coupling. The configuration can be modified via the MASLDEF instruction or the machine data MD37250 $MA_MS_ASSIGN_MASTER_SPEED_CMD and MD37252 $MA_MS_ASSIGN_MASTER_TORQUE_CTR.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 filter %2 limited
desc_en: The position controller cycle is too small or position setpoint filters activated with the specified machine data are parameterized too large and are limited internally. Change parameterization: Increase position controller cycle (or system cycle), deactivate filter in the specified machine data, or reduce parameterization of the used filters (e.g. used filter time constant).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 encoder parameterization MD %2[%3] has been adjusted.
desc_en: The parameterization of the encoder in P979 read out from the drive and displayed in the MD does not match the NCK parameterization. The corresponding NCK-MD has been adapted. Power-On required. This alarm only occurs when the NC-MD is set unequal to the drive parameter.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 parameter set change from %2 to %3 not possible
desc_en: The parameter block change cannot be performed without jumps. This is due to the content of the parameter block to be switched on, e.g. different load gear factors. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] In block %2 unanticipated stop crossed in continuous path mode
desc_en: The path interpolation did not stop, as required, at the end of the block, but only decelerates to a standstill in the next block. This error situation occurs if the stop at the end of the block was not planned by the path interpolation or was not detected early enough. One possible cause is that the PLC changed the spindle speed when MD35500 $MA_SPIND_ON_SPEED_AT_IPO_START > 0, and the machine has to wait until the spindle has returned to the setpoint range. Another possible cause is that a synchronized action needs to be finished before path interpolation continues. The alarm is only output if MD11400 $MN_TRACE_SELECT = 'H400'. The alarm output is normally suppressed. - MD11400 $MN_TRACE_SELECT has SIEMENS password protection. MD35500 $MA_SPIND_ON_SPEED_AT_IPO_START = 1. Program G09 before the alarm output in the block to allow the path interpolation to stop as planned.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] In block %2: path velocity too high for auxiliary function output (%3)
desc_en: This alarm usually occurs in a block with auxiliary function output during a movement. In this case, the wait for acknowledgment of the auxiliary function was longer than planned. The alarm also occurs if internal control inconsistencies cause continuous path mode (G64, G641, ...) to be blocked unexpectedly. The path interpolation stops abruptly at the end of the block indicated in the message (regenerative stop). Alarm 21620 is often triggered as a follow-up alarm. If not, the path continues after the block change. - The time calculated for the auxiliary function output during the movement comes from the PLC in most systems. Otherwise, MD10110 $MN_PLC_CYCLE_TIME_AVERAGE is used for this purpose. - The alarm can basically be avoided by programming in the block G09 indicated in the message. This stops the path interpolation briefly at the end of the block.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 interpolation problem in Look Ahead (module %3, identifier %4)
desc_en: Synchronism between interpolation and preparation is incorrect. Please contact Siemens.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 interpolation warning in Look Ahead (module %3, problem %4)
desc_en: The computer performance is inadequate to create a smooth path velocity profile. This can lead to drops in velocity. Change parameterization. Increase interpolation cycle.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 cannot be controlled by the PLC, max. number exceeded
desc_en: An attempt was made to define more axes than allowed as PLC-controlled axes. Check the option 'Number of PLC-controlled axes' and correct if necessary or reduce the number of requests for PLC- controlled axes.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 cannot be controlled by the PLC
desc_en: Axis cannot be made a PLC-controlled axis. For the time being, the axis cannot be controlled at any state from the PLC. Use Release or Waitp to make the axis a neutral one.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Switching off PLC control of axis %2 not allowed in the current state
desc_en: The PLC can return the control rights for an axis to program processing only, if the axis is in READY state. Reset VDI interface signal "PLC controls axis", then activate "Axial reset" and repeat process.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Axis %3 not available for the NC program, as exclusively controlled by the PLC
desc_en: The axis is exclusively controlled by the PLC. Therefore, the axis is not available for the NC program. Have the axis not exclusively controlled by the PLC, but only temporarily. Change MD30460 $MA_BASE_FUNCTION_MASK, bit 4.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Axis %3 not available for NC program, firmly assigned PLC axis
desc_en: The axis is a firmly assigned PLC axis. The axis is therefore not available for the NC program. Do not define axis as a firmly assigned PLC axis. Change of MD30460 $MA_BASE_FUNCTION_MASK bit5.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 not available for the NC program, as exclusively controlled by the PLC
desc_en: The axis is exclusively controlled by the PLC. Therefore, the axis is not available for the NC program. Have the axis not exclusively controlled by the PLC, but only temporarily. Change MD30460 $MA_BASE_FUNCTION_MASK, bit 4. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 not available for NC program, firmly assigned PLC axis
desc_en: The axis is a firmly assigned PLC axis. The axis is therefore not available for the NC program. Do not define axis as a firmly assigned PLC axis. Change of MD30460 $MA_BASE_FUNCTION_MASK bit5.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Retraction position of axis %2 not programmed or invalid
desc_en: No retraction position has been programmed for the axis trigger time or the position became invalid. Preset value by means of POLFA(Axis,Type,Pos), with type = 1 (absolut) or type = 2 (incremental); type = 0 specifies the position as invalid.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis trigger of axis %2 was activated, but axis is not PLC-controlled
desc_en: The axis trigger for single axis was initiated. However, the axis is not PLC-controlled at the trigger time (therefore no single axis) or the position became invalid. Preset axis PLC-controlled (declare single axis).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] ESR for PLC-controlled axis %2 has been triggered
desc_en: An axial ESR has been triggered for an individual axis (PLC-controlled axis): The display can be suppressed by MD11410 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK bit28 = 1. The individual axis is in axial stop after the ESR movement. If an axial reset is performed for the individual axis, the alarm will be deleted and the individual axis can be traversed again.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 drive %2 sign of life missing
desc_en: Special case: The output of drive number=0 indicates that a computing timeout occurred on the IPO level (see also alarm 4240) Restart drive, check drive software.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 drive %2 communication failure
desc_en: For PROFIdrive only: The drive is not communicating. - Check the bus configuration. - Check the interface (connector removed, option module inactive, etc.).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 drive %2 sign of life missing
desc_en: For PROFIdrive only: The sign-of-life cell is no longer being updated by the drive. - Check the cycle settings (recommendation: e.g. MD10062 $MN_POSCTRL_CYCLE_DELAY = 0.0) - Increase the cycle time if necessary. - Power-up the drive again. - Check drive software. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Drive of axis %1 not found
desc_en: For PROFIdrive only: The drive configured for the specified axis could not be found. For example, a PROFIBUS slave was configured on the NC but is not contained in the PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration. Possible causes: - MD30130 $MA_CTRLOUT_TYPE not equal to 0 as a result of an oversight; the drive should actually be simulated (= 0). - MD30110 $MA_CTRLOUT_MODULE_NR entered incorrectly, i.e. the logical drive numbers were exchanged and an invalid value is stored for this drive in MD13050 $MN_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDRESS (see 3.) or a drive number which does not exist on the bus was entered (check the number for slaves, for example). - MD13050 $MN_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDRESS contains values which were not configured on PROFIBUS/PROFINET or different addresses of the input and output slots of the drives were selected in the PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Encoder %2 of axis %1 not found
desc_en: For PROFIdrive only: The encoder configured for the specified axis could not be found. For example, a PROFIBUS slave was configured on the NC but it is not contained in the PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration or defective hardware was reported for it. Possible causes: - MD 30240 $MA_ENC_TYPE not equal to 0 as a result of an oversight; the encoder should actually be simulated (= 0). - MD 30220 $MA_ENC_MODULE_NR entered incorrectly, i.e. the logical drive numbers were transposed and an invalid value is stored for this drive in MD 13050 $MN_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDRESS (see next paragraph), or a drive number which does not exist on the bus was entered (check the number for slaves, for example). - MD 13050 $MN_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDRESS contains values which were not configured on the PROFIBUS/PROFINET or different addresses were selected for the input and output slots of the drive in the PROFIBUS/PROFINET configuration. - A fatal encoder error was detected during the selection of the encoder (encoder defective, removed), so that park status cannot be left (in such a case, this alarm is triggered instead of alarm 25000/25001 - please refer to them for other possible causes of the error).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Independent drive stop/retract triggered
desc_en: For SINAMICS only: Informational alarm: At least in one axis, a "drive-autonomous shutdown or retraction" was triggered. Deselect drive-autonomous stop or retration. acknowledge alarm with reset.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 $AA_ESR_ENABLE = 1 but axis should be set to NEUTRAL
desc_en: One axis with ESR configuration and $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 1 should be set to NEUTRAL. However, neutral axes (apart from single axes) cannot execute an ESR. Set $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 0 before setting axis to NEUTRAL. Alarm can be suppressed via MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2 bit 6 = 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 is NEUTRAL and $AA_ESR_ENABLE = 1 should be set
desc_en: $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 1 should not be set to neutral axes (apart from single axes). Neutral axes (apart from single axes) cannot execute an ESR. Do not apply $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 1 to neutral axes (apart from single axes). Alarm can be suppressed via MD11415 $MN_SUPPRESS_ALARM_MASK_2 bit 6 = 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2, $AA_ESR_ENABLE = 1, axis exchange not executed in this state
desc_en: With $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 1 axis exchange not permitted. Set $AA_ESR_ENABLE[axis] = 0 before axis exchange.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2 axis %3: ESRR or ESRS could not be executed, error code %4
desc_en: Writing the data of the part program commands ESRR or ESRS could not be executed. Error code: 1: The indicated axis is not assigned to any axis. 2: One or more ESR parameters in SINAMICS are not available. 3: Writing of one or more ESR parameters in SINAMICS was prevented. Error code: 1: Check the assignment of the NC axes to the drives. 2: One or more ESR parameters in SINAMICS are not available. Check the assignment of the NC axes to the drives. Programming of ESRR or ESRS is possible only for SINAMICS as from V4.4. The function module "drive-autonomous stop and retract" in SINAMICS not active. 3: Writing one or more ESR parameters in SINAMICS was prevented. Activate the output of additional information alarms through MD11411 $MN_ENABLE_ALARM_MASK, bit 1 = 1.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The ROOT chain element was not found.
desc_en: The kinematic chain element with the name specified in MD16800 $MN_ROOT_KIN_ELEM_NAME was not found. This error does not occur if kinematic chain elements have not been defined, i.e. if all system variables $NK_NAME[n] are empty. Change the content of machine data MD16800 $MN_ROOT_KIN_ELEM_NAME so that it refers to an existing, kinematic chain element, or adapt the name of a kinematic chain element to the content of the specified machine data.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The names of the kinematic chain links $NK_NAME[%3] and $NK_NAME[%4] are the same
desc_en: There are (at least) two kinematic chain links with the same name. The names of the kinematic chain links must be clear and identifiable. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The chain element %3 referred to in $NK_NEXT[%4] is already contained in the chain
desc_en: In one chain link, the next link of the chain is indicated as a chain link already in existence in the chain. This allows you to define a not permitted closed chain. Define the kinematic chain in such a way that no closed chain results.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Chain element %3, referred to in $NK_NEXT[%4], was not found
desc_en: The chain link indicated as the next link in a kinematic chain was not found. Indicate in $NK_NEXT[...] the name of an existing chain link.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Chain element %3, referred to in $NK_PARALLEL[%4], was not found
desc_en: The specified parallel chain element was not found. In $NK_PARALLEL[...], specify the name of an existing chain element.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: $NK_SWITCH_INDEX[%3] is too large.
desc_en: The content of $NK_SWITCH_INDEX of a chain element of type "SWITCH" must be greater than or equal to -1 and less than the content of machine data MD18882 $MN_MM_MAXNUM_KIN_SWITCHES. Enter a permissible value in $NK_SWITCH_INDEX.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The axis direction in chain element %3 has not been defined.
desc_en: The chain element describes an axis, the direction of which is defined by the value included in $NK_OFF_DIR and $NK_OFF_DIR_FINE. The definition is valid only if the value of the sum vector and the value of the basic vector $NK_OFF_DIR are higher than 1.0e-6. Enter valid vectors in $NK_OFF_DIR and/or $NK_OFF_DIR_FINE, or change the type of the chain element.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Invalid name in %3[%4]
desc_en: A system variable of type STRING contains an invalid name. Use a permissible name. The permissible names can be found in the documentation of the system variables involved.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: unknown element type in $NK_TYPE[%3]

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The names of the protection areas $NP_PROT_NAME[%3] and $NP_PROT_NAME[%4] are the same
desc_en: Two protection areas were assigned the same name. The names of the protection areas must be clear and identifiable. Rename one of the protection areas involved.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The names of the protection area elements $NP_NAME[%3] and $NP_NAME[%4] are the same
desc_en: Two protection area elements were assigned the same name. The names of the protection area elements must be clear and identifiable. Rename one of the protection area elements involved.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Invalid protection area type in $NP_PROT_TYPE[%4] of the protection area $NP_PROT_NAME[%4] = %3.
desc_en: An invalid protection area type was entered. Only the following protection area types are permitted: "MACHINE" "TOOL" Indicate valid protection area type.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Invalid protection area element type in $NP_TYPE[%3] of the protection area element $NP_NAME[%4] = %3.
desc_en: An invalid type of protection area element was entered. Only the following types of element are permitted: "FRAME" "BOX" "SPHERE" "CYLINDER" "FILE" Indicate valid protection area type.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The CAD file stated in $NP_FILENAME[%4] = %3 was not found.
desc_en: A CAD file specified in a protection area element of the type "FILE" was not found. Correct the name in $NP_FILENAME or load the CAD file of this name into the control.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area element %3, referred to in $NP_1ST_PROT[%4], was not found
desc_en: The protection area element indicated first in a protection area was not found. Indicate in $NP_1ST_PROT[...] the name of an existing protection area element.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The tool protection area element $NP_NAME[%5] = %3 referred to in $NP_1ST_PROT[%6] is of an invalid type
desc_en: If an explicitly specified protection area element is referred to in a tool protection area with $NP_1ST_PROT, it must be of the type "FRAME". Note: Parameter 4 contains the descriptions of parameters 5 and 6 separated by the character "|". - 5 = Index of the protection area element - 6 = Index of the tool protection area Delete the entry in $NP_1ST_PROT if no additional frame is required, or enter $NP_TYPE = "FRAME" in the protection area element referred to.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area element %3, referred to in $NP_NEXT[%4] / $NP_NEXTP[%4], was not found
desc_en: The protection area element indicated next in a protection area was not found. Indicate in $NP_NEXT[...] the name of an existing protection area element.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Maximum number of %3 protection area elements exceeded
desc_en: The maximum number of permitted protection area elements has been exceeded. Reduce number of protection areas or protection area elements.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The maximum permissible number of tool protection area elements has been exceeded.
desc_en: The maximum permissible number of protection area elements reserved for the tool has been exceeded. Increase the number of protection area elements reserved for the tool (MD18893 $MN_MM_MAXNUM_3D_T_PROT_ELEM) or reduce the complexity of the tool descriptions.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area $NP_PROT_NAME[%3] does not contain any protection area elements
desc_en: A protection area must contain at least one protection area element. Change definition of protection area or delete protection area.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Impermissible reference to a follow-up element of a tool protection area element %3[%4]
desc_en: A tool protection area must not refer to more than one explicitly specified protection area element of the "FRAME" type. Further references in such an element to follow-up elements in $NP_ADD, $NP_NEXT or $NP_NEXTP are impermissible. Delete all entries in $NP_ADD, $NP_NEXT or $NP_NEXTP in the explicitly specified tool protection area element. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area element %3, referred to in $NP_NEXT[%4] / $NP_NEXTP[%4], is already contained in the definition chain
desc_en: A closed definition chain was found, i.e. a protection area element contains the protection area of which it is a part. Change definition of protection area or delete protection area.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: $NP_CHAIN_ELEM[%4] = %3 refers to a chain element of type SWITCH.
desc_en: The component $NP_CHAIN_ELEM of the specified protection area refers to a chain element of type "SWITCH". Protection areas must not be attached to chain elements of this type. Attach the protection area to another element in the kinematic chain. For example, an additional element of the type OFFSET with zero length can be inserted before the chain element of the type SWITCH.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area %3, referred to in $NP_ADD[%4], was not found
desc_en: The protection area to be added to the current protection area element was not found. Indicate in $NP_ADD[...] the name of an existing protection area element, define a protection area with the name indicated or delete entry.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The type of protection area %3, which is referred to in $NP_ADD[%4], differs from the type of the basic protection area.
desc_en: The type of the protection area to be added to the current protection area element and the type of the basic protection area are not identical Change the type of the protection area to be added or the type of the basic protection area ($NP_PROT_TYPE) such that both types are identical.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area %3, which is referred to in $NP_ADD[%4], is linked to the kinematic chain.
desc_en: Protection areas added to an existing protection area via $NP_ADD[...], must not be linked to the kinematic chain, e.g. $NP_CHAIN_ELEM[...] must be empty. Enter in $NP_ADD[...] a protection area not linked with the kinematic chain or delete the reference to a kinematic chain in the protection area to be added or delete the entry in $NP_ADD[...].

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area %3, referred to in $NP_ADD[%4], is already contained in the definition chain
desc_en: A closed definition chain was found, i.e. a protection area element contains the protection area of which it is a part. Change definition of the protection area or delete protection area.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Parameter $NP_PARA[%3,%4] is invalid
desc_en: An invalid parameter value for defining a protection area element was indicated. Parameter values must be positive. Indicate valid parameter value.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The contents (%4) of parameter $NP_BIT_NO[%3] are invalid
desc_en: Invalid bit index indicated for the switchover of a preactivated protection area between the states activated / deactivated. The lowest permissible bit index is -1, the highest permissible bit index is equal to the content of 18897 $MN_MM_MAXNUM_3D_INTERFACE_IN minus 1. As the maximum permissible value of MD $MN_MM_MAXNUM_3D_INTERFACE_IN is equal to 64 , the maximum possible bit index is equal to 63. Bit index -1 means that no interface bit was assigned to the protection area. Values between 0 and 63 indicate the index of the interface bit through which the activation state of the protection area is switched over. Specify valid index.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The contents (%4) of parameter $NP_USAGE[%3] are invalid
desc_en: An invalid value was entered for the parameter $NP_USAGE. Only the following values are permissible: "C" or "c" (only use protection area element to avoid collisions) "V" or "v" (only use protection area element for visualization) "A" or "a" (use protection area element for avoiding collisions and visualization) Specify valid index.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: No name was entered in $NP_COLL_PAIR[%3, %4].
desc_en: Only one name was entered in the collision pair $NP_COLL_PAIR[n, 0] - $NP_COLL_PAIR[n, 1]. If one element of a collision pair contains a name, then the other element must also contain a name. The alarm refers to the missing element. Delete the existing entry or add the missing entry

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area name in $NP_COLL_PAIR[%5, %6] = '%3' was not found.
desc_en: The stated protection area, to which the entry in $NP_COLL_PAIR[n, m] refers, was not found. Note: Parameter 4 contains the descriptions of parameters 5 and 6 separated by the character "|". - 5 = 1st index of the collision pair - 6 = 2nd index of the collision pair Enter the name of an existing protection area.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Two identical names were entered in the collision pair $NP_COLL_PAIR[%3, 0] - $NP_COLL_PAIR[%3, 1].
desc_en: Two identical names were entered in the collision pair $NP_COLL_PAIR[n, 0] - $NP_COLL_PAIR[n, 1]. The two names must refer to different protection areas. Enter two different protection area names.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area was entered in collision pair element $NP_COLL_PAIR[%3, %4] that is not anchored to a kinem. chain element.
desc_en: In the collision element specified, a protection area was specified that is not anchored to a kinematic chain element, which is part of the kinematic description of the machine. It is only possible to monitor protection areas for possible collision, whose position in space is known. Protection areas which are not themselves anchored to a kinematic chain element can be added to other protection areas (with $NP_ADD[..]), and then, if necessary, monitored for collision together with these areas. Delete the entry in $NP_COLL_PAIR or define the protection area component $NP_CHAIN_ELEM.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Collision of the two protection areas %3 and %4
desc_en: The two protection areas named collide in the indicated block, i.e. the distance between the two protection areas is smaller than the value defined by MD10619 $MN_COLLISION_TOLERANCE. Change NC program or definition of the protection areas involved.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Not enough memory space for determining the distance between two protection areas. Currently available memory space: %3KB.
desc_en: The determination of the distance between two protection areas with the function PROTDFCT requires temporary internal memory space, the size of which depends on the number of elements contained in the protection areas, and their positions relative to each other. The size of the available memory space can be changed in MD18896 $MN_MM_MAXNUM_3D_COLLISION. Change NC program or definition of the protection areas involved. Adjust MD18896 $MN_MM_MAXNUM_3D_COLLISION.

title: ЧПУ · указатель

title: ЧПУ · указатель

desc_en: The name of a protection area was programmed several times (e.g, during the function call PROTA). Indicate each required name of a protection area only once.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2: error %3 when calling WORKPIECE or FIXTURE process.
desc_en: When calling the WORKPIECE or FIXTURE process, an error has incurred. The error cause is described in detail by the error code: 1: No memory space available to store tool protection area / workholder protection area. 2: The name of the specified kinematic chain could not be found. 3: The name of the specified kinematic chain link could not be found. 4: An invalid frame name was given (only identifiers of programmable frames are permitted). 5: The specified protection area type cannot be interpreted by the NCK. 6: Impermissible name of the workpiece protection area. Workpiece protection areas must start with __WORKP. 7: No protection area definition found with the specified name. 8: The name of the workholder protection area was not given. 9: Impermissible name of the workholder protection area. Workholder protection areas must start with __FIXTURE. 10: Indication of the protection area type missing. 11: Less than three parameters were given for the protection area of the "Box" type. 12: Less than two parameters were given for the protection area of the "CYLINDER" type. n: Invalid parameter(s) (the exact meaning of the possible error code must still be defined / extended). Eliminate error cause specified in error code. Set bit NO_ERROR in fifth call parameter to surpress alarm output.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The protection area %3 has not been assigned an interface bit
desc_en: An attempt was made to activate a protection area, to which no interface bit is assigned, with the status "P" (PLC controlled). Protection areas with this status can only be activated if, in $NP_BIT_NO[..], an interface bit was defined that can be used to toggle the monitoring status of the protection area between the two states, activated (monitored) and deactivated (not monitored). NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Error %3 on calling the COLLPAIR function.
desc_en: An error occurred when the function "COLLPAIR" was called. The cause of the error is more closely defined by the error parameter. -1 Either less than 2 parameters (strings) were entered or at least one of the two strings is the zero string. -2 The protection area entered in the first parameter was not found. -3 The protection area entered in the second parameter was not found. -4 Neither of the two protection areas entered were found. -5 Both of the two protection areas entered were found, but not in a pair. 6 Machine modeling is not possible. Machine modeling requires that both kinematic chains and protection areas can be defined. Call function with valid parameters.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Invalid activation parameter during the PROTA function call
desc_en: The activation parameter of the PROTA function contains an invalid value. Only the following values are permitted: "A" or "a" (= activated) "I" or "i" (= inactivated) "P" or "p" (= preactivated) "R" or "r" (= take over activation state from protection area definitions) Indicate a valid activation parameter ("A", "a", "I", "i", "P", "p" , "R", "r").

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Chain element %3, referred to in $NP_CHAIN_ELEM[%4], was not found
desc_en: The kinematic chain element referred to in the protection area definition ($NP_CHAIN_ELEM[...]) was not found. Indicate in $NP_CHAIN_ELEM[...] the name of an existing chain element or define a chain element with the name indicated.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The axis name %3 contained in $NK_AXIS[%4] is unknown or invalid
desc_en: An unknown or invalid name was entered in the element of a kinematic chain in the component $NK_AXIS[...]. The name entered must be a machine axis identifier. The alarm also occurs if the name entered in $NK_AXIS[...] exists, but the named element is not of the type defined in $NK_TYPE[...]. Example: $NK_TYPE[...] contains type "AXIS_ROT" and $NK_AXIS[...] the machine axis identifier of a linear axis, e.g. "X1". Enter a valid name in $NK_AXIS[...] (machine axis identifier). Enter the type of element in $NK_TYPE[...] that is referred to by the content of $NK_AXIS. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 risk of collision %3 %4
desc_en: The indicated axis was stopped due to the risk of collision. In JOG mode: Retract axis from danger zone. In automatic mode: Determine reason for the risk of collision and eliminate. Possible reasons: wrong NC program, too large handwheel overrides, axis couplings and vice-versa impairing of two channels.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Axis %2 risk of collision %3 %4
desc_en: The stated axis was stopped due to the risk of collision. The programmed path may have been left because it was not possible to stop in time on the path (exceptional situation). In JOG mode: Retract axis from danger zone. In automatic mode: Determine reason for the risk of collision and eliminate. Possible reasons: wrong NC program, too large handwheel overrides, axis couplings and vice-versa impairing of two channels.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Invalid definition of the protection areas or the kinematic chains.
desc_en: There are no valid definitions of the protection areas and / or the kinematic chain. This alarm only occurs if an error occurred the last time the procedure PROTA was called, and its cause has not been eliminated. Protection areas and kinematic chain must be defined without errors. This is achieved by calling the procedure PROTA and closing it without errors.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: The call of the function / procedure %3 is only permissible if the function 'Collision monitoring' is present.
desc_en: The function or procedure stated in the alarm text (e.g. PROTA or PROTD) can only be called if the function "Collision avoidance" is present. The function "Collision avoidance" must be activated. For this, the MD18890 $MN_MM_MAXNUM_3D_PROT_AREAS must contain a value greater than zero.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Emergency stop due to collision %3 %4

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 risk of collision preactivated protection areas %3 and %4
desc_en: A collision was detected involving at least one preactivated protection area. Such a collision can occur if the interface signal assigned to a preactivated protection area has been activated. In other words, if a preactivated protection area has become an active protection area. Either a preactivated and a (static) active protection area can be involved in the collision, or two preactivated protection areas can be involved. The names of the protection areas are output in the alarm test. Reset activating interface signals. Redefine protection areas. Retract

desc_en: Definition of the tool is incorrect. The cause of the error is defined more closely by the following error number: - 1. The cutting edge position is invalid. Valid range is [0...9]. - 2. The sum $TC_DP10 + $TC_DP24 must be less than 180 degrees so that the insert angle is greater than zero. Correct input parameters.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Incorrect AFIS configuration for axis %3 identifier %4
desc_en: Automatic filter switching (AFIS) is active, but with an incorrect configuration for an axis. 1: The axis is configured as AFIS axis, but no jerk filter is activated by MD32400 $MA_AX_JERK_ENABLE. The jerk filter must always be active for AFIS axes. 2: The axis is configured with only one filter chain (e.g. MD32402 $MA_AX_JERK_MODE=0x). Two filter chains must always be configured for AFIS axes. 3: The axis has the configuration MD32332 $MA_AFIS_ENABLE=1 and MD32402 $MA_AX_JERK_MODE=5x. This configuration is not allowed for a channel axis in a channel with MD20630 $MC_AFIS_MODE=1. 1: Activate the jerk filter for the axis with MD32400 $MA_AX_JERK_ENABLE 2: a: Parameterize two filter chains for the axis with MD32402 $MA_AX_JERK_MODE b: Deactivate AFIS for the axis: MD32332 $MA_AFIS_ENABLE = FALSE 3: Change values of MD32332 $MA_AFIS_ENABLE, MD32402 $MA_AX_JERK_MODE or MD20630 $MC_AFIS_MODE

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 SW limit switch deactivated
desc_en: Via the HMI, the SI acceptance test Safe limit position has been started, for example with the acceptance test wizard. For these acceptance tests, the single-channel software limit switches are deactivated for the axis/spindle, in order to assure that the safe limit positions can be approached. Deselect the acceptance test, for example with the acceptance test wizard, or wait until completed. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 parameterisation of MD %2[%3] invalid, error code %4
desc_en: The parameterization of the specified machine data is incorrect. An additional indication is the array index of the machine data. If the machine data is a single machine data item, a zero is specified as the array index. This alarm occurs in accordance with the displayed error code in the following connections: 43: For an axis with safety functions, no PROFIdrive drive has been parameterized for the setpoint/actual value channel assignment in MD30100 $MA_CTRLOUT_SEGMENT_NR. 44: For an axis with safety functions, an invalid value was parameterized for the basic address assignment in MD37954 $MA_SAFE_INFO_MODULE_NR. Check and change the specified MD. Reset the enable of the SIC/SCC connection (MD37950 $MA_SAFE_INFO_ENABLE).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Safety operating mode inconsistent: %1 = %2; PLC configuration = %3
desc_en: The NCK-side Safety mode does not match the value of the PLC configuration. Align Safety mode between NCK and PLC. - The Safety mode defined in the PLC configuration is not permitted. The PLC configuration must be changed. - Operation as F-PLC is not possible. The function enable in MD19500 $ON_SAFE_PLC_LOGIC must be reset.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 Parameterizing error: MD %2 [%3] invalid

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axes %1 and %2 parameterized with the same SIC/SCC address %3.
desc_en: The same base address for communication with a drive was selected for the specified axes. This is not permissible. Correct the drive assignment for the two specified axes. Different logical base addresses must be selected for assignment to the specified axes via MD37954 $MA_SAFE_INFO_MODULE_NR and MD13374 $MN_SAFE_INFO_DRIVE_LOGIC_ADDR.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: F logic option not set
desc_en: The option for F logic MD19500 $ON_SAFE_PLC_LOGIC is not available. Align option data and safety operating mode.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Axis %1 Control not ready for the drive-integrated safe brake test
desc_en: The motion control rejects the request for the drive-integrated "safe brake test" via the VDI interface. Possible causes: - When the brake test was selected via the VDI, the interpolator or the axis had not stopped, therefore the axis in motion or exact stop was not (no longer) given. - A new brake test was requested, but the previous brake test had not yet finished in the control. - Another axis was in motion in the channel. The alarm disappears automatically if the conditions in the motion control for performing the drive-integrated "safe brake test" are fulfilled, or the request for the drive-integrated "safe brake test" is withdrawn.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: PROFIBUS DP: SI fault on axis %1, code %2, value %3, time %4.
desc_en: The drive signals SI fault %2 with the further information %3 at instant %4. See drive documentation for fault codes/fault values.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: PROFIBUS DP: SI fault on axis %1, code %2, value %3, time %4.
desc_en: The drive signals SI fault %2 with the further information %3 at instant %4. See drive documentation for fault codes/fault values.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: NCU link connection to all other NCUs of the link network has been canceled
desc_en: All NCUs in the NCU link network exchange data cyclically (sign-of-life). If this alarm occurs, sign-of-life signals have not been received from any other NCUs on the NCU network. This fault in the link can have various causes: - Defective hardware. - The machine data which configure the NCU link are not the same on all NCUs. - An identical interpolator cycle time has not been selected on all NCUs.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: NCU link connection to the NCU %1 of the link network has been canceled
desc_en: All NCUs in the NCU link network exchange data cyclically (sign-of-life). If this alarm occurs, sign-of-life signals have not been received from one other NCU on the NCU network. (see alarm parameters) This fault in the link can have various causes: - Defective hardware. - The machine data which configure the NCU link are not identical on all NCUs. - An identical interpolator cycle time has not been selected on all NCUs. - Check the IPO cycle on all the NCUs. - If necessary, check NCU link-specific alarms first.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Error on activation of machine data, NCU network-wide machine data were modified by NCU %1
desc_en: During the activation of machine data with NEWCONFIG or during an operator panel RESET, NCU network-wide machine data were modified on another NCU. This alarm can only occur when a link connection is active. Repeat the operator action or, if NEWCONFIG is activated by an NC program, terminate the program with Reset.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: Synchronization of the life cycle in the NCU link failed after %1 attempts.
desc_en: At a specific point in time during NCK ramp-up, the NCK switches to the cyclic plane; in other words, the IPO and servo tasks start to work. If these points in time deviate too significantly in the NCU link grouping, this alarm 280003 will appear. This delay time can be increased in IPO cycle steps by increasing the machine data LINK_LIFECYCLE_MAX_LOOP.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: NCU link: NCU %1 of the link network is not on the bus
desc_en: Error message of the NCU link module. When the NCU link was powered up, the local NCU (indicated by the alarm) detected that the NCU with the number in the alarm parameter was not on the bus although it should be connected according to the MD settings. This fault in the link can have various causes: - Defective hardware. - The machine data which configure the NCU link are not identical on all NCUs. - An identical interpolator cycle time has not been selected on all NCUs. Check the machine data configuration and link hardware.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: NCU link: NCU %1 of the link network not running synchronously
desc_en: Error message of the NCU link module. When the NCU link was powered up, the local NCU (indicated by the alarm) detected that the NCU with the number in the alarm parameter was not running synchronously. This fault in the link can have various causes: - The machine data which configure the NCU link are not identical on all NCUs. - An identical interpolator cycle time has not been selected on all NCUs. Check machine data configuration.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: NCU link: conflict in configuration data of NCU %1
desc_en: Error message of the NCU link module. When the NCU link was powered up, the local NCU (indicated by the alarm) detected a conflict between its configuration and the configuration of the NCU in the alarm parameter. Example: MD18782 $MN_MM_LINK_NUM_OF_MODULES defines the number of nodes on the NCU link network. The alarm occurs if this MD has a different setting on different NCUs. NC alarms 4.1 NC alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: NCU link: conflict in timer setting of NCU %1
desc_en: Error message of the NCU link module. When the NCU link was powered up, the local NCU (indicated by the alarm) detected a conflict between its timer configuration and the configuration of the NCU in the alarm parameter. Check machine data configuration.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: NCU link: conflict in bus parameters of NCU %1
desc_en: Error message of the NCU link module. When the NCU link was powered up, the local NCU (indicated by the alarm) detected a conflict between its timer bus configuration and the configuration of the NCU in the alarm parameter. Check machine data configuration.

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: NCU link: the NCU %1 has not received a message %2, %3
desc_en: Error message of the NCU link module. During operation of the NCU link, a message from the local NCU to the NCU specified in the alarm parameter has failed. A hardware error may have occurred (e.g. sporadic disturbances on the communication line).

title: ЧПУ · указатель
message_en: IPO time insufficient for NCU link. Link cycle time: %1
desc_en: Error message of the NCU link module. All messages must be transmitted within one interpolator cycle. This applies particularly to messages retries. The time was not sufficient! desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. If the error message comes from CYCLE9960: Start/end RA1: Set measuring range is not compatible with the traversing range (machine data 36100 $MA_POS_LIMIT_MINUS) of rotary axis 1. Start/end RA2: Set measuring range is not compatible with the traversing range (machine data 36100 $MA_POS_LIMIT_MINUS) of rotary axis 2. The measuring range is always considered in the clockwise direction from the start to the end Example: Start = 0°, end = -45°, traversing range of the axis -90°..90° => error because the measuring range is interpreted from 0° to 315° and not from -45° to 0°. Error message is displayed when measuring the kinematics of a grinding machine: 1st measurement: Starting position is "Beta" = 0°, "Beta" <> 0° leads to the error message. For the 2nd and 3rd measurements, "Beta" has to be rotated further, either in the positive or negative direction. A change in the direction of rotation leads to the error message.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Transformation not active: %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. The specified transformation is not active. You have to activate the transformation data set before you can use it. TRAORI before CYCLE832: The multi-axis program was selected in the High Speed Setting mask. This assumes that a TRAORI is active during machining. If CYCLE832 is called before TRAORI, incorrect rotary axes may be used to consider the compressor. A mandatory TRAORI call must be made before the CYCLE832 call. The rotary axes of the active TRAORI are only used with this sequence. If no TRAORI is active before the CYCLE832 call, the rotary axes of the 1st and 2nd transformation found on the basis of the machine data and the 1st and 2nd TRAORI/ TRAORI_DYN found are generally assumed for the consideration of the compressor. This can result in incorrectly decelerated rotary axes, for example. If compatibility is required, the alarm can be suppressed with Bit5 SD55220 $SCS_FUNCTION_MASK_MILL_TOL_SET

desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Error code: A: Only new swivel plane permitted, see parameter _ST B: Angular range >= 360 -> angular range of the B axis >= 360 degrees C: Rotary axis vector V1 is not equal to 0 1 0 -> rotary axis vector V1 must rotate around Y See setup of swivel CYCLE800 D: Rotary axis vector V2 -> rotary axis vector V2 must rotate around X (1 0 0) or Z (0 0 1) See setup of swivel CYCLE800 E: WCS ROT Y > 90 -> active rotation of the Work (WCS) around Y is >90 degrees. -90 to +90 is permitted F: If geometry axis Y is not available -> SD55221 set Bit 5 = 1 G: Initial setting defines ($TC_CARR37] HUNDREDTHOUSANDS digit -Z or -X) -> SD55221 set Bit 5 = 1 See setup of swivel CYCLE800 H: Align tool, but active plane not G18 I: 1st turning technology (MD52200=1) and no Y axis available -> mirroring not allowed J: 1st turning technology (MD52200=1) and no Y axis available -> rotation around Y not possible K: Grinding technology (MD52200=3) and align tool -> SD55221 set Bit 5 = 1 L: Grinding technology (MD52200=3) and align tool -> set MD20186 = 1 Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms

desc_en: The difference between actual and setpoint measurements is greater than the upper tolerance limit (screen parameter TUL): - TUL is the upper tolerance limit of the measurement difference. - TUL is always related to the material, irrespective of whether external or internal machining is involved. - The hole/pocket is thus too small and the spigot is too large. - This means that further material can be removed. - The measuring cycle parameter TUL corresponds to "upper deviation", the usual term used in mechanical engineering for fits and tolerances. message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check probe type
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Measurement of workpiece: Check tool type of measuring probe in the tool management. When measuring workpiece milling, tool types 710, 712, 713 or 714 should preferably be used. But a type 1xy can also be used. Type 710 is permitted for workpiece measurement in all measuring cycles. Types 712, 713 and 714 are intended for special measuring tasks. When measuring workpiece turning, tool type 580 should preferably be used. However, a type 1xy can also be used, but only if setting data $SC_TOOL_LENGTH_TYPE=2 is set. Measurement of tool: - For measuring tool milling, no permissible tool probe type is entered in SD54633 $SNS_MEA_TP_TYPE[S_PRNUM-1] or SD54648 $SNS_MEA_TPW_TYPE[S_PRNUM-1]. For probe type "Disk" the permissible working plane G17...G19 must be checked. - "Cube" is the only tool probe type permitted on milling/turning machines: SD54633 $SNS_MEA_TP_TYPE=0 and SD54648 $SNS_MEA_TPW_TYPE=0
