message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check selected tool type
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Measure workpiece: - Specify new S_PRNUM or recalibrate probe - Check whether the probe (type 7xx or 5xx) is suitable for the measuring task Measure tool: Tool type impermissible for calibration (adjustment) of the tool probe.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check position of cutting edge
desc_en: When measuring the workpiece for the technology turning, cutting edge positions 7 and 8 are allowed for probe type 580. Cutting edge positions 5 and 6 are also possible in special applications, such as measuring at the counterspindle. When measuring the workpiece for the technology turning, check the cutting edge position of the probe in the tool list. When measuring the tool for the technology turning with orientable toolholders, the active cutting edge position of the probe is evaluated. In this case, the currently active cutting edge position must be checked.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Center and radius cannot be determined
desc_en: No circle can be calculated from the measured points, as all measured points lie on a straight line. Program change

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check number of circle calculation points
desc_en: Parameterization faulty. 3 or 4 points are required to calculate the center point. Change parameterization of CYCLE116.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check weighting factor
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check call parameter CYCLE114
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check call parameter CYCLE114.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2: check tool name / number
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. - Check parameter S_TNAME. With active tool management, parameter S_TNAME is empty or the specified tool name is unknown to the tool management.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check WO memory number
desc_en: The work offset to be corrected does not exist. Or a correction should be made to the coordinate rotation of a global work offset. Global work offsets have only linear offsets and no rotational offsets. It is therefore not possible to correct measured angles or other rotational offsets in them. Check the number of the work offset to be corrected that is specified in the measuring cycle mask. Check also the parameters S_KNUM and S_KNUM1 in the measuring cycle interface. If the machine data 18601 $MN_MM_NUM_GLOBAL_USER_FRAMES is greater than zero, all work offsets are globally defined. In this case, no coordinate rotation can be corrected. If you want to correct a coordinate rotation, the machine data 18601 must be set to zero so that the work offsets are defined according to the specific channel. For this the machine data 18601 $MN_MM_NUM_GLOBAL_USER_FRAMES and 28080 $MC_MM_NUM_USER_FRAMES must be checked Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check 4th digit of _KNUM
desc_en: The stated digit of _KNUM includes invalid values. Also check _MVAR. Check parameter for the tool offset target (_KNUM) and the measurement variant (S_MVAR).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check 5th digit of _KNUM
desc_en: The stated digit of _KNUM includes invalid values. Also check _MVAR. Check parameter for the tool offset target (_KNUM) and the measurement variant (S_MVAR).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check 6th digit of _KNUM
desc_en: The stated digit of _KNUM includes invalid values. Also check _MVAR. Check parameter for the tool offset target (_KNUM) and the measurement variant (S_MVAR).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check measuring axis/offset axis
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check the parameter for the measuring axis (X, Y, Z).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check measuring direction
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Milling measuring cycles: - Check the measuring direction (+/-) entered in the mask. Turning measuring cycles: - Check the current pre-positioning of the workpiece probe with reference to the entered inner or outer measurement (setpoint).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Program reset required
desc_en: NC reset required. Execute NC reset.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check D number
desc_en: The D number in parameter _KNUM is larger than the maximum value in the machine data 18105 $MN_MM_MAX_CUTTING_EDGE_NO. Only cutting edges 1 and 2 are permitted for the "simultaneous measurement" function. Check the parameter for the tool offset target (S_KNUM1). Check the value in the machine data 18105 $MN_MM_MAX_CUTTING_EDGE_NO.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check rotary axis
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Coordinate rotation active
desc_en: No measuring possible in the rotated coordinate system. Check the conditions for measuring.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Angle too large, change measuring axis
desc_en: The parameter Start angle (alpha 0) is too large for the specified measuring axis. Select a different measuring axis or check the value for the start angle.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Modify tool tip position
desc_en: The tool tip is below the measuring probe surface (e.g. for a ring gauge or cube). Place the tool above the measuring probe surface.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check calibration block number
desc_en: The _CALNUM parameter is too large.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check safety area
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check parameters for the protection area: -XS -YS -ZS

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Reserved
desc_en: Alarm triggered: Reserved reserved

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Geometry axes do not exist
desc_en: Not all the geometry axes required for measurement or machining are configured. Machine data 20060[0..2] $MC_AXCONF_GEOAX_NAME_TAB must be checked and, if necessary, changed.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check measuring input
desc_en: Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Positioning speed equal to zero
desc_en: In some measuring variants, e.g. measuring spigots (CYCLE977), intermediate paths are generated in addition to the actual measuring paths. These are traversed at a specific feed rate. The values for the feed rate can be found in the setting data 55634 $SCS_MEA_FEED_PLANE_VALUE, 55636 $SCS_MEA_FEED_FEEDAX_VALUE and 55640 $SCS_MEA_FEED_CIRCLE. Check the values for the feed rate in the setting data 55634 $SCS_MEA_FEED_PLANE_VALUE, 55636 $SCS_MEA_FEED_FEEDAX_VALUE and 55640 $SCS_MEA_FEED_CIRCLE.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2:Correction factor for rapid traverse speed = 0
desc_en: The correction factor for rapid traverse speed is 0. Check setting data 55632 $SCS_MEA_FEED_RAPID_IN_PERCENT.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Incorrect alarm number
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Internal error in measuring cycles.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe not calibrated in active plane or wrong calibration data record
desc_en: The probe is not calibrated in the active plane or an incorrect calibration data set has been selected. Calibrate the probe before measuring. Check the number of the probe calibration data field (calibration data record) in parameter S_PRNUM. Note planes G17, G18 and G19. Only G18 is permitted for workpiece measurement when turning. Check: Setting data 54611 $SNS_MEA_WP_FEED[S_PRNUM-1] > 0 after calibration

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Upgrade NCK software version
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Upgrade NCU software version.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: %[[channel %1: ] block %2:%]Tool does not exist: %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check the tool name.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Several tools are active
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Remove tool from another spindle.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: D number of tool offset, too many digits
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Reduce the D number in _KNUM or check MD of flat D number.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Distance between starting point and measuring point is smaller than or equal to zero
desc_en: The distance between the starting point and the measuring point is less than or equal to 0. The parameters X1 or X2 are not occupied or smaller than 0. Check parameters X1 and X2.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Angle 1st edge - 2nd edge equals 0
desc_en: The parameter following angle (alpha 1) is 0. Check the parameter following angle (alpha 1).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Angle rel. to reference edge equals 0
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Programm continuation: Clear alarm with the RESET key. Restart part program Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Distance upper probe edge - measuring position = 0 for tool radius measurement
desc_en: The distance between the upper edge and lower edge of the tool probe is 0. This is relevant for radius measurement. Check the setting data 54634 $SNS_MEA_TP_CAL_MEASURE_DEPTH.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Feed, speed not programmed for tool measurement with rotating spindle
desc_en: No feed rate or spindle speed is programmed for tool measurement with rotating spindle. Check parameters F1 and S1.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool length or radius is 0
desc_en: The active tool length or the active tool radius is 0. Cutter: - Check length and radius of the active tool in the compensation data memory Drill: - Check length of the active tool in the compensation data memory - Radius or tip angle of the active tool must be predefined in the compensation data memory

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Path for logfile not permitted
desc_en: The specified path for the log file is incorrect. Check the programmed path specification. Check parameter _PROTNAME[0]. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Path for logfile not found
desc_en: The specified directory does not exist or the specified path is incorrect. Check the programmed path specification. Check parameter _PROTNAME[0].

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Log file not found
desc_en: No name specified for the log file. Check the programmed path specification. Check parameter _PROTNAME[0].

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Incorrect file type for logfile
desc_en: The file extension for the log file is incorrect. The file extensions .txt and .csv are permitted. Check parameter _PROTNAME[0].

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Logfile is being used
desc_en: The log file is already used by an NC program.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: %[[Channel %1: ] Block %2: %] Not enough NC memory or too many files/directories in the NC
desc_en: There is not enough NC memory available or there are too many files or directories in the NC file system. Delete files whose names are comprised exclusively of numbers, e.g. "201202100938202_MPF", in the directory / _N_WKS_DIR/_N_TEMP_WPD. Also check whether other files in this directory can be deleted. Check, and if required, increase machine data 18320: $MN_MM_NUM_FILES_IN_FILESYSTEM.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Error during logging: WRITE command %4
desc_en: Internal error caused by the WRITE command. Causes of error codes: 10 The file size specified in MD11420 $MN_LEN_PROTOCOL_FILE has been reached (file is full). Machine data MD11420 must be set to a value of at least 20 kB, and this sets the maximum size of the log file. - Increase the value in MD11420 or - Select log data "new" in cycle150 (data are overwritten) or - Delete log file or - Create new log file (change the name of the log file in CYCLE150) Error code 10 occurs only when logging in the passive file system of the NC. 13 The protection level must be greater than or equal to the Write right of the stated log file. 16 Check the path of the log file (invalid external path). Other errors: See Programming Guide: WRITE command Save measurement results: After eliminating the cause of the error, the associated log can be generated with the function "Report last measurement".

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Error recording in table format: %4
desc_en: Internal error

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Error recording in JOG: %4
desc_en: Internal error Call the hotline!

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Error reporting last measurement %4
desc_en: Internal error Call the hotline!

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tolerance of the linear vector %4 exceeded
desc_en: If the error comes from CYCLE996 or CYCLE9960: The tolerance of the linear vectors is exceeded during the measurement of the kinematics. The value of the tolerance is transferred in parameter TLIN. If TLIN=0 or tolerance (check) = no, the measured vectors are not monitored. A 2nd measurement with a larger tolerance can be made for the analysis. The kinematic data should not be overwritten. The newly measured vectors are documented in the measurement log (data file).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tolerance of the rotary axis vector %4 exceeded
desc_en: The rotary axis orientation is also calculated during kinematic measurement. If the deviation is negligible and only the tolerance range is too small, this can be changed in $SN_CORR_TRAFO_DIR_MAX. A deviation of the rotary axis orientation can also have a mechanical cause. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check distance between measuring points %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. In automatic mode, the Distance measuring points (_ID) parameter must be checked. In JOG mode, the selected measuring points are congruent. The measuring points must be redefined.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check circular feed
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check parameter SD55640 $SCS_MEA_FEED_CIRCLE

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Direction of rotation for tool measurement with rotating spindle not specified.
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check setting data 54674 $SNS_MEA_CM_SPIND_ROT_DIR. Permissible values are 3 (corresponds to M3) or 4 (corresponds to M4)

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2: parameters %4 are identical
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Specify different positions for the relevant points of P1(X1,Y1), P2(X2,Y2), P3(X3,Y3) and P4(X4,Y4).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [channel %1: ] block %2: straights through parameter %4 do not intersect
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Specify different positions for the relevant points of P1(X1,Y1), P2(X2,Y2), P3(X3,Y3) and P4(X4,Y4).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Position of corner not clearly definable, check parameter %4
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Define points P1(X1,Y1) and P2(X2,Y2) or P3(X3,Y3) and P4(X4,Y4) so that the intersection of the straight lines passing through these points lies outside the sections formed by P1(X1,Y1) and P2(X2,Y2) or P3(X3,Y3) and P4(X4,Y4).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Product of column width and number of columns is greater than %4 characters per line
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check user programming in CUST_MEAPROT.SPF.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: selected meas.variant requires SPOS-capable spindle
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Change the measuring variant or check the machine equipment. If the error message comes from CYCLE9960: Calibration of the probe on ball is not possible with non-SPOS-capable spindle. Select measuring variant without calibration.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: No SPOS-capable spindle available
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. - Check configuration/parameterization of the spindle axis - If the intention to use a 3D workpiece probe at a "non-SPOS capable spindle", then check the setting of MD 52207 $MCS_AXIS_USAGE_ATTRIB[n], bit 9 (also see Commissioning instructions, cycles) - If a 3D workpiece probe is attached to the machine outside the spindle, then check the setting of MD 51740 $MNS_MEA_FUNCTION_MASK, bit 4. (also see Commissioning instructions, cycles)

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe not calibrated in axis direction %4
desc_en: The probe is not calibrated in the specified axis direction. Axis calibration is deleted if the following conditions change between two calibrations: - Measuring speed - Spindle position - Rotations of the coordinate system - Reference of probe length to ball end or center (MD51740 Bit 1) - Correction of ball diameter in tool or calibration data (MD54740 Bit 3) Calibrate the probe in the specified axis direction. Check part program and make sure that no condition mentioned above has been changed between two calibrations.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Trigger values of measuring sensor are incompatible
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Trigger values of the tool measuring sensor must be fully described either via the _TP[] / _TPW[] fields or via the setting data (SD: 54625-54632 or SD: 54640-54647). A mixture of the two variants is not permitted.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Number of teeth missing from tool parameters
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Enter the number of teeth of the tool in the tool management.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Dimensional tolerance %4 exceeded
desc_en: Error message is displayed while measuring the kinematics of a grinding machine: When the kinematics are measured (CYCLE496), it is checked whether the measured vectors lie within the tolerance value of setting data $SCS_GRIND_MEA_KIN_TOL. Error message is displayed while measuring the kinematics of a grinding machine: Enter the vectors of the kinematics in advance so that the tolerance value in setting data 55844 $SCS_GRIND_MEA_KIN_TOL is not exceeded during the following measuring process.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool spindle is not the master spindle
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Before calling the measuring cycles, the tool spindle must be defined as master spindle (SETMS...). Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Too many teeth
desc_en: Tools with a maximum of 100 teeth can be measured. Check the number of teeth of the tool in tool management.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool probe width too small
desc_en: The width of the tool probe is too small. Check the following machine data: 51781 $MNS_MEA_T_PROBE_THICKNESS[n]

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Coupling the spindle position with coordinate rotation around %4 not executable
desc_en: The alarm relates to the cross-measuring tasks measuring cycle function "Coupling of spindle position with coordinate rotation around the infeed axis". This function requires a positionable spindle. If a positionable spindle is not available for holding the workpiece probe, the function "Coupling the spindle position with coordinate rotation around the infeed axis" can be deactivated with setting data 55740 $SCS_MEA_FUNCTION_MASK, bit 1=0.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 probe is attached to the machine, measuring variant is not possible
desc_en: The measuring variant cannot be executed with a probe permanently mounted on the machine. The selected measuring variant requires rotational positioning/alignment of the probe. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Rotary axis 1: Diameter tolerance of calibration ball of measurement %4 exceeded
desc_en: CYCLE996: See measured diameter in the parameters _OVR[72] to _OVR[74] or the value in the SD $SCS_MEA_KIN_DM_TOL CYCLE9960: See measured diameter in the parameters _OVR[72] or the value in the SD $SCS_MEA_KIN_DM_TOL Check the calibration data or recalibrate the 3D probe. Check also the mechanical structure (stiffness) of the calibration ball in the machine.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Rotary axis 2: Diameter tolerance of calibration ball of measurement %4 exceeded
desc_en: CYCLE996: See measured diameter in the parameters _OVR[75] to _OVR[77] or the value in the SD $SCS_MEA_KIN_DM_TOL CYCLE9960: See measured diameter in the parameters _OVR[75] or the value in the SD $SCS_MEA_KIN_DM_TOL Check the calibration data or recalibrate the 3D probe. Check also the mechanical structure (stiffness) of the calibration ball in the machine.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe not calibrated in the coordinate system
desc_en: Probe has not been calibrated in the coordinate system set in MD52000 $MCS_DISP_COORDINATE_SYSTEM. Calibrate the probe before measurement.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Invalid protection level for executing measuring cycles %4
desc_en: The protection level is inadequate for the execution of measuring cycles. Check machine data 51742 $MNS_MEA_ACCESS_EXEC and 11160 $NM_ACCESS_EXEC_CST.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Internal execution error
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Call the SIEMENS hotline

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe does not switch, path reduced by software end position %4
desc_en: The traversing path would extend beyond the software end position on the current measuring axis. The traversing path has currently been shortened, and does not reach the position specified as a setpoint. Alarm 61401 is output after 5 unsuccessful contact attempts. - Check setpoint value specification. - Reduce the measuring distance (DFA). - Place the workpiece further away from the software end position.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Probe collision, path reduced by software end position %4
desc_en: This alarm is only output with external measurements (web, spigot, ball) in conjunction with a possible collision in the infeed axis. The collision is caused by the reduction of the path in the measuring axis of the working plane, before lowering the infeed axis to the measuring height. The probe was switched during the following infeed in the infeed axis. If the path had not been reduced, the traversing movement would have extended beyond the software end position of the working plane, and the corresponding NCK alarm 10722 would have been triggered. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Work offset correction not executed
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. The measurement result contains more than one rotation component around the geometry axes of the coordinate system. However, only one of the rotation components of a rotary axis can be corrected. To prevent any consequential position errors, the offset of the selected rotary axis is not performed. "Correction into the coordinate system" must be selected as the bypass.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool correction not executed
desc_en: The offset of the selected tool could not be executed because of the current tool status. The following applies to tools without a tool status: - Must not be disabled, must have been active and in use. The following applies to tools that form a tool grouping: - Must not be disabled, must have been active and in use. Check the tool state and adapt accordingly.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tool environment does not exist
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Correct the name of the tool environment (_TENV) or create this environment. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Check DL number
desc_en: Reaction: Interpreter stop NC Start disable in this channel. Interface signals are set. Alarm display. Check parameter DL. Check also the number of the sum and setup offset.

desc_en: In the case of dual-channel stock removal with Balance Cutting machining (finishing or roughing with parameter DCH=0), the tool position from the leading channel from CYCLE952 is approached before the axis coupling is switched on in the following channel. In the actual case, the tool position from the leading channel violates the software limit switch in the following channel. A position must be approached in the leading channel, which can also be approached in the following channel without violating the software limit switch.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Allowance
desc_en: The difference between actual and setpoint measurements is greater than the upper tolerance limit (screen parameter TUL): - TUL is the upper tolerance limit of the measurement difference. - TUL is always related to the material, irrespective of whether external or internal machining is involved. - The hole/pocket is thus too small and the spigot is too large. - This means that further material can be removed. - The measuring cycle parameter TUL corresponds to "upper deviation", the usual term used in mechanical engineering for fits and tolerances. The difference between actual and setpoint value is larger than upper tolerance limit (parameter _TUL). Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Dimension too small
desc_en: The difference between the actual and setpoint measurement is less than the lower tolerance limit (screen parameter TLL): - TLL is the lower tolerance limit of the measurement difference. - TLL is always related to the material, irrespective of whether external or internal machining is involved. - The hole/pocket is thus too large and the spigot too small. - This means that too much material has already been removed. - The measuring cycle parameter TLL corresponds to "lower deviation", the usual term used in mechanical engineering for fits and tolerances. The difference between actual and setpoint value is smaller than lower tolerance limit (parameter _TLL).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Path limitation via software end position %4, collision detection activated, continue with NC START / cancel with RESET
desc_en: This alarm is only output with external measurements (web, spigot, ball) as a query about the program continuation before the lowering movement in the infeed axis The alarm scan is caused by the reduction of the path of the measuring axis in the working plane that has just been made. If the path had not been reduced, the traversing movement would have extended beyond the software end position of the working plane. A corresponding NCK alarm 10722 would have been triggered. With program stop, the user can check whether the infeed axis can be lowered to measuring height without causing a collision. Alarm 61402 is output if there is a switch (collision) of the probe in the subsequent movement of the infeed axis. - Check setpoint value specification. - Place the workpiece further away from the software limit position.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tolerance of the linear vector %4 exceeded
desc_en: If the error comes from CYCLE996 or CYCLE9960: The tolerance of the linear vectors is exceeded during the measurement of the kinematics. The value of the tolerance is transferred in parameter TLIN. If TLIN=0 or tolerance (check) = no, the measured vectors are not monitored. A 2nd measurement with a larger tolerance can be made for the analysis. The kinematic data should not be overwritten. The newly measured vectors are documented in the measurement log (data file).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: Tolerance of the rotary axis vector %4 exceeded
desc_en: The rotary axis orientation is also calculated during kinematic measurement. If the deviation is negligible and only the tolerance range is too small, this can be changed in $SN_CORR_TRAFO_DIR_MAX. A deviation of the rotary axis orientation can also have a mechanical cause. If the deviation is very large, the cause may be a small measuring circuit. With a rotary table, the calibration ball must not be too close to the center of rotation. With head kinematics, the measuring circuit can be enlarged by positioning the 2nd rotary axis when measuring the first.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2: No internal correction of the calibration data
desc_en: Reaction: Alarm display. Check probe alignment/spindle position! The alignment (programmed position) of the tool probe in the workspindle must be identical during calibration and measuring! If these positions vary, the calibration data cannot be corrected cycle-internally with regards to a coordinate rotation of the workplane around the infeed axis!

message_en: [Channel %1: ] Block %2 Individual edges lie outside the dimensional difference: %4

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: incorrect MD configuration, error code: %2
desc_en: On ramp-up the following error was found in the clearance control machine data: Error code = -1: The intermediate points of one of the two sensor characteristics are not rising or falling strictly monotonously. Error code = -2: One of the two sensor characteristics has less than 2 valid intermediate points. Error code = -3: One of the two sensor characteristics has more than 5 intermediate points with negative velocity or more than 5 intermediate points with positive velocity. Error code = -4: The digital input for sensor collision monitoring as set in MD $MC_CLC_SENSOR_TOUCHED_INPUT has not been activated on the control ( 10350 $MN_FASTIO_DIG_NUM_INPUTS ) Error code = -5: No rapid input was assigned to the special function "Fast retraction in the position controller" via MD $MC_CLC_SENSOR_TOUCHED_INPUT. Error code = -6: The axis selected for the clearance control in MD $MC_CLC_AXNO is not active in the channel. Error code = -7: The 5-axis transformation ( 24100 $MC_TRAFO_TYPE_x ) selected for the clearance control in MD $MC_CLC_AXNO is not configured in the channel. Error code = -8: More than one of the axes involved in the clearance control is the master axis of a gantry grouping 37100 $MA_GANTRY_AXIS_TYPE Error code = -9: One of the axes involved in the clearance control is the slave axis of a gantry grouping 37100 $MA_GANTRY_AXIS_TYPE Error code = -10: Export versions will only enable activation of an axial clearance control, if less than four simulataneously interpolating axes have been configured. Error code = -11: In MD $MC_CLC_PROG_ORI_AX_MASK, no or three axes exactly may be configured for CLC(3). When three axes are configured, these must be assigned to the channel with $MC_AXCONF_MACHAX_USED. Modify relevant machine data

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: block %2 General programming error
desc_en: The activation / deactivation command for the clearance control "CLC(..)" accepts only the values 3, 2, 1, 0 and -1 as call parameters. This alarm signals that parameters are incorrect or missing. The activation command CLC(2) with monitoring of the sensor collision signal is accepted only if a valid digital input is configured for the monitoring signal in MD $MC_CLC_SENSOR_TOUCHED_INPUT. Modify part program. Configure the digital input for the collision evaluation in MD if necessary.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: block %2 CLC_LIM value exceeds MD limit
desc_en: One of the limits for the position offset of the clearance control programmed with CLC_LIM( ...,...) is greater than the permissible limitation set in the associated MD. $MC_CLC_SENSOR_LOWER_LIMIT[ 1 ] or $MC_CLC_SENSOR_UPPER_LIMIT[ 1 ]. Modify part program. Extend limitation in appropriate machine date. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: block %2 CLC(0) with active TRC
desc_en: The 3D clearance control has been switched off with CLC(0) while tool radius compensation is still active (G41/G42). Since CLC(0) empties the internal block buffer and accepts the current traversed position offset of the clearance control as a "contour jump" in the interpreter, TRC must be deactivated when this command is issued. Modify part program: Switch off active G41/G42 before CLC(0) or do not switch of clearance control, but just "freeze" temporarily (CLC_GAIN=0.0) or cancel the position offset mechanically with CLC(-1).

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: block %2 orientation changed for TRAFOOF
desc_en: 1. The 2D/3D clearance control has been switched off before the transformation. The tool direction according to G17/G18/G19 has been applied as the control direction. Switching on the transformation with rotary axis settings that define a different tool orientation requires an orientation step change and is therefore rejected. 2. The transformation has been switched off temporarily (TRAFOOF) while clearance control is still active. When the transformation is switched on again, the tool orientation must be the same as when it was switched off, i.e. the rotary axes must not be moved while the transformation is deactivated. Modify part program: Do not switch on the clearance control until the transformation is already active or make sure that the required conditions relating to orientation are observed.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: block %2 in programmable direction, error ID: %3
desc_en: The subfunction of the 3D clearance control programmed with CLC(3) "Closed-loop control in programmable direction" reports an error: Error ID: 0: CLC(3) was programmed without having set the corresponding option bit or without having entered an axis screen with three validly configured, simulated axes in MD $MC_CLC_PROG_ORI_AX_MASK. 1: The plane in which the closed-loop control direction is to be re-oriented, has not been defined. Probably, two directions programmed one after the other, are anti-parallel. Modify MD or the part program.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: error ID: %2, angle %3
desc_en: The subfunction of the 3D clearance control programmed with CLC(3) "Closed-loop control in programmable direction" reports an error: Error ID: 1: The clearance control direction has not been defined. Probably, [ 0,0,0 ] has been programmed for the three simulated axes specifying the direction components. In the "angle" parameter, zero is output. 2: The max. permissible angle between the orientation of the blast tool and the programmed control direction was exceeded. The permissible angle is set in machine data $MC_CLC_PROG_ORI_MAX_ANGLE. The angle triggering the alarm is output in the 3rd alarm parameter. Enlarge the monitoring angle or modify the programming in the part program.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: position offset at lower limit %2
desc_en: The position offset generated by the overlaid motion has reached the limit set in MD $MC_CLC_SENSOR_LOWER_LIMIT or programmed with CLC_LIM(...,...). Depending on the setting in bit 0 of MD $MC_CLC_SPECIAL_FEATURE_MASK the following cancel criterion applies: Bit 0 = 0: Cancel key Bit 0 = 1: Reset key Check position and form of the workpiece. If necessary, program further limits.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: position offset at upper limit %2
desc_en: The position offset generated by the overlaid motion has reached the limit set in MD $MC_CLC_SENSOR_UPPER_LIMIT or programmed with CLC_LIM(...,...). Depending on the setting in bit 1 of MD $MC_CLC_SPECIAL_FEATURE_MASK the following cancel criterion is active: Bit 1 = 0: Cancel key Bit 1 = 1: Reset Check position and form of the workpiece. If necessary, program further limits.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] CLC: stopped because sensor head has been touched
desc_en: The collision monitor of the sensor tip has signaled "Sensor touched". A retraction motion to the upper limit of the position offset ($MC_CLC_SENSOR_UPPER_LIMIT ) is started using the max available velocity and acceleration reserves. The feedrate override setting has no effect on this retraction motion. The path motion is stopped at the same time. The part program can be continued with NC start. The overlaid motion then returns to the control distance.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] MCSC: wrong MD configuration, error code %2
desc_en: Incorrect configuration in MD $MA_CC_MASTER_AXIS Error code = 2: This axis indicated in the alarm message or the CC_Master axis is a spindle. Error code = 4: Coupling between rotary and linear axes impermissible. Error code = 8: Coupled axes must not be exchanged between channels. Check machine data.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] MCSC: CC_COPON CC_COPOFF block number %2 error number %3
desc_en: Error code = 1: Wrong argument programmed Error code = 10: An axis for which no coupling has been defined, was programmed in CC_COPON (axis identifier). Error code = 20: Too many arguments programmed. Error code = 100: Internal error Error code = 200: Internal error Modify part program.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] MCSC: tolerance window exceeded axis %2
desc_en: The actual position value difference between the CC_Slave axis indicated in the alarm message and its CC_Master axis is outside the configured tolerance window. Check configured tolerance window. Compare dynamic settings of involved axes. Check mechanical components of axes. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] MCSC: MD modification on active coupling axis %2
desc_en: Machine data MD 63000 CC_MASTER_AXIS has been changed when the coupling was active. Reset machine data to its old value, switch off the coupling and then enter the new value.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] MCSC: axes to be coupled are not in standstill axis %2
desc_en: The CC_Master and/or CC_Slave axes were not at standstill when the coupling was switched on. Input G601 for path axes or program a stop preprocessor (STOPRE) before coupling with CC_COPON.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] MCSC: wrong machine data for collision protection axis %2
desc_en: Incorrect machine data for collision protection. Correct machine data. The axes must be either both rotary axes or both linear axes!

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] MCSC: collision monitoring axis %2
desc_en: The collision monitor has responded because the deceleration precomputation has detected that the distance between the axes has fallen below the configured distance. Traverse the axis out of the danger area in manual mode.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: CC_TPM Axis %1 stopped by external process monitoring system
desc_en: An external process monitoring system has stopped the axis, as tool breakage is to be expected or has already occured. Cycle alarms 5.1 Cycle alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: CC_TPM problem found in the (DPIO) configuration. Error ID = %1
desc_en: Error ID = -1: No DPIO range found that corresponds to $MN_TOOL_MON_LOGIC_ADDRESS_IN Error ID = -2: $MN_DPIO_RANGE_LENGTH_IN[ 'inIndex' ] is invalid (that is, less than 12 or more than 40) Error ID = -3: No DPIO range found that corresponds to $MN_TOOL_MON_LOGIC_ADDRESS_OUT Error ID = -4: $MN_DPIO_RANGE_LENGTH_OUT[ 'outIndex' ] is invalid (that is, less than 12 or more than 40) Error ID = -5: $MN_DPIO_RANGE_ATTRIBUTE_OUT[ 'outIndex' ] is invalid (bit_1 is not set) Error ID = -11: $MN_DPIO_RANGE_LENGTH_IN[ 'inIndex + 1' ] of the 2nd monitoring device is invalid Error ID = -12: $MN_DPIO_RANGE_LENGTH_OUT[ 'outIndex + 1' ] of the 2nd monitoring device is invalid Error ID = -13: $MN_DPIO_RANGE_ATTRIBUTE_OUT[ 'outIndex + 1' ] of the 2nd monitoring device is invalid Error ID = -20: General error reading machine data Error ID = 1: 61700__$MN_TOOL_MONITOR_AX_ASSIGN_TAB[0..7] contains the number of a machine axis that is not active. Please correct machine data

TRAFO6_TFLWP: The orientation entered in MD TRAFO6_TFLWP_RPY is impermissible. TRAFO6_TX3P3: The orientation entered in MD TRAFO6_TX3P3_RPY is impermissible. TRAFO6_MAIN_LENGTH_AB: The value entered in MD TRAFO6_MAIN_LENGTH_AB is incorrect. Correct machine data

desc_en: The transformer type entered in MD TRAFO_TYPE_x is incorrect TRAFO_TYPE 4100 is to be used

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RCTR: MD cannot be changed while transformation active.
desc_en: An attempt has been made to modify machine data of an active transformation via NEWCONF. This is not permissible, because a change to the machine data directly affects the current axis position, which is transformed from the basic coordinate system into the machine coordinate system in real time. Changing the transformation data during an active transformation would cause the axis positions to jump. Switch off transformation with TRAFOOF before the machine data is taken over by means of NEWCONF.

desc_en: A violation of the software limit switch of an axis has been detected while traversing with transformation active in JOG mode. JOG traverse in opposite direction.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RCTR: Excessive velocity near pole, error code %2 old value %3 new value %4
desc_en: Excessive velocity of the machine axes involved can occur when traversing near the pole with active transformation, especially in JOG mode. The alarm is triggered if excessive velocity or acceleration occurs for an output axis of the transformation (Machine). Error code: 0: Position jump 1: Excessive velocity 2: Excessive acceleration Depending on whether a position jump, excessive velocity or excessive acceleration occurs, the old and the new value for position, velocity or acceleration are output as third and fourth parameter. Reduce velocity. Avoid JOG traverse near pole.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RCTR: block: %2, unreachable position on interpolation
desc_en: On block interpolation a non-approachable position is detected: Modify part program.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] HSLC: Configuration error ID=%2

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] HSLC: CC_FASTON_CONT velocity too high
desc_en: The path-related switching signal output switched on by the part rogramm command CC_FASTON_CONT( PATH_DISTANCE_ON, PATH_DISTANCE_OFF ) cannot output all switching signals correctly at the current velocity. Reason: A maximum of one switching edge can be output per IPO cycle (see $MN_IPO_CYCLE_TIME ). The current path velocity is so high that there is more than one switching edge to be output within one path distance PATH_DISTANCE_ON or PATH_DISTANCE_OFF. Example: IPO cycle = 2ms ( position-control cycle = 1ms ) PATH_DISTANCE_ON = 0.667 PATH_DISTANCE_OFF = 0.667 Maximum path velocity in which no switching edges are lost: 20000 mm/min When alarm 75501 occurs, the function skips the output of two successive switching edges. This does not affect the position of subsequent switching edges. Note: Whether the ommission of a signal from the previous switching signal leaves a high or low level present, is purely coincidental. - Lengthen the operating travels programmed in the command CC_FASTON_CONT - Program the path velocity or reduce it with the override switch - Set a shorter IPO cycle (machine manufacturer only)

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] HSLC: Configuration error Power-On machine data ID=%2
desc_en: The error ID indicates the cause of the error as follows: 1: Internal error while reading Power-On MDs. 2: Internal error while reading Newconf MDs 3: DPIO range not configured 4: DPIO range length insufficient 5: DPIO range not assigned to the compile cycle Change the relevant machine data

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] HSLC: Configuration error Newconf machine data ID=%2
desc_en: The error ID indicates the cause of the error as follows: 1: Non-monotonous power table Change the relevant machine data

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: wrong MD configuration. Error code %2
desc_en: The following errors were detected in the machine data of the retrace support function when ramping up: Error code = 4 : Machine date $MC_MM_NUM_CC_BLOCK_ELEMENTS or $MC_MM_NUM_CC_BLOCK_USER_MEM must be increased. Error code = 5 : Insufficient heap memory for compile cycles available. Adjust machine data $MC_RESU_RING_BUFFER_SIZE, $MC_RESU_SHARE_OF_CC_HEAP_MEM and $MC_MM_NUM_CC_HEAP_MEM. Error code = 6 : The machine data $MN_ASUP_START_MASK and $MN_ASUP_START_PRIO_LEVEL are not set correctly. Error code = 11: Machine data $MC_AXCONF_GEOAX_NAME_TAB[n], $MN_INTERMEDIATE_POINT_NAME_TAB[n] and $MN_IPO_PARAM_NAME_TAB[n] are not set correctly for RESU: Error code = 13: With bit 1 = 0 of MD $MC_RESU_SPECIAL_FEATURE_MASK it was specified that the retraction program cc_resu.mpf is to be stored in the DRAM part program memory. However, no DRAM part program memory was requested via MD $MN_MM_DRAM_FILE_MEM_SIZE. Remedy: Either set MD $MN_MM_DRAM_FILE_MEM_SIZE to a value inequal to zero or set bit 1 of MD $MC_RESU_SPECIAL_FEATURE_MASK equal to one. Correct machine data.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: block %2 invalid parameter in CC_PREPRE()
desc_en: Only the values <arg> = -1 0 or 1 are valid parameters for programming CC_STOPRE( <arg>). Modify part program.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: Return traveling not possible, error code %2

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: internal error, error code %2
desc_en: With this alarm, RESU-internal error states are displayed which, together with the transferred error number, provide information on the error cause and error location. If this error occurs, please contact us on the SINUMERIK Hotline of the SIEMENS AG, specifying the error number.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: retraceable contour was shortened
desc_en: The block search buffer is full. Therefore the retraceable contour had to be shortened. This alarm has no effect on the current machining. If the alarm continues to occur frequently, the reason should be eliminated: adjust machine data $MC_RESU_RING_BUFFER_SIZE, $MC_RESU_SHARE_OF_CC_HEAP_MEM and $MC_MM_NUM_CC_HEAP_MEM.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: resynchronisation not possible
desc_en: The block search triggered by the compile cycle has been terminated with an error. It can have the following cause: The control is not in the correct operating mode, e.g. in JOG_ AUTO instead of in AUTO. Switch the control to the AUTO operating mode and restart resynchronisation.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: NC memory limit reached, RAM type %2
desc_en: A memory limit was reached on writing to file cc_resu.mpf. The possible area for return traveling is shortened. RAM type = 1: File cc_resu.mpf is created in the buffer memory (SRAM). The buffer memory is therefore full. If the buffer memory is used and if alarm 75608 with RAM type 1 is output, system alarm 6500 will be output simultaneously. RAM type = 2: The memory limit was reached on creating file cc_resu.mpf in the dynamic memory (DRAM part program memory). RAM type = 1: Increase size of buffer memory ($MN_MM_USER_MEM_BUFFERED) or the available space in the buffer memory, e.g. by unloading unused part programs. Alternatively the ring buffer can be decreased via MD $MC_RESU_RING_BUFFER_SIZE.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: POS axis not permitted, axis type %2, block no. %3
desc_en: A geometry axis is traversed as a positioning axis with CC_PREPRE active. This programming is not permissible. In order to traverse a geometry axis as positioning axis, RESU must be switched off temporarily (with CC_PREPRE(0) ) or completely. In order to make the internal axis state change from the geometry axis as positioning axis after traversing, a block without traveling motion must be programmed, if required: e.g. X=IC(0)

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: NC start currently not possible
desc_en: While RESU is active, no NC START must be performed in certain situations. If NC START is confirmed nevertheless, execution will be blocked and alarm 75610 will be displayed. This applies in the following situations: - On requesting return traveling: NC START is blocked when return traveling program cc_resu.mpf has been created and selected. - After having triggered continuation under NC STOP condition: as long as the internally started block search or the finally started ASUB cc_resu_bs_asup.spf is running. Wait for completion of the current internal procedure. Then delete the alarm with NC START and continue

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] RESU: Block %2 change to the NEWCONF machine data from RESU is not permitted
desc_en: The change to the NEWCONF machine data from RESU is not permitted if RESU is active or CC_PREPRE(1) is programmed.

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] PROT: Incorrect configuration no. %2
desc_en: Invalid configuration of the axis collision protection PROT Significance of the displayed error numbers: 1: The axes of one pair are not of the same axis type (linear / rotary axis) 2: A selected axis pair includes an axis not activated in any channel 8: In an assignment $MN_CC_PROTECT_PAIRS[ n ], only one axis was entered 16: MD $MN_CC_PROTECT_SAFE_DIR[ n ] or $MN_CC_PROTECT_OFFSET[ n ] was changed with collision monitoring active 32: The current position difference between the axes to be monitored is smaller than the monitoring window $MN_CC_PROTECT_WINDOW[ n ] 64: The axis is assigned to the channel in which PROT is not activated 128: Problem related to accessing machine data (internal error) Still missing

title: Циклы · указатель

desc_en: Trace file access error Close trace file or release memory space

title: Циклы · указатель
message_en: [Channel %1: ] PROT: Collision protection stops axis %2
desc_en: The axis collision protection function PROT has detected a risk of collision, and stopped the critical axes. Retract axis in JOG. Modify part program if necessary.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Image preparation suppressed, please wait.
desc_en: The control is so heavily loaded by the processing of a subroutine, that it cannot keep all the display values up-to-date. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the overload situation has been eliminated. If this alarm occurrs often, the start-up engineer will have to take appropriate measures (e.g. reduce IPO clock pulse rate).

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The settings for the acyclic links with the drive devices are not yet effective.%nSwitch off/on HMI !
desc_en: A file transfer from/to a drive device has failed as the settings for acyclic links with the drive devices become effective only after an HMI reboot. Switch off/on HMI and then repeat the process leading to the alarm.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: SINAMICS: Write job for parameter %1, value %2, area %3: %4s timeout!
desc_en: The write job of a SINAMICS parameter was not not acknowledged within 10 seconds by the drive device. If the write job is not acknowledged within the next 10 seconds, the alarm will again be triggered. The waiting period for the acknowledgment of a write job is a maximum of 130 seconds, i.e. if the timeout specified in the alarm is 130 seconds, it is assumed that the write job has failed. Otherwise it can be assumed that the write job was successful despite the timeout. As long as the timeout specified in the alarm is less than 130 seconds, acknowledge alarm, otherwise switch off/on control, drive system and HMI, and then repeat the process leading to the alarm.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Bus%1.Slave%2: %3: First commissioning of SINAMICS required!
desc_en: The drive device with the bus number and slave address specified in the alarm is in 'First commissioning' state. Execute first commissioning for the affected drive device. To do so, switch in the HMI to the dialog 'First commissioning > Drive system > Drive devices, select the affected drive device, and follow the instructions of the HMI. Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Bus%1.Slave%2: %3: Check/acknowledge topology!
desc_en: The drive device with the bus number and slave address specified in the alarm has detected an illegal difference between target topology and actual topology during the ramp-up when checking the DRIVE-CLiQ topology. For this reason, the drive device has stopped the ramp-up in the 'Topology error' state. - Check actual topology and possibly replug in line with the target topology. - Check DRIVE-CLiQ cables for breakage and problems with contacts. - Test DRIVE-CLiQ components for operational functioning. Note: Under 'Setup > Drive system > Drive devices > Topology', HMI offers a suitable diagnostics (e.g. target/actual value comparison).

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Setting up acyclic link %1 failed.%nSwitch off/on control, drives and HMI.
desc_en: Setting up an acyclic link with a drive device for file transfer from/to this drive device has failed. The file could not be transferred from/to this drive device. The affected drive device has the bus number and slave address specified in the link name: /DRIVE_<Bus number>_<Slave address>. Execute the following measures in the sequence specified until the process leading to the alarm can be repeated successfully: 1. Switch off/on control, drives and HMI, and then repeat the process leading to the alarm. 2. Load PROFIBUS configuration (HW Config) with same PLC and CP-Subnet-ID in PLC and CP, switch off/on control and HMI, and then repeat the process leading to the alarm. 3. Return to factory settings of the affected drive device, switch off/on control, drives and HMI, and then repeat the process leading to the alarm. 4. Regarding the error text, submit a Support Request to: http://www.siemens.com/automation/support-request

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: SINAMICS: Firmware update for DRIVE-CLiQ components is running.%nPlease wait for the firmware update to be completed!
desc_en: The firmware update is being executed for at least one DRIVE-CLiQ component. None required. Please wait for the firmware update to be completed. Completion of the firmware update is signaled by alarm 120406.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: SINAMICS: Firmware update of DRIVE-CLiQ components completed.%nSwitch off/on drive system!
desc_en: Firmware update of all DRIVE-CLiQ components completed.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: SINAMICS: Read job for parameter %1, area %2: %3 s timeout!
desc_en: It is taking too long to read a SINAMICS parameter. This can slow down the operation of a connected HMI significantly. 1. Acknowledge alarm. 2. Check drive load: The CPU time load values in parameter r9976 for the corresponding Control Unit should be less than 80%. 3. Regarding the error text, submit a Support Request to: http://www.siemens.com/automation/support-request

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The safety operating mode needs to be adapted in at least one drive device!
desc_en: The safety operating mode needs to be adapted in at least one drive device. The safety operating mode needs to be adapted under 'Setup/Safety/Adapt SI mode'.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Adaptation to SINUMERIK required in at least one drive device.
desc_en: An adaptation to SINUMERIK is required in at least one drive device. An adaptation to SINUMERIK is required in at least one drive device. To do so, carry out a Reset (PO), then acknowledge the following system dialog "Adaptation to SINUMERIK" with "OK". Alternatively, a manual adaptation can be made in the affected drive device using the parameter sequence P0009 = 30 and P0976 = 502. Then save the parameters of the drive device.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Auto Servo Tuning has been shut down unexpectedly during a previous operation.%nIt may be necessary to restore the output data of the last tuning.
desc_en: The alarm signals that a recovery point exists. A recovery point may come to a standstill on a platform if AST is unexpectedly shut down (e.g. in the case of power failure, failure in communications etc.) Recovery of the recovery point sets the machine data back to the values before the tuning. This ensures that the machine is in a consistent state. Data recovery may be executed from the Auto Servo Tuning application in HMI-Setup.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Error during Auto Servo Optimization: %1
desc_en: Automatic axis optimization has failed. Auto Servo Tuning canceled optimization because of an error. Place a support request with the error text under: http://www.siemens.com/automation/support-request HMI alarms 6.1 HMI alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Error in the AST Kernel Library: %1
desc_en: Automatic axis optimization has failed. Auto Servo Tuning canceled optimization because of an error. Place a support request with the error text under: http://www.siemens.com/automation/support-request

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Auto Servo Optimization has aborted the optimization. Reason: %1 (%2<AST>)
desc_en: Automatic axis optimization has failed. Ensure that: 1. The channel is in RESET. 2. The axis can be traversed in JOG mode. 3. The axis optimization calls in the part program are neither incorrect nor incomplete. Look up error number in the user documentation. After debugging, restart the part program.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: AST Kernel Library has aborted the optimization. Reason: %1 (%2<AST>)
desc_en: Automatic axis optimization has failed. The axis optimization calls in the part program are probably incorrect or incomplete. Look up error number in the user documentation. After debugging, restart the part program.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Auto Servo Tuning was canceled by the user.
desc_en: Automatic axis optimization was canceled by the user. The part program must be restarted.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Auto Servo Optimization has aborted the optimization. Reason: %1 (%2<AST>)
desc_en: An error has occurred during a measurement of the automatic axis optimization.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Adaptation of the softkey access levels active
desc_en: The alarm signalizes that the commissioning mode for softkeys has been activated. In this mode, the access level of a softkey can be reassigned by a right click on the softkey. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the commissioning mode for softkeys is terminated.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Communication to %1 failed
desc_en: The operator panel is connected to the NC and PLC by a communications bus. This alarm occurs when the communication to these components is interrupted. In connection with this alarm, all display values connected with the NC/PLC become invalid. Such faults are normal while the controls are ramping up (e.g. after resetting). The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the fault situation has ended. If this alarm is continuously present, a wide variety of faults may be the cause. (e.g. wire breakage, NC/PLC not ramped up, faulty address/data transfer rate configuration of one of the bus nodes, etc.).

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Waiting for a connection to %1
desc_en: The operator panel is connected to the NC and PLC by a communications bus. This alarm occurs if the MMC is started for the first time and the NC/PLC ramp-up has not yet finished or the communication to these components is faulty. In conjuncction with this alarm, all display values connected with the NC/PLC become invalid. Such faults are normal while the controls are starting up (e.g. after resetting). The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the fault situation has ended. If this alarm is continuously present, a wide variety of faults may be the cause. (e.g. wire breakage, NC/PLC not ramped up, faulty address/data transfer rate configuration of one of the bus nodes, etc.).

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: ----- Start alarm acquisition -----
desc_en: The alarm indicates the start or restart of alarm acquisition in the alarm log. If the alarm log has been configured so that it is persistently written into the file system, a further alarm is written into the log at each new start. The alarm thus separates the individual time intervals during which alarm acquisition is active. The coming and going time stamps are identical, and correspond to the time of the start/restart of the alarm acquisition. The alarm is only visible in the alarm log. The alarm can but need not be deleted as it is only visible in the alarm log.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: ----- Maximum log size %1 MB reached -----
desc_en: The alarm indicates that the alarm log, for alarm acquisition, of the alarm recorder has reached its maximum size. No more events will be recorded! The alarm can but need not be deleted as it is only visible in the alarm log.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: %1 is active
desc_en: The alarm signalizes that a defined energy state has been reached. Energy states can be configured via an HMI screenform in commissioning. The HMI screenforms can be accessed with the shortcut "Ctrl-E". The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the energy state reached has been terminated.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: HMI Operate version %1 requires CNC software version %2
desc_en: The alarm indicates that the version of the HMI Operate software used requires a different version of the SINUMERIK CNC software. This combination can lead to malfunctions or display problems. Use of the version of the SINUMERIK CNC software stated in the alarm.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The system CF card is nearly full.
desc_en: The alarm signalizes that the system CF card is nearly full. Please delete the programs no longer required on the local drive and/or the data on the system CF card. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as sufficient memory space is available.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: '%1' : '%2' cannot be reselected in channel '%3'
desc_en: On the NCU, the program could not be automatically selected for the channel for external execution. Please check whether the channel is in reset and if the program is present. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the program is selected on the NCU for the channel for 'Execution from external source'

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The buffered memory for the 'NC Extend' drive is full
desc_en: The alarm indicates that the 'NC Extend' drive is full. Please delete programs that are no longer needed from the local drive. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as sufficient memory space is available.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The set user memory on the 'local drive'/'NC Extend' has been exceeded, see display MD HMI_MEM_LIMIT_USER
desc_en: The alarm indicates that the user memory set in display MD HMI_MEM_LIMIT_USER is full. Please delete data that is no longer needed from the local drive/NC Extend. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as sufficient memory space is available.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The available manufacturer memory has been exceeded, see display MD HMI_MEM_LIMIT_USER
desc_en: The alarm indicates that the available manufacturer memory set in display MD HMI_MEM_LIMIT_USER is full. Please delete data that is no longer needed from manufacturer area of the CF card. HMI alarms 6.1 HMI alarms Alarms Diagnostics Manual, 07/2024, A5E48124459B AK

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The SD card is almost full
desc_en: The alarm indicates that the SD card is almost full. Delete any programs that are no longer needed on the local drive and/or any data on the SD card. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as sufficient memory space is available.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The memory available for users and manufacturer data (6 GB) is full
desc_en: The alarm indicates that the area for users and manufacturer data is full. Please delete programs that are no longer needed from the drives. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as sufficient memory space is available.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: /install directory exceeds the permissible size, please correct.
desc_en: The alarm indicates that the install directory is too full. Please delete data that are no longer needed with external tools, and restart the HMI. The alarm does not disappear until the next HMI restart after the cause has been eliminated.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The available memory for manufacturer 'oem' and/or 'individual' is full
desc_en: The alarm indicates that the manufacturer drive 'oem' and/or 'individual' is full. Delete any files on the drive that you no longer need. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as sufficient memory space is available.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Action not possible. Option not set: %1
desc_en: The functionality can only be executed if the corresponding option is set. In the operating area "Setup", set (HSK) "Licenses", (VSK) "All options" The alarm disappears when the option is set and the HMI is then rebooted.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Texts in the PLC project have been changed!%nIf required, they must be imported and the HMI restarted.
desc_en: Loading new texts to the PLC requires an HMI reboot. If texts have been changed in the PLC project, they have to be imported, and the HMI restarted if they are used in the HMI, e.g. alarm texts. HMI alarms 6.1 HMI alarms Alarms

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: No information on SIEMENS registration available.
desc_en: Checking the machine registration is activated and has failed. The machine is not registered with SIEMENS. The alarm disappears when the machine is registered at Siemns. The registration can be performed in the "Diagnostics" operating area in the "Version" operating screen via the "Register machine" softkey. Scan the QR code in the "Register machine" operating screen. Via a link this code takes you to the official SIEMENS registration page. Enter the required information on the registration page to obtain the 12-digit registration code. The 12-digit registration code must then be entered in the "Register machine" operating screen. Make sure that the registered CF card is also inserted in the registered NCU. The message can be temporarily switched off via the "Remind me later" softkey in the "Register machine" operating screen.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Backup data archive could not be created, next attempt tomorrow at %1%n %2 .
desc_en: The creation of automatic data backup archives is enabled. However, no data backup archive could be created due to errors. A new attempt will be made after 24 hours. The alarm explains the cause of the error and how to fix it. It disappears with the next successful data backup.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The creation of the automatic data backup archive will start in %1 minutes.
desc_en: The creation of automatic data backup archives is enabled and notification of the start of the data backup has been given. Notifications appear at two-minute intervals starting 10 minutes before the start. The alarm disappears once the system starts the data backup.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The CNC is registered by the machine manufacturer. Update the information at the final installation location after commissioning.
desc_en: The machine is registered with the machine manufacturer. Update the information at the final installation site after commissioning. The alarm disappears when the machine is registered at the final installation location. The registration can be performed in the "Diagnostics" operating area in the "Version" operating screen via the "Register machine" softkey. Scan the QR code in the "Register machine" operating screen. Via a link this code takes you to the official SIEMENS registration page. Enter the required information on the registration page to obtain the 12-digit registration code. The 12-digit registration code must then be entered in the "Register machine" operating screen. Make sure that the registered CF card is also inserted in the registered NCU. The message can be temporarily switched off via the "Remind me later" softkey in the "Register machine" operating screen.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The CNC is registered by the machine dealer. Update the information at the final installation location after commissioning.
desc_en: The machine is registered with the machine dealer. Update the information at the final installation site after commissioning. The alarm disappears when the machine is registered at the final installation location. The registration can be performed in the "Diagnostics" operating area in the "Version" operating screen via the "Register machine" softkey. Scan the QR code in the "Register machine" operating screen. Via a link this code takes you to the official SIEMENS registration page. Enter the required information on the registration page to obtain the 12-digit registration code. The 12-digit registration code must then be entered in the "Register machine" operating screen. Make sure that the registered CF card is also inserted in the registered NCU. The message can be temporarily switched off via the "Remind me later" softkey in the "Register machine" operating screen.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Please set Windows enable and distribute drives.
desc_en: The alarm signals that logon data for EES drives are missing. Please set Windows enable under Setup/HMI/Log. drives, and distribute drives. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the logon data have been set for Windows enable and the drives have been distributed.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The drive configuration is being distributed and activated on NCU %1
desc_en: The alarm signals that the drives are being distributed. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the drives have been activated on the NCU.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Error during the drive configuration of drives %2 on NCU %1
desc_en: The alarm signals that an error has occurred during activation of the drives on the NCU. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the NCU drives have been successfully activated.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The drive configuration could not be distributed on the NCU %1 as programs are being processed
desc_en: The alarm signals that not all channels on the NCU are in the RESET state. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the NCU drives have been successfully activated.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The drive configuration has been changed, and must be redistributed
desc_en: The alarm signals that the contents of the logdrive.ini file(s) have changed, or are not the same as those on the NCU. Please distribute the drives under Setup/HMI/Log. drives. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the drives have been distributed.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Error accessing NCU %1. Please check the NCU and redistribute the drives.
desc_en: The alarm signals that an error has occurred while accessing the NCU. Please check the NCU, and redistribute the drives under Setup/HMI/Log. Drives. The alarm disappears automatically as soon as the drives have been distributed.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Invalid configuration of the "Additional CNC user memory extended" option.
desc_en: "Additional CNC user memory" can only be used after "CNC user memory extended" or " Execute from external storage (EES)" has been set. The alarm is cleared when "CNC user memory extended" or "Execution From External Storage (EES)" has been set.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Only %1 %2 of the SD card is available. Not as much user memory available as requested in the "Additional CNC user memory extended" option.
desc_en: The alarm appears if not as much memory can be provided as requested by the user in the option "Additional CNC user memory extended". You can try to free memory on the SD card (delete unused additional languages, old archives and NC programs) or select the value for the "Additional CNC user memory extended" option so that it matches the available free memory. The following values are possible for the "Additional CNC user memory extended" option: 0 – Default value. No additional memory available. 1 – 300 MB additional SD card memory available. 2 – 500 MB additional SD card memory available. 3 – 1000 MB additional SD card memory available.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: PLC stopped - password for protection of confidential PLC configuration data not set or not correct.
desc_en: The configuration data in the loaded PLC project was protected with a password. This password was not set in the PLC or is not correct. Therefore, the PLC project cannot be started. In Sinumerik Operate, set the correct password for the protection of confidential PLC configuration data. The alarm is deleted after setting the correct password for protecting confidential PLC configuration data and restarting the PLC.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The PLC access level in Operate is not sufficient to enable correct operation.
desc_en: Access level passwords were defined in the loaded PLC project. In Sinumerik Operate these passwords were not set or the access level of the stored password is not sufficient. Sinumerik Operate requires at least the password for full access. If the PLC project contains a Safety part, full access incl. fail- safe PLC is required to also create and restore PLC archives. Set a PLC access level password in Sinumerik Operate for the required access level. The alarm is deleted after setting the correct PLC access level password and restarting the PLC.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: The PLC access level in Operate is not sufficient to create a PLC archive of a fail-safe PLC.
desc_en: Access level passwords were defined in the loaded PLC project. In Sinumerik Operate, these passwords were not set or the access level of the stored password is not sufficient. Sinumerik Operate requires at least the password for full access. If the PLC project contains a Safety part, full access incl. fail- safe PLC is required to be able to also create and restore PLC archives. Set a PLC access level password in Operate for the required access level. Set a PLC access level password with the required rights. The alarm is deleted after setting the correct PLC access level password and restarting the PLC.

title: Панель оператора · указатель
message_en: Security Services are not available. To avoid severe impact on the use of the HMI, reboot the system after part program is finished.
desc_en: There is a problem with the Security Services. This may severely restrict operability. However, the current machining process should not be affected by this. Try restarting the device on which Operate is running. Note that a restart is not recommended during active machining.
